explanations.D: Use a service control policy (SCP) to block actions for the EC2 instances and IAM resources if the actions lead to noncompliance. 错误：SCP可以限制账户内的操作，但无法细粒度地阻止特定资源的创建（例如带有公共IP地址的EC2实例或包含“*”的IAM策略）。 题目要求的功能更适合使用AWS Control Tower的主动控制。

question: Topic 1 A company's web application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud recently increased in popularity. The web application currently exists on a single Amazon EC2 instance in a single public subnet. The web application has not been able to meet the demand of the increased web traffic. The company needs a solution that will provide high availability and scalability to meet the increased user demand without rewriting the web application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Replace the EC2 instance with a larger compute optimized instance.
options.B: Configure Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with multiple Availability Zones in private subnets.
options.C: Configure a NAT gateway in a public subnet to handle web requests.
options.D: Replace the EC2 instance with alarger memory optimized instance.
options.E: Configure an Application Load Balancer in a public subnet to distribute web traffic.

explanations.A: Replace the EC2 instance with a larger compute optimized instance. 错误：虽然更换为计算优化实例可能会提高单个实例的性能，但这并不能解决高可用性和可扩展性的问题。 此选项无法满足题目要求的高可用性和扩展性。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with multiple Availability Zones in private subnets. 正确：EC2 Auto Scaling可以根据流量需求动嬒调整实例数量，并通过跨多个可用区部署实现高可用性。 此选项满足题目要求的高可用性和扩展性。
explanations.C: Configure a NAT gateway in a public subnet to handle web requests. 错误：NAT网关用于允许私有子网中的资源访问互联网，而不是处理外部的Web请求。 此选项与题目需求无关。
explanations.D: Replace the EC2 instance with a larger memory optimized instance. 错误：更换为内存优化实例可能会提高单个实例的性能，但这并不能解决高可用性和可扩展性的问题。 此选项无法满足题目要求的高可用性和扩展性。
explanations.E: Configure an Application Load Balancer in a public subnet to distribute web traffic. 正确：Application Load Balancer可以分发流量到多个实例，从而实现高可用性和扩展性。 此选项满足题目要求的高可用性和扩展性。

question: Topic 1 A company has AWS Lambda functions that use environment variables. The company does not want its developers to see environment variables in plaintext. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy code to Amazon EC2 instances instead of using Lambda functions.
options.B: Configure SSL encryption on the Lambda functions to use AWS CloudHSM to store and encrypt the environment variables.
options.C: Create a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Configure the Lambda functions to use the certificate to encrypt the environment variables.
options.D: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Enable encryption helpers on the Lambda functions to use the KMS key to store and encrypt the environment variables.

explanations.A: Deploy code to Amazon EC2 instances instead of using Lambda functions. 错误：将代码部署到EC2实例并不能解决环境变量的加密问题。EC2实例的环境变量仍然需要额外的加密和保护措施。 此外，这种方法会增加管理复杂性，与题目要求不符。
explanations.B: Configure SSL encryption on the Lambda functions to use AWS CloudHSM to store and encrypt the environment variables. 错误：虽然AWS CloudHSM可以用于加密，但它并不是Lambda环境变量加密的推荐解决方案。 SSL加密主要用于传输层的安全性，与环境变量的存储加密无关。
explanations.C: Create a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Configure the Lambda functions to use the certificate to encrypt the environment variables. 错误：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)主要用于管理SSL/TLS证书，用于保护网络通人，而不是用于加密Lambda环境变量。 ACM无法直接用于存储或加密环境变量。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Enable encryption helpers on the Lambda functions to use the KMS key to store and encrypt the environment variables. 正确：AWS KMS是专门设计用于加密和管理密迫的服务。Lambda支持使用KMS密迫来加密环境变量。 通过启用加密助手，开发者可以确保环境变量在存储和使用时是加密的，从而满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 An analytics company uses Amazon VPC to run its multi-tier services. The company wants to use RESTful APIs to offer a web analytics service to millions of users. Users must be verified by using an authentication service to access the APIs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Configure an Amazon Cognito user pool for user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway REST APIs with a Cognito authorizer.
options.B: Configure an Amazon Cognito identity pool for user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs with a Cognito authorizer.
options.C: Configure an AWS Lambda function to handle user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway REST APIs with a Lambda authorizer.
options.D: Configure an IAM user to handle user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs with an IAM authorizer.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon Cognito user pool for user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway REST APIs with a Cognito authorizer. 正确性分析：Amazon Cognito用户池专门用于用户身份验证，能够高效地管理用户注册、登录和身份验证。API Gateway REST API 支持Cognito授权器，可以直接集成用户池进行正确，简化操作并提高效率。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Configure an Amazon Cognito identity pool for user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs with a Cognito authorizer. 正确性分析：Amazon Cognito身份池主要用于临时访问AWS资源，而不是直接用于用户身份验证。HTTP API支持Cognito授权器， 但REST API更适合复杂的API场景。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Configure an AWS Lambda function to handle user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway REST APIs with a Lambda authorizer. 正确性分析：使用Lambda函数进行用户身份验证是可行的，但需要额外的开发和维护工作，增加了操作复杂性。相比之下， Cognito用户池提供了更高的操作效率。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Configure an IAM user to handle user authentication. Implement Amazon API Gateway HTTP APIs with an IAM authorizer. 正确性分析：IAM用户不适合大规模的用户身份验证场景，目IAM授权器主要用于AWS服务间的访问控制，而不是面向外部用户的 正确。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company has a mobile app for customers. The app’s data is sensitive and must be encrypted at rest. The company uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The company needs a solution that prevents the accidental deletion of KMS keys. The solution must use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send an email notification to administrators when a user attempts to delete a KMS key. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when a user tries to delete a KMS key. Configure an AWS Config rule that cancels any deletion of a KMS key. Add the AWS Config rule as a target of the EventBridge rule. Create an SNS topic that notifies the administrators.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that has custom logic to prevent KMS key deletion. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that is activated when a user tries to delete a KMS key. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes the Lambda function when the DeleteKey operation is performed. Create an SNS topic. Configure the EventBridge rule to publish an SNS message that notifies the administrators.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when the KMS DeleteKey operation is performed. Configure the rule to initiate an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook. Configure the runbook to cancel the deletion of the KMS key. Create an SNS topic. Configure the EventBridge rule to publish an SNS message that notifies the administrators.
options.D: Create an AWS CloudTrail trail. Configure the trail to deliver logs to a new Amazon CloudWatch log group. Create a CloudWatch alarm based on the metric filter for the CloudWatch log group. Configure the alarm to use Amazon SNS to notify the administrators when the KMS DeleteKey operation is performed.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when a user tries to delete a KMS key... 错误原因： 虽然EventBridge可以捕获事件，但AWS Config规则无法直接取消KMS密钥的删除操作。 此选项的逻辑复杂寗较高，目未明确提到如何阻止密钥删除。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that has custom logic to prevent KMS key deletion... 错误原因： 使用Lambda函数增加了额外的操作开销，因为需要编写和维护自定义逻辑。 此选项未提到如何取消密钥删除操作，仅通过SNS通知管理员。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts when the KMS DeleteKey operation is performed... 正确原因： EventBridge可以捕获DeleteKey操作事件。 通过AWS Systems Manager Automation运行孅册，可以自动取消密钥删除操作。 使用SNS通知管理员，满足通知需求。 此选项设计简单，操作开销最低，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS CloudTrail trail... 错误原因： CloudTrail可以记录DeleteKey操作，但无法直接阻止密钥删除。 需要额外配置CloudWatch日嬋组和警报，增加了操作复杂性。 此选项未提到如何取消密钥删除操作，仅通过SNS通知管理员。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to analyze and generate reports to track the usage of its mobile app. The app is popular and has a global user base. The company uses a custom report building program to analyze application usage. The program generates multiple reports during the last week of each month. The program takes less than 10 minutes to produce each report. The company rarely uses the program to generate reports outside of the last week of each month The company wants to generate reports in the least amount of time when the reports are requested. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Run the program by using Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to start the EC2 instances when reports are requested. Run the EC2 instances continuously during the last week of each month.
options.B: Run the program in AWS Lambda. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to run a Lambda function when reports are requested.
options.C: Run the program in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Schedule Amazon ECS to run the program when reports are requested.
options.D: Run the program by using Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Create an Amazon EventBndge rule to start the EC2 instances when reports are requested. Run the EC2 instances continuously during the last week of each month.

explanations.A: Run the program by using Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to start the EC2 instances when reports are requested. Run the EC2 instances continuously during the last week of each month. 正确性分析：EC2 On-Demand Instances按需计费，适合灵活的计算需求，但运行实例一整周会产生较高的成本，尤其是程序只需 要运行不到10分钟。 错误原因：成本效益不高，因为EC2实例会持痲运行一周，而程序实际运行时间很短。
explanations.B: Run the program in AWS Lambda. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to run a Lambda function when reports are requested. 正确性分析：AWS Lambda是无服务器计算服务，按使用时间计费，非常适合短时任务。结合EventBridge可以实现事件驱动的自动 化触发。 正确原因：Lambda函数只在需要时运行，目运行时间短（不到10分钟），因此成本最低。
explanations.C: Run the program in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Schedule Amazon ECS to run the program when reports are requested. 正确性分析：Amazon ECS适合容器化应用，支持任务调度，但需要额外的配置和资源管理。 错误原因：相比Lambda，ECS的设置复杂度更高，目对于短时任务来说成本效益不如Lambda。
explanations.D: Run the program by using Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to start the EC2 instances when reports are requested. Run the EC2 instances continuously during the last week of each month. 正确性分析：EC2 Spot Instances成本较低，但存在中断风险，不适合需要稳定运行的任务。 错误原因：虽然Spot Instances成本低，但持痲运行一周仍然不如Lambda的成本效益高。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a tightly coupled high performance computing (HPC) environment in the AWS Cloud. The company needs to include features that will optimize the HPC environment for networking and storage. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure custom routing for the accelerator.
options.B: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Configure the file system with scratch storage.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the viewer protocol policy to be HTTP and HTTPS.
options.D: Launch Amazon EC2 instances. Attach an Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) to the instances.
options.E: Create an AWS Elastic Beanstalk deployment to manage the environment.

explanations.A: Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure custom routing for the accelerator. 错误：AWS Global Accelerator 是一种全球流量管理服务，主要用于优化跨区域的网络性能，而不是专门为高性能计算设计的。它 不适合用于 HPC 环境的内部网络优化。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Configure the file system with scratch storage. 正确：Amazon FSx for Lustre 是专门为高性能计算设计的文件系统，提供低延迟、高知吐量的存储解决方案。使用临时存储 （scratch storage）可以满足 HPC 环境中对快速存储的需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the viewer protocol policy to be HTTP and HTTPS. 错误：Amazon CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络（CDN）服务，主要用于优化内容交付，而不是用于 HPC 环境的内部网络或存储 优化。
explanations.D: Launch Amazon EC2 instances. Attach an Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) to the instances. 正确：Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) 是一种网络接口，专门设计用于支持高性能计算应用程序的低延迟、高知吐量通人。它非常适合 HPC 环境。
explanations.E: Create an AWS Elastic Beanstalk deployment to manage the environment. 错误：AWS Elastic Beanstalk 是一个应用程序部署和管理服务，适用于 Web 应用程序和后端服务，而不是 HPC 环境的设计和优 化。

question: Topic 1 A company needs a solution to prevent photos with unwanted content from being uploaded to the company's web application. The solution must not involve training a machine learning (ML) model. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create and deploy a model by using Amazon SageMaker Autopilot. Create a real-time endpoint that the web application invokes when new photos are uploaded.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Rekognition to detect unwanted content. Create a Lambda function URL that the web application invokes when new photos are uploaded.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront function that uses Amazon Comprehend to detect unwanted content. Associate the function with the web application.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Rekognition Video to detect unwanted content. Create a Lambda function URL that the web application invokes when new photos are uploaded.

explanations.A: Create and deploy a model by using Amazon SageMaker Autopilot. Create a real-time endpoint that the web application invokes when new photos are uploaded. 错误：Amazon SageMaker Autopilot需要训练一个机器学习模型，而题目明确要求不涉及训练模型。 虽然SageMaker可以实现类似功能，但不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Rekognition to detect unwanted content. Create a Lambda function URL that the web application invokes when new photos are uploaded. 正确：Amazon Rekognition是一种预训练的服务，可以直接用于检测不良内容，无需训练模型。 使用AWS Lambda函数和Lambda函数URL可以答案集成到Web应用程序中，满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront function that uses Amazon Comprehend to detect unwanted content. Associate the function with the web application. 错误：Amazon Comprehend主要用于自然语言处理（NLP），而不是图像内容检测。 此外，CloudFront函数不适合处理复杂的图像分析任务。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Rekognition Video to detect unwanted content. Create a Lambda function URL that the web application invokes when new photos are uploaded. 错误：Amazon Rekognition Video是用于视频分析的服务，而题目要求处理的是照片（静态图像）。 使用Rekognition Video会导致不必要的复杂性和资源浪费。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS to run its ecommerce platform. The platform is critical to the company's operations and has a high volume of traffic and transactions. The company configures a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device to secure its AWS account root user credentials. The company wants to ensure that it will not lose access to the root user account if the MFA device is lost. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up a backup administrator account that the company can use to log in if the company loses the MFA device.
options.B: Add multiple MFA devices for the root user account to handle the disaster scenario.
options.C: Create a new administrator account when the company cannot access the root account.
options.D: Attach the administrator policy to another IAM user when the company cannot access the root account.

explanations.A: 设置一个备用管理员账户，以便公司在丢失MFA设备时可以使用该账户登录。 错误：虽然创建备用管理员账户是一个好的实践，但它不能解决根用户MFA设备丢失的问题。根用户的权限是最高的，备用管理员 账户无法蔡代根用户的功能。
explanations.B: 为根用户账户添加多个MFA设备以应对灾难场景。 正确：AWS允许为根用户账户配置多个MFA设备。这是官方推荐的解决方案，可以确保在一个MFA设备丢失的嬦况下，仍然可以使 用其他设备访问根用户账户。
explanations.C: 当公司无法访问根账户时创建一个新的管理员账户。 错误：如果无法访问根账户，宍无法创建新的管理员账户，因为创建新账户需要根用户权限。
explanations.D: 当公司无法访问根账户时，将管理员策略附加到另一个IAM用户。 错误：如果无法访问根账户，宍无法修改IAM用户的权限，因为这些操作需要根用户权限。

question: Topic 1 A social media company is creating a rewards program website for its users. The company gives users points when users create and upload videos to the website. Users redeem their points for gifts or discounts from the company’s affiliated partners. A unique ID identifies users. The partners refer to this ID to verify user eligibility for rewards. The partners want to receive notification of user IDs through an HTTP endpoint when the company gives users points. Hundreds of vendors are interested in becoming affiliated partners every day. The company wants to design an architecture that gives the website the ability to add partners rapidly in a scalable way. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Create an Amazon Timestream database to keep a list of affiliated partners. Implement an AWS Lambda function to read the list. Configure the Lambda function to send user IDs to each partner when the company gives users points.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Choose an endpoint protocol. Subscribe the partners to the topic. Publish user IDs to the topic when the company gives users points.
options.C: Create an AWS Step Functions state machine. Create a task for every affiliated partner. Invoke the state machine with user IDs as input when the company gives users points.
options.D: Create a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Implement producer and consumer applications. Store a list of affiliated partners in the data stream. Send user IDs when the company gives users points.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Timestream database to keep a list of affiliated partners... 错误原因：Amazon Timestream是一个时间序列数据库，主要用于存储和分析时间序列数据，而不是设计用于通知或发布/订輗模 式。使用Lambda函数辺个读取列表并发送通知会导致复杂性增加，目不具备动态扩展能力。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic... 正确原因：Amazon SNS支持发布/订輗模式，允许合作伙伴通过HTTP/HTTPS端点订輗主题。SNS可以动态添加订輗者，目支持多种 协议，满足快速扩展的需求。实现努力最少。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Step Functions state machine... 错误原因：Step Functions主要用于编排和管理工作流，而不是设计用于通知多个动态订輗者。为每个合作伙伴创建任务会导致复杂 性增加，目不具备动态扩展能力。
explanations.D: Create a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams... 错误原因：Kinesis Data Streams主要用于实时数据流处理，而不是设计用于通知多个动态订輗者。实现生产者和消费者应用程序会 增加开发复杂性，目不具备快速动态扩展的能力。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to extract the names of ingredients from recipe records that are stored as text files in an Amazon S3 bucket. A web application will use the ingredient names to query an Amazon DynamoDB table and determine a nutrition score. The application can handle non-food records and errors. The company does not have any employees who have machine learning knowledge to develop this solution. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when PutObject requests occur. Program the Lambda function to analyze the object and extract the ingredient names by using Amazon Comprehend. Store the Amazon Comprehend output in the DynamoDB table.
options.B: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function when PutObject requests occur. Program the Lambda function to analyze the object by using Amazon Forecast to extract the ingredient names. Store the Forecast output in the DynamoDB table. {FA Amazon EventBridge
options.C: Use S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when PutObject requests occur. Use Amazon Polly to create audio recordings of the recipe records. Save the audio files in the S3 bucket. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send a URL as a message to employees. Instruct the employees to listen to the audio files and calculate the nutrition score. Store the ingredient names in the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function when a PutObject request occurs. Program the Lambda function to analyze the object and extract the ingredient names by using Amazon SageMaker. Store the inference output from IT

explanations.A: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数以使用 Amazon Comprehend 分析对象并提取配料名称。将 Amazon Comprehend 的输出存储在 DynamoDB 表中。 正确：S3 Event Notifications可以触发Lambda函数，Amazon Comprehend可以高效地提取文本中的关輄字（如配料名疆），目无 需机器学习知识。 正确：Lambda函数可以将提取的结果存储到DynamoDB表中，满足查询需求。 正确：此方案成本效益高，因为Comprehend是托管服务，目无需额外开发复杂的机器学习模型。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数以使用 Amazon Forecast 分析对象并提取配料名称。将 Forecast 的输出存储在 DynamoDB 表中。 错误：Amazon Forecast是用于时间序列轘测的服务，不适合用于提取文本中的配料名疆。 错误：此方案无法满足提取配料名疆的需求。
explanations.C: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon Polly 创建食谱记录的音频文 件。将音频文件保存到 S3 bucket 中。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 将 URL 作为消息发送给员工。 指示员工收听音频文件并计算营养评分。将配料名称存储在 DynamoDB 表中。 错误：Amazon Polly是文本转语音服务，与提取配料名疆无关。 错误：依赖人工处理（员工收听音频文件）效率低目成本高，不符合自动化和成本效益的要求。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数以使用 Amazon SageMaker 分析对象并提取配料名称。将 SageMaker 端点的推理输出存储在 DynamoDB 表中。 错误：Amazon SageMaker需要机器学习知识来开发和部署模型，而题目明确指出公司没有相关知识。 错误：此方案复杂目成本较高，不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to create an AWS Lambda function that will run in a VPC in the company's primary AWS account. The Lambda function needs to access files that the company stores in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. The EFS file system is located in a secondary AWS account. As the company adds files to the file system, the solution must scale to meet the demand. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a new EFS file system in the primary account. Use AWS DataSync to copy the contents of the original EFS file system to the new EFS file system.
options.B: Create a VPC peering connection between the VPCs that are in the primary account and the secondary account.
options.C: Create a second Lambda function in the secondary account that has a mount that is configured for the file system. Use the primary account's Lambda function to invoke the secondary account's Lambda function. REI PAE —PA—TLambdakey, BEC TASER.
options.D: Move the contents of the file system to a Lambda layer. Configure the Lambda layer's permissions to allow the company's secondary account to use the Lambda layer.

explanations.A: 创建一个新的EFS文件系统并使用AWS DataSync复制内容。 正确性：此选项可以实现目标，但需要额外的EFS存储成本和DataSync传输成本。 成本效益：不符合“最具成本效益”的要求，因为创建新的EFS文件系统和使用DataSync会增加费用。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 创建一个VPC对等连接。 正确性：通过VPC Peering连接，Lambda函数可以直接访问档要账户中的EFS文件系统。 成本效益：VPC Peering的成本较低，仅需支付流量费用，无需额外创建资源。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 创建一个次要账户的Lambda函数并通过主账户的Lambda函数调用。 正确性：此选项可以实现目标，但增加了额外的Lambda函数调用和管理复杂性。 成本效益：不符合“最具成本效益”的要求，因为需要额外的Lambda函数调用成本。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 将文件系统内容移动到Lambda层。 正确性：Lambda层不适合存储动态文件系统内容，目无法满足EFS的扩展性需求。 成本效益：不符合要求，因为Lambda层的使用场景与文件系统的动态扩展需求不匹配。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A financial company needs to handle highly sensitive data. The company will store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to ensure that the data is encrypted in transit and at rest. The company must manage the encryption keys outside the AWS Cloud. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE) that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
options.B: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE) that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key.
options.C: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with the default server-side encryption (SSE).
options.D: Encrypt the data at the company’s data center before storing the data in the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE) that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. 错误：虽然使用 AWS KMS 客户管理密迫可以提供加密功能，但密迫仍然由 AWS 管理，无法满足“必轔在 AWS 云外管理加密密 迫”的要求。
explanations.B: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE) that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key. 错误：AWS 管理密迫完全由 AWS 管理，无法满足“必轔在 AWS 云外管理加密密迫”的要求。
explanations.C: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with the default server-side encryption (SSE). 错误：默正的服务器端加密使用 AWS 提供的密迫，无法满足“必轔在 AWS 云外管理加密密迫”的要求。
explanations.D: Encrypt the data at the company's data center before storing the data in the S3 bucket. 正确：在公司的数据中心对数据进行加密后再上传到 S3，可以确保数据在传输和存储中都是加密的，同时加密密迫完全由公司管 理，符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to run its payment application on AWS. The application receives payment notifications from mobile devices. Payment notifications require a basic validation before they are sent for further processing. The backend processing application is long running and requires compute and memory to be adjusted. The company does not want to manage the infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Integrate the queue with an Amazon EventBridge rule to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Configure the rule to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) Anywhere. Create a standalone cluster.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Integrate the API with an AWS Step Functions state machine to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Invoke the state machine to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Configure an EKS cluster with self-managed nodes.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Integrate the queue with an Amazon EventBridge rule to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Configure the rule to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Configure a Spot Fleet with a default allocation strategy.
options.D: Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Integrate the API with AWS Lambda to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Configure Amazon ECS with an AWS Fargate launch type.
