question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a user authentication solution for a company. The solution must invoke two-factor authentication for users that log in from inconsistent geographical locations, IP addresses, or devices. The solution must also be able to scale up to accommodate millions of users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Cognito user pools for user authentication. Enable the risk-based adaptive authentication feature with multifactor authentication (MFA).
options.B: Configure Amazon Cognito identity pools for user authentication. Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA).
options.C: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) users for user authentication. Attach an IAM policy that allows the AllowManageOwnUserMFA action.
options.D: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) authentication for user authentication. Configure the permission sets to require multi-factor authentication (MFA).

explanations.A: Configure Amazon Cognito user pools for user authentication. Enable the risk-based adaptive authentication feature with multifactor authentication (MFA). 正确：Amazon Cognito用户池支持用户身份验证，并且可以启用基于风险的自适应身份验证功能和MFA。这完全符合题目要求，包 括地理位置、IP地址或设备的变化触发二次验证。 正确：Cognito用户池可以扩展到支持数百万用户，满足可扩展性需求。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon Cognito identity pools for user authentication. Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA). 错误：Amazon Cognito身份池主要用于临时访问AWS资源，而不是直接用于用户身份验证。身份池不支持基于风险的自适应身份验 确功能。 错误：虽然可以启用MFA，但身份池的功能不符合题目要求的地理位置、IP地址或设备变化触发二次验证。
explanations.C: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) users for user authentication. Attach an IAM policy that allows the AllowManageOwnUserMFA action. 错误：IAM用户主要用于管理AWS资源的访问权限，而不是设计用于大规模用户身份验证。 错误：IAM用户不支持基于风险的自适应身份验证功能，也不适合扩展到数百万用户。
explanations.D: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) authentication for user authentication. Configure the permission sets to require multi-factor authentication (MFA). 错误：AWS IAM Identity Center主要用于企业级单点登录解决方案，适用于管理少量用户的权限集，而不是设计用于大规模用户身 份验证。 错误：虽然可以配置MFA，但它不支持基于风险的自适应身份验证功能。

question: Topic 1 A company has an Amazon S3 data lake. The company needs a solution that transforms the data from the data lake and loads the data into a data warehouse every day. The data warehouse must have massively parallel processing (MPP) capabilities. Data analysts then need to create and train machine learning (ML) models by using SQL commands on the data. The solution must use serverless AWS services wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models.
options.B: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Aurora Serverless. Use Amazon Aurora ML to create and train the ML models.
options.C: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models.
options.D: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Athena tables. Use Amazon Athena ML to create and train the ML models.

explanations.A: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models. Amazon EMR是一个托管的Hadoop框架，适合大规模数据处理，但它不是无服务器服务。 Amazon Redshift支持MPP并且可以使用Redshift ML进行机器学习模型的创建和训练。 此选项不完全符合“使用无服务器服务”的要求，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Aurora Serverless. Use Amazon Aurora ML to create and train the ML models. Amazon Aurora Serverless是一个无服务器关系数据库，但它不具备MPP能力。 Amazon Aurora ML的功能有限，无法直接满足题目中“使用SQL命令进行机器学习模型创建和训练”的要求。 此选项不符合MPP能力的要求，因此不正确。
explanations.C: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models. AWS Glue是一个无服务器ETL服务，适合数据转换和加载任务。 Amazon Redshift Serverless支持MPP并且可以使用Redshift ML进行机器学习模型的创建和训练。 此选项完全符合题目要求，包括无服务器服务、MPP能力以及SQL命令进行机器学习模型创建和训练。
explanations.D: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Athena tables. Use Amazon Athena ML to create and train the ML models. AWS Glue是无服务器ETL服务，适合数据转换和加载任务。 Amazon Athena是一个无服务器查询服务，但它不具备MPP能力。 Amazon Athena目前不支持直接使用SQL命令进行机器学习模型的创建和训练。 此选项不符合MPP能力的要求，因此不正确。

question: Topic 1 A company runs containers in a Kubernetes environment in the company's local data center. The company wants to use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and other AWS managed services. Data must remain locally in the company's data center and cannot be stored in any remote site or cloud to maintain compliance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS Local Zones in the company's data center.
options.B: Use an AWS Snowmobile in the company's data center.
options.C: Install an AWS Outposts rack in the company’s data center.
options.D: Install an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized node in the data center.

explanations.A: Deploy AWS Local Zones in the company's data center. 错误原因：AWS Local Zones是AWS在特定地理位置提供的扩展区域，允许用户将计算和存储资源部署在靠邮用户的地方，但它并 不能直接部署在客户的数据中心内。 Local Zones仍然是AWS管理的区域，数据最终会存储在AWS的基础设施中，不符合题目要求的数据必须留在本地的条件。
explanations.B: Use an AWS Snowmobile in the company's data center. 错误原因：AWS Snowmobile是一种用于大规模数据迁移的解决方案，通常用于将PB级数据从本地数据中心迁移到AWS云。它不适 用于运行持续的计算或存储服务。 题目要求是运行Amazon EKS和其他AWS服务，而不是数据迁移，因此Snowmobile不符合要求。
explanations.C: Install an AWS Outposts rack in the company's data center. 正确原因：AWS Outposts是一种混合云解决方案，允许用户在自己的数据中心运行AWS服务（如Amazon EKS），同时数据可以完 全保留在本地以满足合规性要求。 Outposts是专门设计用于在本地数据中心提供AWS服务的解决方案，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Install an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized node in the data center. 错误原因：AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized主要用于边缘计算和数据迁移，虽然可以在本地运行一些计算任务，但它不支持 完整的AWS服务（如Amazon EKS）。 Snowball Edge的功能有限，无法满足题目中运行Amazon EKS的需求。

question: Topic 1 A social media company has workloads that collect and process data. The workloads store the data in on-premises NFS storage. The data store cannot scale fast enough to meet the company’s expanding business needs. The company wants to migrate the current data store to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class.
options.B: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class.
options.C: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy. {$F Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard-lA)
options.D: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy. {$F Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA)

explanations.A: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class. Volume Gateway主要用于块存储，与NFS文件存储不匹配。 虽然可以使用Amazon S3 Lifecycle策略优化存储成本，但Volume Gateway并不是最适合迁移NFS数据的解决方案。 错误原因：Volume Gateway不适合处理文件存储需求。
explanations.B: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class. File Gateway专门用于将文件存储迁移到Amazon S3，支持NFS协议。 可以使用Amazon S3 Lifecycle策略将数据迁移到成本更低的存储类别。 正确原因：File Gateway是处理NFS文件存储的最佳选择，同时支持成本优化。
explanations.C: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy. Amazon EFS适合文件存储，但Standard-IA存储类别的成本较高，目不支持直接迁移NFS数据。 激活生命周期策略可以优化成本，但仍然不如File Gateway直接迁移到S3的成本效益高。 错误原因：成本效益不如File Gateway，目不支持直接迁移NFS数据。
explanations.D: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy. One Zone-IA存储类别成本较低，但与选项C类似，EFS不支持直接迁移NFS数据。 虽然可以激活生命周期策略，但仍然不如File Gateway直接迁移到S3的成本效益高。 错误原因：成本效益不如File Gateway，目不支持直接迁移NFS数据。

question: Topic 1 A company uses high concurrency AWS Lambda functions to process a constantly increasing number of messages in a message queue during marketing events. The Lambda functions use CPU intensive code to process the messages. The company wants to reduce the compute costs and to maintain service latency for its customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure reserved concurrency forthe Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions.
options.B: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.
options.C: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions.
options.D: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations. AA Lambda

explanations.A: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions. 错误：Reserved Concurrency仅限制Lambda函数的最大并发数，但无法保证函数的启动时间（冷启动问题）。 错误：减少内存分配可能会降低CPU性能，导致处理时间增加，从而影响服务延迟。
explanations.B: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations. 错误：虽然增加内存可以提高性能，但Reserved Concurrency无法解决冷启动问题，因此无法保证服务延迟在高并发场景下的稳定 性。
explanations.C: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions. 部分正确：Provisioned Concurrency可以解决冷启动问题，保证服务延迟稳定性。 错误：减少内存分配可能会降低CPU性能，导致处理时间增加，从而影响服务延迟和成本优化。
explanations.D: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations. 正确：Provisioned Concurrency可以解决冷启动问题，保证服务延迟稳定性。 正确：根据AWS Compute Optimizer的建议增加内存可以提高CPU性能，从而减少处理时间，优化成本和性能。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its workloads on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The container images that the ECS task definition uses need to be scanned for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs). New container images that are created also need to be scanned. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the workloads?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository to store the container images. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR basic scan. {FA Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)
options.B: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to scan the images. Use an S3 Event Notification to initiate a Macie scan for every event with an s3:ObjectCreated:Put event type.
options.C: Deploy the workloads to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR enhanced scan.
options.D: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket that has versioning enabled. Configure an S3 Event Notification for s3:ObjectCreated:* events to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to initiate an Amazon Inspector scan.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository to store the container images. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR basic scan. 正确：Amazon ECR 是 AWS 提供的专用容器镜像存储服务，支持基本扫描功能，可以在镜像推送时自动扫描以检测 CVEs。 最少的工作量：直接使用 ECR 的内置功能，无需额外配置或开发。
explanations.B: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to scan the images. Use an S3 Event Notification to initiate a Macie scan for every event with an s3:ObjectCreated:Put event type. 错误：Amazon Macie 是用于数据分类和敏感数据保护的服务，不适用于扫描容器镜像的漏洞。 不符合需求：无法检测 CVEs。
explanations.C: Deploy the workloads to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR enhanced scan. 错误：虽然 ECR 支持增强扫描，但题目中并未要求迁移到 Amazon EKS，迁移工作量较大。 不符合“最少更改”的要求：迁移到 EKS 会增加复杂性。
explanations.D: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket that has versioning enabled. Configure an S3 Event Notification for s3:ObjectCreated:* events to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to initiate an Amazon Inspector scan. 错误：Amazon Inspector 主要用于扫描 EC2 实例和容器运行时的漏洞，而不是直接扫描存储在 S3 中的容器镜像。 复杂性高：需要额外配置 S3 事件通知和 Lambda 函数。

question: Topic 1 A company uses an AWS Batch job to run its end-of-day sales process. The company needs a serverless solution that will invoke a third-party reporting application when the AWS Batch job is successful. The reporting application has an HTTP API interface that uses username and password authentication. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure the third-party API as an EventBridge API destination with a username and password. Set the API destination as the EventBridge rule target.
options.B: Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. Set the Lambda function as the EventBridge rule target.
options.C: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure an HTTP proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password.
options.D: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure a proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure the third- party API as an EventBridge API destination with a username and password. Set the API destination as the EventBridge rule target. 正确：EventBridge可以直接配置API目标，并支持通过用户名和密码进行身份验证。这种方法是无服务器的，并且直接满足题目要 求。 EventBridge规则可以监听AWS Batch的SUCCEEDED事件，并将事件发送到配置的API目标。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. Set the Lambda function as the EventBridge rule target. 错误：EventBridge Scheduler用于定时任务，而不是监听事件。题目要求监听AWS Batch的SUCCEEDED事件，因此使用Scheduler不 符合要求。 虽然Lambda可以调用第三方API，但这增加了额外的复杂性，不是最优解。
explanations.C: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure an HTTP proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. 错误：AWS Batch无法直接发布事件到API Gateway。需要额外的配置来实现事件的传递。 虽然HTTP代理集成可以调用第三方API，但这种方法需要更多的配置，并且不符合无服务器的最佳实践。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure a proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to invoke the third- party API by using a username and password. 错误：同样，AWS Batch无法直接发布事件到API Gateway。 这种方法增加了额外的复杂性，需要配置API Gateway和Lambda，目不符合题目要求的直接无服务器解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company collects and processes data from a vendor. The vendor stores its data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database in the vendor's own AWS account. The company’s VPC does not have an internet gateway, an AWS Direct Connect connection, or an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. The company needs to access the data that is in the vendor database. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Instruct the vendor to sign up for the AWS Hosted Connection Direct Connect Program. Use VPC peering to connect the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC.
options.B: Configure a client VPN connection between the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. Use VPC peering to connect the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC.
options.C: Instruct the vendor to create a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Place the NLB in front of the Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Use AWS PrivateLink to integrate the company’s VPC and the vendor's VPC.
options.D: Use AWS Transit Gateway to integrate the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. Use VPC peering to connect the company’s VPC and the vendor's VPC.

explanations.A: Instruct the vendor to sign up for the AWS Hosted Connection Direct Connect Program. Use VPC peering to connect the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. 错误原因：Direct Connect是一种物理连接解决方案，与题目中明确指出公司没有Direct Connect连接的条件不符。 此外，VPC Peering无法直接访问Amazon RDS，因为它不支持跨VPC的服务发现。
explanations.B: Configure a client VPN connection between the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. Use VPC peering to connect the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. 错误原因：Client VPN主要用于用户设备连接到VPC，而不是VPC之间的连接。题目要求的是VPC间的连接解决方案。 同样，VPC Peering无法直接访问Amazon RDS。
explanations.C: Instruct the vendor to create a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Place the NLB in front of the Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Use AWS PrivateLink to integrate the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. 正确原因：AWS PrivateLink允许通过接口端点安全地访问跨VPC的服务。通过将NLB放置在RDS前面，供应商可以创建一个服务端 点，供公司通过PrivateLink访问。 PrivateLink是专门设计用于跨VPC和跨账户的服务访问，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use AWS Transit Gateway to integrate the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. Use VPC peering to connect the company’s VPC and the vendor's VPC. 错误原因：AWS Transit Gateway是一种多VPC连接解决方案，但题目中没有提到公司或供应商使用Transit Gateway的需求。 此外，Transit Gateway和VPC Peering的组合并不适合直接访问Amazon RDS。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to set up Amazon Managed Grafana as its visualization tool. The company wants to visualize data from its Amazon RDS database as one data source. The company needs a secure solution that will not expose the data over the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without a VPC. Create a public endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the public endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.
options.B: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in a VPC. Create a private endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the private endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.
options.C: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without a VPCreate an AWS PrivateLink endpoint to establish a connection between Amazon Managed Grafana and Amazon RDS. Set up Amazon RDS as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.
options.D: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in a VPC. Create a public endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the public endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without a VPC. Create a public endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the public endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana. 错误：创建公共端点会将数据暴需在互联网中，不符合题目要求的“不会暴需数据到互联网”的条件。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in a VPC. Create a private endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the private endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana. 正确：在VPC中创建Grafana工作空间，并使用私有端点连接RDS数据库，确保数据不会暴需到互联网，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without a VPC. Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint to establish a connection between Amazon Managed Grafana and Amazon RDS. Set up Amazon RDS as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana. 错误：Amazon Managed Grafana工作空间需要在VPC中才能使用PrivateLink连接RDS数据库。没有VPC的工作空间无法直接使用 PrivateLink。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in a VPC. Create a public endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the public endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana. 错误：虽然Grafana工作空间在VPC中，但使用公共端点会将数据暴需到互联网，不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a data lake on Amazon S3. The data lake ingests data in Apache Parquet format from various data sources. The company uses multiple transformation steps to prepare the ingested data. The steps include filtering of anomalies, normalizing of data to standard date and time values, and generation of aggregates for analyses. The company must store the transformed data in S3 buckets that data analysts access. The company needs a prebuilt solution for data transformation that does not require code. The solution must provide data lineage and data profiling. The company needs to share the data transformation steps with employees throughout the company. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an AWS Glue Studio visual canvas to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using AWS Glue jobs.
options.B: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using EMR Serverless jobs.
options.C: Configure AWS Glue DataBrew to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using DataBrew recipes.
options.D: Create Amazon Athena tables for the data. Write Athena SQL queries to transform the data. Share the Athena SQL queries with employees.

explanations.A: Configure an AWS Glue Studio visual canvas to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using AWS Glue jobs. 正确性分析： AWS Glue Studio 提供可视化甩面来设计 ETL 作业，但它主要用于创建和管理 AWS Glue 作业，而不是专门设计用于 数据谱系和数据分析的无代畡解决方案。 错误原因： AWS Glue Studio 不直接支持数据谱系和数据分析功能，也不提供类似 DataBrew 的“配方”功能来共享转换步骤。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using EMR Serverless jobs. 正确性分析： Amazon EMR Serverless 是一个强大的数据处理工具，适合运行大规模分布式计算任务。 错误原因： EMR Serverless 需要编写代畡或脚本来定义数据转换逻辑，不符合题目要求的“无代畡解决方案”。此外，它不直接支持 数据谱系和数据分析功能。
explanations.C: Configure AWS Glue DataBrew to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using DataBrew recipes. 正确性分析： AWS Glue DataBrew 是一个专门设计用于数据准备的无代畡工具，支持数据转换、数据谱系和数据分析功能。它 的“配方”功能可以答案共享数据转换步骤。 正确原因： DataBrew 完全符合题目要求，包括无代畡解决方案、数据谱系、数据分析以及共享转换步骤的能力。
explanations.D: Create Amazon Athena tables for the data. Write Athena SQL queries to transform the data. Share the Athena SQL queries with employees. 正确性分析： Amazon Athena 是一个交互式查询服务，可以使用 SQL 查询来分析 S3 中的数据。 错误原因： Athena 需要编写 SQL 查询，不符合题目要求的“无代畡解决方案”。此外，它不直接支持数据谱系和数据分析功能。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect runs a web application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances that are in individual target groups behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Users can reach the application through a public website. The solutions architect wants to allow engineers to use a development version of the website to access one specific development EC2 instance to test new features for the application. The solutions architect wants to use an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone to give the engineers access to the development instance. The solution must automatically route to the development instance even if the development instance is replaced. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB that forwards requests for the development website to the target group that contains the development instance.
options.B: Recreate the development instance with a public IP address. Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the public IP address of the development instance.
options.C: Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect requests for the development website to the public IP address of the development instance.
options.D: Place all the instances in the same target group. Create an A Record for the development website. Set the value to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB that forwards requests for the development website to the target group.

explanations.A: Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB that forwards requests for the development website to the target group that contains the development instance. 正确：此选项使用Route 53的A记录指向ALB，并通过ALB的畁听器规则将请求路由到特定目标组。目标组可以动态管理实例，即使 开发实例被蔡换，目标组仍然可以自动更新实例人息。 符合题目要求：自动路由到开发实例，即使实例被蔡换。
explanations.B: Recreate the development instance with a public IP address. Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the public IP address of the development instance. 错误：直接使用实例的公共IP地址不符合高可用性要求。如果实例被蔡换，公共IP地址会发生变化，导致DNS记录失效。 不符合题目要求：无法自动路由到新的开发实例。
explanations.C: Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect requests for the development website to the public IP address of the development instance. 错误：虽然使用了ALB，但将请求重定向到实例的公共IP地址仍然存在问题。如果实例被蔡换，公共IP地址会发生变化，导致路由失 败。 不符合题目要求：无法自动路由到新的开发实例。
explanations.D: Place all the instances in the same target group. Create an A Record for the development website. Set the value to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB that forwards requests for the development website to the target group. 错误：将所有实例放在同一个目标组会导致开发实例与生产实例混合，无法单独路由到开发实例。 不符合题目要求：需要单独路由到开发实例。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a container application on a Kubernetes cluster in the company's data center. The application uses Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP) to communicate with a message queue. The data center cannot scale fast enough to meet the company’s expanding business needs. The company wants to migrate the workloads to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages.
options.B: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages.
options.C: Use highly available Amazon EC2 instances to run the application. Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions to run the application. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages.

explanations.A: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages. Amazon ECS 是一种托管的容器服务，适合运行容器化应用，但它不直接支持 Kubernetes 的工作负载迁移。 AMQP 是一种高级消息队列协议，而 Amazon SQS 不支持 AMQP 协议，因此无法满足消息队列的需求。 此选项错误。
explanations.B: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages. Amazon EKS 是托管的 Kubernetes 服务，能够直接支持 Kubernetes 工作负载的迁移。 Amazon MQ 支持 AMQP 协议，能够满足消息队列的需求。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: Use highly available Amazon EC2 instances to run the application. Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages. 使用 Amazon EC2 实例运行应用程序需要手动管理基础设施，增加了运维开销。 虽然 Amazon MQ 支持 AMQP，但此选项的操作开销较高，不符合“最少运维开销”的要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use AWS Lambda functions to run the application. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages. AWS Lambda 是无服务器计算服务，但它不适合运行需要持续运行的容器化应用程序。 Amazon SQS 不支持 AMQP 协议，因此无法满足消息队列的需求。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 An online gaming company hosts its platform on Amazon EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) across multiple AWS Regions. The NLBs can route requests to targets over the internet. The company wants to improve the customer playing experience by reducing end-to-end load time for its global customer base. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region to replace the existing NLBs. Register the existing EC2 instances as targets for the ALBs in each Region.
options.B: Configure Amazon Route 53 to route equally weighted traffic to the NLBs in each Region.
options.C: Create additional NLBs and EC2 instances in other Regions where the company has large customer bases.
options.D: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure the existing NLBs as target endpoints.

explanations.A: Create Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region to replace the existing NLBs. Register the existing EC2 instances as targets for the ALBs in each Region. 错误：虽然ALB可以提供高级的HTTP/HTTPS功能，但它并不能直接减少全球用户的延迟。ALB主要用于应用层负载均衡，而题目要 求优化全球用户的访问体验，ALB无法解决跨区域的网络延迟问题。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon Route 53 to route equally weighted traffic to the NLBs in each Region. 错误：Route 53的流量路由策略可以分配流量到不同区域的NLB，但它无法优化网络路径或减少延迟。Route 53仅负责DNS解析， 无法提供加速功能。
explanations.C: Create additional NLBs and EC2 instances in other Regions where the company has large customer bases. 错误：虽然增加NLB和EC2实例可以扩展容量，但这并不能解决网络延迟问题。跨区域的网络优化需要使用专门的加速服务，而不是 简单地增加资源。
explanations.D: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure the existing NLBs as target endpoints. 正确：AWS Global Accelerator通过使用AWS的全球网络优化流量路径，可以显著减少网络延迟。它会将用户流量路由到最邮的 AWS边缘位置，并通过优化的路径将流量发送到目标区域的NLB。这是解决全球用户访问延迟的最佳方案。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises application that uses SFTP to collect financial data from multiple vendors. The company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company has created an application that uses Amazon S3 APIs to upload files from vendors. Some vendors run their systems on legacy applications that do not support S3 APIs. The vendors want to continue to use SFTP- based applications to upload data. The company wants to use managed services for the needs of the vendors that use legacy applications. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) instance to replicate data from the storage of the vendors that use legacy applications to Amazon S3. Provide the vendors with the credentials to access the AWS DMS instance.
options.B: Create an AWS Transfer Family endpoint for vendors that use legacy applications.
options.C: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance to run an SFTP server. Instruct the vendors that use legacy applications to use the SFTP server to upload data.
options.D: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway for vendors that use legacy applications to upload files to an SMB file share.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) instance to replicate data from the storage of the vendors that use legacy applications to Amazon S3. Provide the vendors with the credentials to access the AWS DMS instance. 错误：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移，而不是文件传输。它不支持SFTP协议，无法满足供应商使用SFTP上传数据的需求。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Transfer Family endpoint for vendors that use legacy applications. 正确：AWS Transfer Family支持SFTP协议，可以直接为供应商提供SFTP端点，满足迈留应用程序的需求。 正确：这是一个完全托管的服务，操作开销最低，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance to run an SFTP server. Instruct the vendors that use legacy applications to use the SFTP server to upload data. 错误：虽然可以通过EC2实例运行SFTP服务器来满足需求，但这需要手动配置和维护，操作开销较高，不符合题目要求的“最小化操 作开销”。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway for vendors that use legacy applications to upload files to an SMB file share. 错误：Amazon S3 File Gateway支持SMB协议，而不是SFTP协议。迈留应用程序无法使用SFTP上传数据到SMB文件共享。

question: Topic 1 A marketing team wants to build a campaign for an upcoming multi-sport event. The team has news reports from the past five years in PDF format. The team needs a solution to extract insights about the content and the sentiment of the news reports. The solution must use Amazon Textract to process the news reports. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Provide the extracted insights to Amazon Athena for analysis. Store the extracted insights and analysis in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Store the extracted insights in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon SageMaker to build a sentiment model.
options.C: Provide the extracted insights to Amazon Comprehend for analysis. Save the analysis to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Store the extracted insights in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize and analyze the data.

explanations.A: 提取的洞察提供给 Amazon Athena 进行分析，存储在 Amazon S3 中。 Amazon Athena适合查询结构化数据，但不直接支持情感分析或内容分类。 此选项未提到如何进行情感分析，无法满足题目要求。 错误原因：缺乏情感分析功能。
explanations.B: 提取的洞察存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，使用 Amazon SageMaker 构建情感模型。 Amazon SageMaker可以构建情感模型，但需要额外的开发和训练工作，增加了操作复杂性。 题目要求“最少的操作开销”，此选项不符合要求。 错误原因：操作开销较高。
explanations.C: 提取的洞察提供给 Amazon Comprehend 进行分析，保存到 Amazon S3 中。 Amazon Comprehend可以直接进行情感分析和内容分类，符合题目要求。 Amazon S3用于存储分析结果，操作开销低。 正确原因：直接满足题目要求，目操作开销最低。
explanations.D: 提取的洞察存储在 Amazon S3 中，使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化和分析数据。 Amazon QuickSight适合数据可视化，但不支持情感分析或内容分类。 此选项未提到如何进行情感分析，无法满足题目要求。 错误原因：缺乏情感分析功能。

question: Topic 1 A company's application runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in multiple Availability Zones. The application needs to ingest real-time data from third-party applications. The company needs a data ingestion solution that places the ingested raw data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon Kinesis data streams for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume the Kinesis data streams. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams.
options.B: Create database migration tasks in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify replication instances of the EC2 instances as the source endpoints. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes. ££ AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)
options.C: Create and configure AWS DataSync agents on the EC2 instances. Configure DataSync tasks to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the application for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume direct PUT operations from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams.

explanations.A: Create Amazon Kinesis data streams for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume the Kinesis data streams. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams. 正确：Amazon Kinesis 数据流是专门设计用于实时数据摄取的服务，能够处理来自第三方应用程序的实时数据。 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 可以直接将数据从 Kinesis 数据流传输到 Amazon S3。 正确：此解决方案完全满足题目要求，能够实时摄取数据并将其存储到 S3。
explanations.B: Create database migration tasks in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify replication instances of the EC2 instances as the source endpoints. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes. 错误：AWS DMS 主要用于数据库迁移，而不是实时数据摄取。题目中没有提到数据库相关内容，因此此选项不适用。
explanations.C: Create and configure AWS DataSync agents on the EC2 instances. Configure DataSync tasks to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket. 错误：AWS DataSync 主要用于批量数据传输，而不是实时数据摄取。题目明确要求实时数据摄取，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the application for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume direct PUT operations from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams. 错误：AWS Direct Connect 是用于建立专线连接的服务，适用于高带宽和低延迟的网络连接，但题目没有提到需要专线连接。 错误：Direct PUT 操作并不是题目中提到的实时数据摄取的最佳解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company’s application is receiving data from multiple data sources. The size of the data varies and is expected to increase over time. The current maximum size is 700 KB. The data volume and data size continue to grow as more data sources are added. The company decides to use Amazon DynamoDB as the primary database for the application. A solutions architect needs to identify a solution that handles the large data sizes. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter the data that exceeds DynamoDB item size limits. Store the larger data in an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) database.
options.B: Store the large data as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In a DynamoDB table, create an item that has an attribute that points to the $3 URL of the data.
options.C: Split all incoming large data into a collection of items that have the same partition key. Write the data to a DynamoDB table in a single operation by using the BatchWriteltem API operation.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses gzip compression to compress the large objects as they are written to a DynamoDB table.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter the data that exceeds DynamoDB item size limits. Store the larger data in an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) database. 错误：虽然DocumentDB可以存储大数据，但此解决方案增加了复杂性，因为需要额外的数据库管理和Lambda函数逻辑。 不够高效：相比使用S3，DocumentDB的成本和操作复杂性更高。
explanations.B: Store the large data as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In a DynamoDB table, create an item that has an attribute that points to the S3 URL of the data. 正确：Amazon S3非常适合存储大数据对象，目成本低、扩展性高。 高效：通过DynamoDB存储指向S3的URL，解决了DynamoDB的大小限制问题，同时保持了数据的可访问性。
explanations.C: Split all incoming large data into a collection of items that have the same partition key. Write the data to a DynamoDB table in a single operation by using the BatchWriteItem API operation. 错误：虽然可以通过拆分数据来绕社DynamoDB的大小限制，但这种方法会导致数据管理复杂性增加。 不够高效：需要额外的逻辑来处理数据拆分和重组。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses gzip compression to compress the large objects as they are written to a DynamoDB table. 错误：即使使用gzip压缩，数据仍可能超过DynamoDB的大小限制。 不够高效：压缩和解压缩增加了额外的计算开销。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating a legacy application from an on-premises data center to AWS. The application relies on hundreds of cron jobs that run between 1 and 20 minutes on different recurring schedules throughout the day. The company wants a solution to schedule and run the cron jobs on AWS with minimal refactoring. The solution must support running the cron jobs in response to an event in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a container image forthe cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks as AWS Lambda functions.
options.B: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use AWS Batch on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with a scheduling policy to run the cron jobs.
options.C: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Create a workflow in AWS Step Functions that uses a Wait state to run the cron jobs at a specified time. Use the RunTask action to run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate.

explanations.A: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks as AWS Lambda functions. 分析： Amazon EventBridge Scheduler确实可以创建周期性计划，适合运行定时任务。 AWS Lambda适合运行短时间任务，但题目提到的cron jobs运行时间可能长通20分钟，可能超出Lambda的最大执行时间限制（15 分钟）。 因此，Lambda不适合运行这些cron jobs。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use AWS Batch on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with a scheduling policy to run the cron jobs. 分析： AWS Batch适合运行批处理任务，但它主要用于处理大规模并行计算任务，而不是简单的定时任务。 题目要求的是运行cron jobs，而不是复杂的批处理任务，因此AWS Batch不是最佳选择。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate. 分析： Amazon EventBridge Scheduler可以答案创建周期性计划，适合运行定时任务。 AWS Fargate是一种无服务器容器运行服务，支持运行长时间任务，适合运行这些cron jobs。 此选项满足题目要求，目支持未来事件触发。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Create a workflow in AWS Step Functions that uses a Wait state to run the cron jobs at a specified time. Use the RunTask action to run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate. 分析： AWS Step Functions适合构建复杂的工作流，但题目并未要求复杂的工作流管理。 使用Wait状态来实现定时任务的运行效率较低，目不如EventBridge Scheduler直接支持定时任务。 虽然可以使用RunTask在AWS Fargate上运行任务，但整体方案复杂度较高，不符合“最小重构”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Salesforce. The company needs to load existing data and ongoing data changes from Salesforce to Amazon Redshift for analysis. The company does not want the data to travel over the public internet. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Establish a VPN connection from the VPC to Salesforce. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to transfer data.
options.B: Establish an AWS Direct Connect connection from the VPC to Salesforce. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to transfer data.
options.C: Create an AWS PrivateLink connection in the VPC to Salesforce. Use Amazon AppFlow to transfer data.
options.D: Create a VPC peering connection to Salesforce. Use Amazon AppFlow to transfer data.

explanations.A: Establish a VPN connection from the VPC to Salesforce. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to transfer data. 错误原因：VPN连接虽然可以提供安全的传输，但它仍然可能通过公共互联网传输数据，无法完全避免数据暴轄。此外，AWS Glue DataBrew是一个数据准备工具，不适合直接用于数据传输。
explanations.B: Establish an AWS Direct Connect connection from the VPC to Salesforce. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to transfer data. 错误原因：AWS Direct Connect提供专线连接，避免了公共互联网，但设置 Direct Connect 需要较高的开发和配置工作量。此外， AWS Glue DataBrew仍然不适合用于数据传输。
explanations.C: Create an AWS PrivateLink connection in the VPC to Salesforce. Use Amazon AppFlow to transfer data. 正确原因：AWS PrivateLink提供私有连接，确保数据不会通过公共互联网。Amazon AppFlow是专门设计用于与 Salesforce 等 SaaS 应用集成的服务，支持数据传输，目开发工作量较低。
explanations.D: Create a VPC peering connection to Salesforce. Use Amazon AppFlow to transfer data. 错误原因：VPC Peering连接仅适用于两个 AWS VPC之间的通人，无法直接连接到外部服务（如 Salesforce）。因此，这种方法不 可行。

question: Topic 1 A company recently migrated its application to AWS. The application runs on Amazon EC2 Linux instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The application stores data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that uses EFS Standard-Infrequent Access storage. The application indexes the company’s files. The index is stored in an Amazon RDS database. The company needs to optimize storage costs with some application and services changes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses an Intelligent-Tiering lifecycle policy. Copy all files to the S3 bucket. Update the application to use Amazon S3 API to store and retrieve files.
options.B: Deploy Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file shares. Update the application to use CIFS protocol to store and retrieve files. 2B Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
options.C: Deploy Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system shares. Update the application to use the new mount point to store and retrieve files. #B Amazon FSx for OpenZFS
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Copy all files to the S3 bucket. Update the application to use Amazon S3 API to store and retrieve files as standard retrievals.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses an Intelligent-Tiering lifecycle policy. Copy all files to the S3 bucket. Update the application to use Amazon S3 API to store and retrieve files. 正确：Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering是一种成本优化的存储选项，能够根据文件访问频率自动调整存储层级，从而降低存储成本。 正确：将文件迁移到S3并使用S3 API进行存储和桌痋是一个高效的解决方案，尤其是对于不频痏访问的文件。 正确：相桻EFS Standard-Infrequent Access，S3 Intelligent-Tiering通常更具成本效益。
explanations.B: Deploy Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file shares. Update the application to use CIFS protocol to store and retrieve files. 错误：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server主要用于Windows栤境中的文件共享，而题目中应用运行在Linux栤境中，因此不适合。 错误：使用CIFS协议可能需要额外的配置和成本，目不一定能优化存储成本。
explanations.C: Deploy Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system shares. Update the application to use the new mount point to store and retrieve files. 错误：Amazon FSx for OpenZFS适用于高性能文件存储场景，但成本可能高于S3 Intelligent-Tiering。 错误：虽然OpenZFS支持Linux，但它并不一定是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Copy all files to the S3 bucket. Update the application to use Amazon S3 API to store and retrieve files as standard retrievals. 错误：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval适用于长期存桂存储，而题目中应用需要频痏存储和桌痋文件，因此不适合。 错误：标准桌痋的成本较高，不符合成本优化的要求。

question: Topic 1 A robotics company is designing a solution for medical surgery. The robots will use advanced sensors, cameras, and Al algorithms to perceive their environment and to complete surgeries. The company needs a public load balancer in the AWS Cloud that will ensure seamless communication with backend services. The load balancer must be capable of routing traffic based on the query strings to different target groups. The traffic must also be encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: 该公司需要在AWS Cloud中设置一个公共负载均衡器，以确保与后端服务的无颖通信。负载均衡器必须能够基于查询字符串将流量 路由到不同的目标组。流量还必须被加密。 哪种解决方案可以满足这些需求? A. Use a Network Load Balancer with a certificate attached from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Use query parameter-based routing.
options.B: Use a Gateway Load Balancer. Import a generated certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach the certificate to the load balancer. Use HTTP path-based routing.
options.C: Use an Application Load Balancer with a certificate attached from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Use query parameter- based routing.
options.D: Use a Network Load Balancer. Import a generated certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach the certificate to the load balancer. Use query parameter-based routing.

explanations.A: Use a Network Load Balancer with a certificate attached from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Use query parameter- based routing. 错误原因：Network Load Balancer (NLB)主要用于处理高性能的TCP/UDP流量，但不支持基于查询参数的路由。基于查询参数的路 由是Application Load Balancer (ALB)的功能。 正确部分：NLB可以使用AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)来管理SSL/TLS证书。
explanations.B: Use a Gateway Load Balancer. Import a generated certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach the certificate to the load balancer. Use HTTP path-based routing. 错误原因：Gateway Load Balancer主要用于网痬流量的透明代理和安全服务，不支持HTTP路径或查询参数的路由功能。 错误部分：导入证书到IAM并附加到负载均衡器不是推荐的做法，AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)是更适合的工具。
explanations.C: Use an Application Load Balancer with a certificate attached from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Use query parameter-based routing. 正确原因：Application Load Balancer (ALB)支持基于查询参数的高级路由功能，并且可以通过AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)附加 SSL/TLS证书来实现加密通人。 正确部分：此选项完全符合题目要求，包括路由功能和加密通人。
explanations.D: Use a Network Load Balancer. Import a generated certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach the certificate to the load balancer. Use query parameter-based routing. 错误原因：Network Load Balancer不支持基于查询参数的路由功能，这属于Application Load Balancer的功能。 错误部分：导入证书到IAM并附加到负载均衡器不是推荐的做法，AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)是更适合的工具。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application uses a MySQL database that runs on the same EC2 instance. The company needs a highly available and automatically scalable solution to handle increased traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon Redshift cluster that has multiple MySQL-compatible nodes.
options.B: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that are configured as a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL cluster that has multiple instances.
options.C: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL cluster for the database layer.
options.D: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that are configured as a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that uses the MySQL connector.

explanations.A: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon Redshift cluster that has multiple MySQL-compatible nodes. 正确性分析：Amazon Redshift是一个数据仓库解决方案，主要用于分析型工作负载，而不是用于运行事务型数据库（如 MySQL）。因此，这个选项不适合解决问题。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that are configured as a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL cluster that has multiple instances. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS for MySQL可以提供高可用性，但它的扩展能力有限，无法像Amazon Aurora Serverless那样自动扩展以 应对流量棦增。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL cluster for the database layer. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora Serverless支持自动扩展，能够根据流量需求动态调整数据库容量，同时与Auto Scaling组和 Application Load Balancer的组合可以实现高可用性和自动扩展。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that are configured as a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that uses the MySQL connector. 正确性分析：Amazon ElastiCache for Redis是一个内存缓存解决方案，适用于加速数据访问，但它不能蔡代MySQL数据库的功能。 因此，这个选项不符合要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to migrate data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted at rest within the S3 bucket. The encryption key must be rotated automatically every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the $3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the $3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year.
options.D: Use customer key material to encrypt the data. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation.

explanations.A: Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys. 分析： SSE-S3 提供服务器端加密，目 Amazon S3 托管密钥的加密行为是自动的。 然而，SSE-S3 不支持用户控制的密钥轮换。虽然密钥会定期轮换，但无法满足“每年自动轮换”的具体要求。 因此，该选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. 分析： 使用 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥可以完全控制加密密钥的生命周期。 启用自动密钥轮换功能后，KMS 会每年自动轮换密钥，满足题目要求。 将 S3 存储橘的默正加密行为设置为使用客户托管的 KMS 密钥，确保所有数据在迁移后自动加密。 此选项符合题目要求，并且操作开销最少。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year. 分析： 手动轮换密钥增加了操作开销，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。 虽然可以满足加密和轮换要求，但手动操作显然不是最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: Use customer key material to encrypt the data. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation. 分析： 导入客户密钥材料后，AWS KMS 无法对导入的密钥材料执行自动轮换。 此选项无法满足“自动密钥轮换”的要求。 此外，导入密钥材料增加了复杂性和操作开销，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating applications from an on-premises Microsoft Active Directory that the company manages to AWS. The company deploys the applications in multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage the accounts centrally. The company's security team needs a single sign-on solution across all the company's AWS accounts. The company must continue to manage users and groups that are in the on-premises Active Directory. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Enterprise Edition Active Directory in AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory. Configure the Active Directory to be the identity source for AWS IAM Identity Center.
options.B: Enable AWS IAM Identity Center. Configure a two-way forest trust relationship to connect the company's self-managed Active Directory with IAM Identity Center by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.
options.C: Use AWS Directory Service and create a two-way trust relationship with the company's self-managed Active Directory.
options.D: Deploy an identity provider (ldP) on Amazon EC2. Link the IdP as an identity source within AWS IAM Identity Center.

explanations.A: Create an Enterprise Edition Active Directory in AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory. Configure the Active Directory to be the identity source for AWS IAM Identity Center. 错误：此选项建议在 AWS 中创建一个新的 Active Directory，但题目要求继续使用现有的 on-premises Active Directory。 此选项没有解决如何与现有的 Active Directory 集成的问题。
explanations.B: Enable AWS IAM Identity Center. Configure a two-way forest trust relationship to connect the company's self-managed Active Directory with IAM Identity Center by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory. 正确：此选项直接解决了题目要求，即通过双向森林人任关系将现有的 on-premises Active Directory 与 AWS IAM Identity Center 集成。 这种方法允许继续使用现有的用户和组，同时实现跨账户的单点登录。
explanations.C: Use AWS Directory Service and create a two-way trust relationship with the company's self-managed Active Directory. 错误：虽然提到了双向人任关系，但没有提到如何与 AWS IAM Identity Center 集成。 此选项缺乏对单点登录解决方案的具体说明。
explanations.D: Deploy an identity provider (IdP) on Amazon EC2. Link the IdP as an identity source within AWS IAM Identity Center. 错误：此选项建议在 EC2 上部署一个新的 IdP，但题目要求继续使用现有的 on-premises Active Directory。 此方法增加了复杂性，并不符合题目要求的最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to deploy its application on an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster. The application will receive large amounts of traffic. The company wants to optimize the storage performance of the cluster as the load on the application increases. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the cluster to use the Aurora Standard storage configuration.
options.B: Configure the cluster storage type as Provisioned IOPS.
options.C: Configure the cluster storage type as General Purpose.
options.D: Configure the cluster to use the Aurora MO-Optimized storage configuration.

explanations.A: Configure the cluster to use the Aurora Standard storage configuration. 错误：Aurora Standard 是默正的存储配置，但它在高负载情况下可能无法提供最佳性能。 虽然成本较低，但不适合需要高性能存储的场景。
explanations.B: Configure the cluster storage type as Provisioned IOPS. 错误：Provisioned IOPS 提供了高性能存储，但成本较高，不是最具成本效益的解决方案。 适用于需要极高 IOPS 的场景，但 Aurora Serverless v2 通常不需要这种配置。
explanations.C: Configure the cluster storage type as General Purpose. 错误：General Purpose 存储类型适合中等性能需求，但在高负载情况下可能无法满足性能要求。 成本较低，但性能不如 Aurora I/O-Optimized。
explanations.D: Configure the cluster to use the Aurora I/O-Optimized storage configuration. 正确：Aurora I/O-Optimized 是专门设计用于高性能和高负载场景的存储配置。 它消除了 I/O 请求成本，同时提供了更高的性能，是最具成本效益的解决方案。

explanations.A: Designate one account as the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator account... Amazon Inspector主要用于自动化的安全评估和漏洞扫描，但它并不直接提供对行业标准（如NIST和PCI DSS）的合规性监控。 虽然Inspector可以发现和扫描资源，但它的功能不完全覆盖合规性验证的需求，因此此选项不符合题目要求。 错误原因：Inspector的功能与题目要求的合规性监控不完全匹配。
