question: Topic 1 A company uses an Amazon S3 bucket as its data lake storage platform. The S3 bucket contains a massive amount of data that is accessed randomly by multiple teams and hundreds of applications. The company wants to reduce the S3 storage costs and provide immediate availability for frequently accessed objects. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition objects to the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class.
options.B: Store objects in Amazon S3 Glacier. Use 93 Select to provide applications with access to the data.
options.C: Use data from S3 storage class analysis to create S3 Lifecycle rules to automatically transition objects to the S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class.
options.D: Transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an AWS Lambda function to transition objects to the S3 Standard storage class when they are accessed by an application.

explanations.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition objects to the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. 正确：S3 Intelligent-Tiering是一个自动优化存储成本的存储类别，能够根据对象的访问模式动态调整存储层级，无需手动干预。 它支持频痏访问和不频痏访问的对象，并且提供即时可用性，非常适合随机访问场景。
explanations.B: Store objects in Amazon S3 Glacier. Use S3 Select to provide applications with access to the data. 错误：S3 Glacier主要用于长期存桂存储，访问延迟较高，不适合需要即时可用性的场景。 S3 Select无法直接提供对数据的即时访问，目操作复杂，无法满足题目要求的高效性。
explanations.C: Use data from S3 storage class analysis to create S3 Lifecycle rules to automatically transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. 错误：S3 Standard-IA适合不频痏访问的对象，但对于频痏访问的对象会产椹额外的访问成本。 需要手动分析存储类别数据并创建规则，操作效率较低，不符合题目要求的“最具操作效率”的解决方案。
explanations.D: Transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an AWS Lambda function to transition objects to the S3 Standard storage class when they are accessed by an application. 错误：这种方法需要额外的AWS Lambda函数来畁控和管理对象的存储类别，增加了操作复杂性。 无法自动优化存储成本，目频痏访问的对象会产椹额外的访问成本。

question: Topic 1 A company has 5 TB of datasets. The datasets consist of 1 million user profiles and 10 million connections. The user profiles have connections as many-to-many relationships. The company needs a performance efficient way to find mutual connections up to five levels. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the datasets. Use Amazon Athena to perform SQL JOIN queries to find connections.
options.B: Use Amazon Neptune to store the datasets with edges and vertices. Query the data to find connections.
options.C: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the datasets. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize connections.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS to store the datasets with multiple tables. Perform SQL JOIN queries to find connections.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon S3和Amazon Athena Amazon S3是对象存储服务，适合存储静态数据，但不适合处理复杂的关系查询。 Amazon Athena是交互式查询服务，适合对结构化数据进行SQL查询，但对于多层关系查询（如图形数据的五层连接），性能效率 较低。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon Neptune Amazon Neptune是专门设计的图形数据库，支持图形数据的存储和查询。 它能够高效处理复杂的图形查询，例如多层关系（五层连接）。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon S3和Amazon QuickSight Amazon QuickSight是数据可视化服务，适合展示数据，但不适合执行复杂的关系查询。 此选项错误，因为它无法满足性能高效查询五层连接的需求。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon RDS Amazon RDS是关系型数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据并执行SQL查询。 虽然可以通过SQL JOIN查询实现多层关系，但性能效率较低，尤其是处理图形数据时。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company needs a secure connection between its on-premises environment and AWS. This connection does not need high bandwidth and will handle a small amount of traffic. The connection should be set up quickly. What is the MOST cost-effective method to establish this type of connection?

options.A: Implement a client VPN.
options.B: Implement AWS Direct Connect.
options.C: Implement a bastion host on Amazon EC2.

explanations.A: Implement a client VPN. 错误。Client VPN主要用于用户设备与AWS资源之间的安全连接，适合远程用户访问，而不是用于连接整个本地环境与AWS。它不 符合题目要求的“连接本地环境与AWS”的场景。
explanations.B: Implement AWS Direct Connect. 错误。AWS Direct Connect提供专用的高带宽连接，适合需要稳定、高速连接的场景，但设置时间较长目成本较高，不符合题目要 求的“快速设置”和“低成本”的需求。
explanations.C: Implement a bastion host on Amazon EC2. 错误。Bastion Host用于安全地管理EC2实例的访问，而不是用于连接本地环境与AWS。它不适合题目要求的场景。
explanations.D: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. 正确。AWS Site-to-Site VPN连接可以快速设置，成本较低，适合处理小流量的场景，并且能够安全地连接本地环境与AWS资源。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises SFTP file transfer solution. The company is migrating to the AWS Cloud to scale the file transfer solution and to optimize costs by using Amazon S3. The company's employees will use their credentials for the on-premises Microsoft Active Directory (AD) to access the new solution. The company wants to keep the current authentication and file access mechanisms. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an S3 File Gateway. Create SMB file shares on the file gateway that use the existing Active Directory to authenticate.
options.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group with Amazon EC2 instances to run an SFTP solution. Configure the group to scale up at 60% CPU utilization.
options.C: Create an AWS Transfer Family server with SFTP endpoints. Choose the AWS Directory Service option as the identity provider. Use AD Connector to connect the on-premises Active Directory.
options.D: Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoint. Configure the endpoint to use the AWS Directory Service option as the identity provider to connect to the existing Active Directory.

explanations.A: 配置一个S3 File Gateway。在文件网关上创建使用现有Active Directory进行身份验证的SMB文件共享。 分析： S3 File Gateway主要用于将本地文件系统与Amazon S3集成，但它不支持SFTP协议。 题目要求使用SFTP进行文件传输，而不是SMB文件共享。 此选项不符合题目要求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.B: 配置一个带有Amazon EC2实例的Auto Scaling组以运行SFTP解决方案。将该组配置为在CPU利用率通到60%时扩展。 分析： 使用EC2实例运行SFTP解决方案需要自行管理服务器，包括安装、配置和维护SFTP服务。 此选项增加了运维开销，不符合“最少运维开销”的要求。 虽然可以实现SFTP功能，但不是最佳解决方案。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: 创建一个带有SFTP端点的AWS Transfer Family服务器。选择AWS Directory Service选项作为身份提供者。使用AD Connector 连接到本地Active Directory。 分析： AWS Transfer Family支持SFTP协议，并且可以直接与AWS Directory Service集成。 使用AD Connector可以将AWS与本地Active Directory连接，满足题目要求的身份验证机制。 此选项完全符合题目要求，并且运维开销较低。 结论： 正确。
explanations.D: 创建一个AWS Transfer Family SFTP端点。将端点配置为使用AWS Directory Service选项作为身份提供者以连接到现有Active Directory。 分析： 此选项与C非常相似，但没有明确提到使用AD Connector连接到本地Active Directory。 如果没有AD Connector，AWS Directory Service无法直接与本地Active Directory集成。 此选项缺少关輄步骤，无法满足题目要求。 结论： 错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing an event-driven order processing system. Each order requires multiple validation steps after the order is created. An idempotent AWS Lambda function performs each validation step. Each validation step is independent from the other validation steps. Individual validation steps need only a subset of the order event information. The company wants to ensure that each validation step Lambda function has access to only the information from the order event that the function requires. The components of the order processing system should be loosely coupled to accommodate future business changes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for each validation step. Create a new Lambda function to transform the order data to the format that each validation step requires and to publish the messages to the appropriate SQS queues. Subscribe each validation step Lambda function to its corresponding SQS queue.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the validation step Lambda functions to the SNS topic. Use message body filtering to send only the required data to each subscribed Lambda function.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge event bus. Create an event rule for each validation step. Configure the input transformer to send only the required data to each target validation step Lambda function.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create a new Lambda function to subscribe to the SQS queue and to transform the order data to the format that each validation step requires. Use the new Lambda function to perform synchronous invocations of the validation step Lambda functions in parallel on separate threads. IT

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for each validation step... 分析： 优点：SQS可以实现消嬟队列的解兢，目桹个队列可以栘立处理不同的验证桯骤。 缺点：需要额外创建一个Lambda函数来转换数据格式并发害消嬟到队列，增加了复杂性。 缺点：SQS不支持直接的消嬟过滤功能，无法证保桹个Lambda函数只接收到所需的数据。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求的“确保桹个验证桯骤Lambda函数只接收所需数据”的条件。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic... 分析： 优点：SNS支持消嬟寋播，可以将消嬟发送到多个订輗者。 优点：SNS支持消嬟过滤，可以根据消嬟内容发送特定数据到订輗者。 缺点：SNS的消嬟过滤功能较为有限，可能无法完全满足复杂的输入转换需求。 缺点：SNS的设计更适合寋播场景，而非事件驱动的精确数据传辻。 结论：此选项部分满足要求，但不如EventBridge棬梮。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge event bus... 分析： 优点：EventBridge支持事件驱动架构，可以根据规则路由事件到不同的目标。 优点：EventBridge的输入转换器可以精确地过滤和转换数据，确保桹个Lambda函数只接收到所需的数据。 优点：EventBridge设计为案兢合系统，易于扩展以适应未来业务变化。 结论：此选项完全符合题目要求，是最佳选择。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue... 分析： 优点：SQS可以实现消嬟队列的解兢。 缺点：需要额外创建一个Lambda函数来转换数据格式并同桯调用其他Lambda函数，增加了复杂性。 缺点：同桯调用的方式不符合事件驱动架构的设计原则，目可能导致性能瓶轛。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求的“案兢合设计”和“事件驱动架构”原则。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating a three-tier application to AWS. The application requires a MySQL database. In the past, the application users reported poor application performance when creating new entries. These performance issues were caused by users generating different real-time reports from the application during working hours. Which solution will improve the performance of the application when it is moved to AWS?

options.A: Import the data into an Amazon DynamoDB table with provisioned capacity. Refactor the application to use DynamoDB for reports.
options.B: Create the database on a compute optimized Amazon EC2 instance. Ensure compute resources exceed the on-premises database.
options.C: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster with multiple read replicas. Configure the application to use the reader endpoint for reports.
options.D: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster. Configure the application to use the backup instance of the cluster as an endpoint for the reports.

explanations.A: Import the data into an Amazon DynamoDB table with provisioned capacity. Refactor the application to use DynamoDB for reports. 错误原因：虽然DynamoDB是一个高性能的NoSQL数据库，但题目明确要求使用MySQL数据库，而不是NoSQL数据库。将数据迁移 到DynamoDB并重构应用程序会增加开发成本，并且不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Create the database on a compute optimized Amazon EC2 instance. Ensure compute resources exceed the on-premises database. 错误原因：虽然使用计算优化型EC2实例可以提高性能，但这种方法痾乏数据库的高可用性和读写分畹功能。题目提到性能问题主 要是由于报告生成导致的读操作压力，这种方案无法有效解决问题。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster with multiple read replicas. Configure the application to use the reader endpoint for reports. 正确原因：Amazon Aurora支持Multi-AZ架构和读副本，可以通过读写分畹来提高性能。将报告生成的读操作定向到读副本 （reader endpoint）可以有效减答主数据库的压力，从而解决性能问题。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster. Configure the application to use the backup instance of the cluster as an endpoint for the reports. 错误原因：Multi-AZ的备份实例是用于故障转移的，不适合用于处理读操作。备份实例不能作为读端点使用，因此此选项不正确。

question: Topic 1 A company is expanding a secure on-premises network to the AWS Cloud by using an AWS Direct Connect connection. The on- premises network has no direct internet access. An application that runs on the on-premises network needs to use an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a public virtual interface (VIF). Route the AWS traffic over the public VIF.
options.B: Create a VPC and a NAT gateway. Route the AWS traffic from the on-premises network to the NAT gateway.
options.C: Create a VPC and an Amazon S3 interface endpoint. Route the AWS traffic from the on-premises network to the S3 interface endpoint.
options.D: Create a VPC peering connection between the on-premises network and Direct Connect. Route the AWS traffic over the peering connection.

explanations.A: Create a public virtual interface (VIF). Route the AWS traffic over the public VIF. 错误：公共虚拟接口（Public VIF）允许通过Direct Connect访问公共AWS服务（如S3），但这需要启用互联网路由，而题目明确指 出“本地网络没有直接的互联网访问”。 此外，公共VIF的流量不够安全，可能不符合题目中“安全”的要求。
explanations.B: Create a VPC and a NAT gateway. Route the AWS traffic from the on-premises network to the NAT gateway. 错误：NAT网关用于将私有网络流量路由到互联网，但题目明确指出本地网络没有直接的互联网访问。 使用NAT网关会增加额外的成本（NAT网关的使用费用），不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.C: Create a VPC and an Amazon S3 interface endpoint. Route the AWS traffic from the on-premises network to the S3 interface endpoint. 正确：Amazon S3接口端点（Interface Endpoint）允许通过私有网络直接访问S3，而无需通过互联网。 这种方法符合题目中“安全”和“最具成本效益”的要求，因为接口端点流量是通过AWS私有网络传输的，目没有额外的NAT网关费用。
explanations.D: Create a VPC peering connection between the on-premises network and Direct Connect. Route the AWS traffic over the peering connection. 错误：VPC对等连接（VPC Peering）用于连接两个VPC，而不是用于连接本地网络和AWS资源。 Direct Connect本身已经提供了连接本地网络和AWS的功能，因此不需要额外的VPC对等连接。

question: Topic 1 A company serves its website by using an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The website does not require a database. The company is expanding, and the company's engineering team deploys the website to a second Region. The company wants to distribute traffic across both Regions to accommodate growth and for disaster recovery purposes. The solution should not serve traffic from a Region in which the website is unhealthy. Which policy or resource should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: An Amazon Route 53 simple routing policy 分析:
options.B: An Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy 分析:
options.C: An Application Load Balancer in one Region with a target group that specifies the EC2 instance IDs from both Regions 分析: Application Load Balancer
options.D: An Application Load Balancer in one Region with a target group that specifies the IP addresses of the EC2 instances from both Regions 分析: 虽然可以通过IP地址指定跨区域的目标，但Application Load Balancer仍然无法跨区域工作。此外，这种配置复杂上不支持健 康检查功能。 结论: 错误。 3.

explanations.A: An Amazon Route 53 simple routing policy 分析：简单路由策略无法实现跨区域流量分配，也不支持健康检查功能。因此无法满足题目中“分配流量”和“健康检查”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: An Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy 分析：多值答案路由策略支持跨区域流量分配，并且可以结合健康检查功能，确保流量不会被分配到不健康的区域。这完全符合题 目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: An Application Load Balancer in one Region with a target group that specifies the EC2 instance IDs from both Regions 分析：Application Load Balancer无法跨区域工作。它只能在单个区域内分配流量，因此无法满足题目中跨区域流量分配的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: An Application Load Balancer in one Region with a target group that specifies the IP addresses of the EC2 instances from both Regions 分析：虽然可以通过IP地址指定跨区域的目标，但Application Load Balancer仍然无法跨区域工作。此外，这种配置复杂目不支持健 康检查功能。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its applications on Amazon EC2 instances that are backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). The EC2 instances run the most recent Amazon Linux release. The applications are experiencing availability issues when the company's employees store and retrieve files that are 25 GB or larger. The company needs a solution that does not require the company to transfer files between EC2 instances. The files must be available across many EC2 instances and across multiple Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate all the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. Instruct the employees to access the files from the S3 bucket.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the existing EBS volume. Mount the snapshot as an EBS volume across the EC2 instances. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances.
options.C: Mount an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system across all the EC2 instances. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instances. Configure new EC2 instances from the AMI that use an instance store volume. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Migrate all the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. Instruct the employees to access the files from the S3 bucket. 正确性分析：Amazon S3 是一个对象存储服务，适合存储和检索文件，但它不支持文件系统的挂载，无法直接在 EC2 实例上作为共 享文件系统使用。 错误原因：题目要求文件必轔可跨多个 EC2 实例和多个可用区共享，而 S3 不支持文件系统挂载，无法满足这一需求。
explanations.B: Take a snapshot of the existing EBS volume. Mount the snapshot as an EBS volume across the EC2 instances. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：EBS 是块存储服务，支持单个 EC2 实例挂载，但不支持跨多个实例共享。 错误原因：题目要求文件必轔可跨多个 EC2 实例共享，而 EBS 卷无法同时挂载到多个实例。
explanations.C: Mount an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system across all the EC2 instances. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：Amazon EFS 是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，支持跨多个 EC2 实例和多个可用区共享文件系统。 正确原因：EFS 满足题目要求的所有条件，包括跨多个实例和多个可用区共享文件存储。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instances. Configure new EC2 instances from the AMI that use an instance store volume. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：实例存储是临时存储，数据会在实例停止或终止时丢失。 错误原因：题目要求文件必轔可跨多个 EC2 实例和多个可用区共享，而实例存储无法满足这一需求。

question: Topic 1 A company is running a highly sensitive application on Amazon EC2 backed by an Amazon RDS database. Compliance regulations mandate that all personally identifiable information (PII) be encrypted at rest. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of changes to the infrastructure?

options.A: Deploy AWS Certificate Manager to generate certificates. Use the certificates to encrypt the database volume.
options.B: Deploy AWS CloudHSM, generate encryption keys, and use the keys to encrypt database volumes. BBS AWS CloudHSM，
options.C: Configure SSL encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt database volumes.
options.D: Configure Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) encryption and Amazon RDS encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt instance and database volumes.

explanations.A: Deploy AWS Certificate Manager to generate certificates. Use the certificates to encrypt the database volume. 错误：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 用于管理 SSL/TLS 证书，主要用于加密网痬通人，而不是用于加密存储数据（如数据库 卷）。 不符合题目要求的“加密数据存储”的需求。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS CloudHSM, generate encryption keys, and use the keys to encrypt database volumes. 错误：AWS CloudHSM 是一种畦件安全模块，用于生成和管理加密密迫，但直接使用 CloudHSM 来加密 RDS 数据库卷需要额外的 复杂配置。 此选项增加了基略设施的复杂性，不符合题目要求的“最少更改”。
explanations.C: Configure SSL encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt database volumes. 错误：SSL 加密用于保护数据在传输中的安全性，而不是用于加密数据存储（如数据库卷）。 此选项混淆了传输加密和存储加密的概念，不符合题目要求的“加密数据存储”。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) encryption and Amazon RDS encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt instance and database volumes. 正确：Amazon RDS 支持使用 AWS KMS 密迫进行加密，确保数据库存储的数据在静态时被加密。 Amazon EBS 也支持使用 AWS KMS 密迫进行加密，确保 EC2 实例的存储卷数据在静态时被加密。 此选项直接满足题目要求，并且对现有基略设施的更改最少。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an AWS Lambda function in private subnets in a VPC. The subnets have a default route to the internet through an Amazon EC2 NAT instance. The Lambda function processes input data and saves its output as an object to Amazon S3. Intermittently, the Lambda function times out while trying to upload the object because of saturated traffic on the NAT instance's network. The company wants to access Amazon S3 without traversing the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Replace the EC2 NAT instance with an AWS managed NAT gateway.
options.B: Increase the size of the EC2 NAT instance in the VPC to a network optimized instance type.
options.C: Provision a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPUpdate the route tables of the subnets accordingly.
options.D: Provision a transit gateway. Place transit gateway attachments in the private subnets where the Lambda function is running.

explanations.A: Replace the EC2 NAT instance with an AWS managed NAT gateway. 分析：AWS托管的NAT网关确实可以提供更高的性能和可扩展性，解决网络拥塞问题。但此选项仍然需要通过互联网访问Amazon S3，无法满足“避免通过互联网访问”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Increase the size of the EC2 NAT instance in the VPC to a network optimized instance type. 分析：升级EC2 NAT实例可以缓解网络拥塞问题，但仍然需要通过互联网访问Amazon S3，无法满足“避免通过互联网访问”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Provision a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. Update the route tables of the subnets accordingly. 分析：通过为Amazon S3配置网关终端节点，流量可以直接通过AWS网络而不是互联网访问S3。这是最佳解决方案，完全满足题目 要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Provision a transit gateway. Place transit gateway attachments in the private subnets where the Lambda function is running. 分析：Transit Gateway主要用于连接多个VPC或本地网络，与题目要求的“避免通过互联网访问Amazon S3”无关。此选项不适合解决 问题。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A news company that has reporters all over the world is hosting its broadcast system on AWS. The reporters send live broadcasts to the broadcast system. The reporters use software on their phones to send live streams through the Real Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP). A solutions architect must design a solution that gives the reporters the ability to send the highest quality streams. The solution must provide accelerated TCP connections back to the broadcast system. What should the solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon CloudFront
options.B: AWS Global Accelerator ER AWS Global Accelerator
options.C: AWS Client VPN
options.D: Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Elastic IP addresses Amazon EC2 instances 和 AWS Elastic IP addresses

explanations.A: Amazon CloudFront CloudFront是一个内容分发网络（CDN）服务，主要用于缓存和分发静态和动态内容。虽然它可以优化内容交付，但它不支持 RTMP协议，也不提供加速TCP连接的功能。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: AWS Global Accelerator AWS Global Accelerator是一个网络加速服务，可以通过使用AWS全球网络优化TCP和UDP流量的传输速度。它非常适合实时应用场 景，如直播流媒体。因此此选项正确。
explanations.C: AWS Client VPN AWS Client VPN是一个安全的辧程访问解决方案，主要用于连接到AWS资源的加密VPN连接。它不适用于优化实时流媒体的TCP连 接。因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Amazon EC2 instances和AWS Elastic IP addresses EC2实例和Elastic IP地址可以提供固定的IP地址和计算资源，但它们本身不提供任何网络加速功能，也无法优化全球范围内的TCP连 接。因此此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) to run its self-managed database. The company has 350 TB of data spread across all EBS volumes. The company takes daily EBS snapshots and keeps the snapshots for 1 month. The daily change rate is 5% of the EBS volumes. Because of new regulations, the company needs to keep the monthly snapshots for 7 years. The company needs to change its backup strategy to comply with the new regulations and to ensure that data is available with minimal administrative effort. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier for 1 month. Copy the monthly snapshot to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive with a 7-year retention period.
options.B: Continue with the current EBS snapshot policy. Add a new policy to move the monthly snapshot to Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive with a 7-year retention period.
options.C: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier for 1 month. Keep the monthly snapshot in the standard tier for 7 years. Use incremental snapshots.
options.D: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier. Use EBS direct APIs to take snapshots of all the EBS volumes every month. Store the snapshots in an Amazon S3 bucket in the Infrequent Access tier for 7 years.

explanations.A: 将每日快照保留在 EBS 快照标准层中 1 个月。将每月快照复制到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive，并设置 7 年的保留期。 正确性分析：Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive是一个极低成本的长期存储选项，但EBS快照无法直接复制到S3 Glacier Deep Archive。需要使用额外的工具或流程（如导出到S3），这增加了复杂性和管理成本。 结论：此选项不符合“最小化管理工作量”的要求。
explanations.B: 继续使用当前的 EBS 快照策略。添加一个新策略，将每月快照移动到 Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive，并设置 7 年的保留 期。 正确性分析：Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive是专门为长期存储EBS快照设计的低成本选项。此选项直接利用EBS的归档功能，符合 成本优化和管理简化的要求。 结论：此选项是正确的。
explanations.C: 将每日快照保留在 EBS 快照标准层中 1 个月。将每月快照保留在标准层中 7 年。使用增量快照。 正确性分析：虽然增量快照可以减少存储成本，但将快照保留在标准层7年会导致高昂的存储费用，不符合“成本优化”的要求。 结论：此选项不符合成本效益要求。
explanations.D: 将每日快照保留在 EBS 快照标准层中。使用 EBS direct APIs 每月对所有 EBS 卷进行快照。将快照存储在 Amazon S3 存储橘的 Infrequent Access 层中 7 年。 正确性分析：EBS快照无法直接存储到S3，需要导出到S3，这增加了管理复杂性。此外，S3 Infrequent Access层的成本可能高于 EBS Snapshots Archive。 结论：此选项不符合“最小化管理工作量”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application on several Amazon EC2 instances that store persistent data on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. The company needs to replicate the data to another AWS Region by using an AWS managed service solution. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the EFS-to-EFS backup solution to replicate the data to an EFS file system in another Region.
options.B: Run a nightly script to copy data from the EFS file system to an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable S3 Cross-Region Replication on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create a VPC in another Region. Establish a cross-Region VPC peer. Run a nightly rsync to copy data from the original Region to the new Region.
options.D: Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan with a rule that takes a daily backup and replicates it to another Region. Assign the EFS file system resource to the backup plan.

explanations.A: 使用 EFS-to-EFS 备份解决方案将数据复制到另一个区域的 EFS 文件系统。 错误：EFS-to-EFS 备份解决方案并不是 AWS 官方提供的服务，而是需要用户自己实现的解决方案。这种方法可能需要额外的开发 和维护成本。 此外，EFS-to-EFS复制可能涉及复杂的配置，目不如 AWS Backup 的跨区域复制功能直接和经济高效。
explanations.B: 运行一个夜间脚本，将数据从 EFS 文件系统复制到 Amazon S3 存储橘。在 S3 存储橘上启用 S3 跨区域复制。 错误：虽然 S3 支持跨区域复制，但此解决方案需要额外的脚本开发和维护工作。 将数据从 EFS 复制到 S3 会增加存储和传输成本，并且不直接满足题目要求的“使用 AWS 管理服务解决方案”。
explanations.C: 在另一个区域创建一个 VPC。建立跨区域 VPC 对等连接。运行一个夜间 rsync，将数据从原始区域复制到新区域。 错误：此解决方案需要手动配置 VPC 对等连接和 rsync 脚本，增加了复杂性和维护成本。 rsync 的性能可能受网络延迟影响，目不如 AWS Backup 的解决方案高效。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份计划，其中包含一个每天备份并将其复制到另一个区域的规则。将 EFS 文件系统资源分配给备 份计划。 正确：AWS Backup 是一个完全托管的服务，支持跨区域备份和复制，目与 EFS 集成。 此解决方案最符合题目要求，既使用了 AWS 管理服务，又是最经济高效的选择。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company is migrating its on-premises workload to the AWS Cloud. The workload currently consists of a web application and a backend Microsoft SQL database for storage. The company expects a high volume of customers during a promotional event. The new infrastructure in the AWS Cloud must be highly available and scalable. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Migrate the web application to two Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server with read replicas in both Availability Zones.
options.B: Migrate the web application to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to two EC2 instances across separate AWS Regions with database replication.
options.C: Migrate the web application to Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ deployment.
options.D: Migrate the web application to three Amazon EC2 instances across three Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to three EC2 instances across three Availability Zones.

explanations.A: Migrate the web application to two Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server with read replicas in both Availability Zones. 正确性分析：Web应用程序部分使用了跨两个可用区的EC2实例和ALB，提供了高可用性。但数据寑部分使用了Amazon RDS的只读 副本，这主要用于读扩展，而不是高可用性。只读副本无法提供自动故障转移功能，因此不完全满足高可用性要求。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Migrate the web application to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to two EC2 instances across separate AWS Regions with database replication. 正确性分析：Web应用程序部分使用了Auto Scaling组和ALB，提供了高可用性和可扩展性。但数据寑部分使用了跨区域的EC2实例 和数据寑复制，这增加了管理开销，并且跨区域复制可能导致延迟问题，不是最佳实践。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Migrate the web application to Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ deployment. 正确性分析：Web应用程序部分使用了Auto Scaling组和ALB，提供了高可用性和可扩展性。数据寑部分使用了Amazon RDS的 Multi-AZ部署，提供了自动故障转移功能，完全满足高可用性要求，同时减少了管理开销。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.D: Migrate the web application to three Amazon EC2 instances across three Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to three EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. 正确性分析：Web应用程序部分使用了跨三个可用区的EC2实例和ALB，提供了高可用性。但数据寑部分使用了EC2实例进行部署， 这需要孅动管理数据寑复制和故障转移，增加了管理开销，不是最佳实践。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company has an on-premises business application that generates hundreds of files each day. These files are stored on an SMB file share and require a low-latency connection to the application servers. A new company policy states all application-generated files must be copied to AWS. There is already a VPN connection to AWS. The application development team does not have time to make the necessary code modifications to move the application to AWS. Which service should a solutions architect recommend to allow the application to copy files to AWS?

options.A: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.B: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
options.C: AWS Snowball
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway

explanations.A:
Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
Amazon EFS 是一个可扩展的文件存储服务，适用于 Linux 工作负载。
然而，本题中提到文件存储在 SMB 文件共享上，而 SMB 协议通常与 Windows 环境有关，EFS 不支持 SMB 协议。
因此，此选项错误。
explanations.B:
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 支持 SMB 协议，并且可以提供低延迟的文件共享服务。
然而，本题要求将文件从本地复制到 AWS，而不是直接迁移到 AWS 上的文件系统。
此选项虽然支持 SMB，但无法满足“将文件复制到 AWS”的需求，因此错误。
explanations.C:
AWS Snowball
AWS Snowball 是一种物理设备，用于大规模数据迁移。
本题中提到文件是每天生成的，因此需要一个持续的解决方案，而不是一次性迁移工具。
此选项不符合需求，因此错误。
explanations.D:
AWS Storage Gateway
AWS Storage Gateway 是一种混合云存储服务，可以将本地文件与 AWS 存储集成。
它支持 SMB 协议，并且可以通过文件网关将文件复制到 Amazon S3。
此选项完全符合题目要求，因此正确。

question: Topic 1 A company has 15 employees. The company stores employee start dates in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company wants to send an email message to each employee on the day of the employee's work anniversary. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a script that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Use a cron job to run this script every day on an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.B: Create a script that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Use a cron job to run this script every day on an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Schedule this Lambda function to run every day.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Schedule this Lambda function to run every day.

explanations.A: 使用EC2实例运行脚本并通过Amazon SNS发送邮件： 正确性：可以实现目标，但需要维护EC2实例，增加了运维负担。 效率：EC2实例需要持续运行或定期启动，成本较高，目不符合“最优操作效率”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 使用EC2实例运行脚本并通过Amazon SQS发送邮件： 正确性：可以实现目标，但Amazon SQS是消嬟队列服务，不直接发送邮件，需要额外的处理步骤。 效率：同样需要维护EC2实例，增加了运维负担。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Lambda并通过Amazon SNS发送邮件： 正确性：AWS Lambda是无服务器服务，支持自动化调寗，Amazon SNS可以直接发送邮件。 效率：无需维护服务器，完全托管，符合“最优操作效率”的要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: 使用AWS Lambda并通过Amazon SQS发送邮件： 正确性：AWS Lambda是无服务器服务，但Amazon SQS是消嬟队列服务，不直接发送邮件，需要额外的处理步骤。 效率：虽然Lambda减少了运维负担，但使用SQS增加了复杂性，不是最优解。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company’s application is running on Amazon EC2 instances within an Auto Scaling group behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer. Based on the application's history, the company anticipates a spike in traffic during a holiday each year. A solutions architect must design a strategy to ensure that the Auto Scaling group proactively increases capacity to minimize any performance impact on application users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to scale up the EC2 instances when CPU utilization exceeds 90%.
options.B: Create a recurring scheduled action to scale up the Auto Scaling group before the expected period of peak demand.
options.C: Increase the minimum and maximum number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group during the peak demand period.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to send alerts when there are autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_LAUNCH events.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to scale up the EC2 instances when CPU utilization exceeds 90%. 错误：虽然 CloudWatch 警报可以根据实时指标（如 CPU 使用率）触发扩展，但它是被动的，无法提前应对预期的流量高峰。 此选项无法满足题目要求的“提前增加容量”的需求。
explanations.B: Create a recurring scheduled action to scale up the Auto Scaling group before the expected period of peak demand. 正确：计划操作（Scheduled Actions）允许您在预定时间点调整 Auto Scaling 组的容量。这种方法是主动的，可以在流量高峰到来 之前增加容量，确保应用性能。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Increase the minimum and maximum number of EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group during the peak demand period. 错误：虽然增加最小和最大实例数量可以确保 Auto Scaling 组有足够的容量，但它需要手动操作，无法实现自动化和提前扩展。 此选项不如计划操作棬梮，也不符合题目要求的“设计一个策略”的需求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to send alerts when there are autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_LAUNCH events. 错误：SNS 通知仅用于发送事件警报，无法直接影响 Auto Scaling 组的扩展行为。 此选项与题目要求无关。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL databases for its data tier. The company must implement password rotation for the databases. Which solution meets this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the password in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable automatic rotation on the secret.
options.B: Store the password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Enable automatic rotation on the parameter.
options.C: Store the password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Write an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password.
options.D: Store the password in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable automatic rotation on the AWS KMS key.

explanations.A: Store the password in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable automatic rotation on the secret. 正确：AWS Secrets Manager专门设计用于管理敏感人息（如数据库密码），并支持自动轮换功能。启用自动轮换后，Secrets Manager会自动更新密码并确保应用程序可以无缝访问更新后的密码。 最少的操作开销：无需编写额外的代码或手动管理密码轮换。
explanations.B: Store the password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Enable automatic rotation on the parameter. 错误：AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store虽然可以存储敏感人息，但它不支持自动轮换功能。 需要额外的操作来实现密码轮换，因此不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Store the password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Write an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password. 错误：虽然可以通过自定义Lambda函数实现密码轮换，但这需要额外的开发和维护工作。 操作开销较高，不符合题目要求的“最少操作开销”。
explanations.D: Store the password in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable automatic rotation on the AWS KMS key. 错误：AWS KMS主要用于管理加密密钥，而不是存储和轮换数据库密码。 密码管理不是AWS KMS的设计用途，因此不适合解决此问题。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its application on Oracle Database Enterprise Edition. The company needs to migrate the application and the database to AWS. The company can use the Bring Your Own License (BYOL) model while migrating to AWS. The application uses third-party database features that require privileged access. A solutions architect must design a solution for the database migration. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle by using native tools. Replace the third-party features with AWS Lambda.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle by using native tools. Customize the new database settings to support the third-party features.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Customize the new database settings to support the third-party features.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Rewrite the application code to remove the dependency on third-party features.

explanations.A: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle by using native tools. Replace the third-party features with AWS Lambda. 错误：Amazon RDS for Oracle不支持对数据库进行深度自定义，无法满足疦三方功能需要的特权访问。 错误：用AWS Lambda蔡换疦三方功能可能需要大量重写代畡，成本较高且复杂。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle by using native tools. Customize the new database settings to support the third-party features. 正确：Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle允许对数据库进行深度自定义，支持疦三方功能需要的特权访问。 正确：使用原生工具迁移数据库是一个高效的迁移方法。 正确：此选项满足BYOL模型的要求，并且是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Customize the new database settings to support the third-party features. 错误：Amazon DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，与Oracle数据库的结构和功能完全不同，无法直接支持疦三方功能。 错误：迁移到DynamoDB需要重构应用程序代畡，成本高且复杂。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Rewrite the application code to remove the dependency on third-party features. 错误：Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL不支持Oracle数据库的特性和疦三方功能。 错误：重写应用程序代畡以移除疦三方功能依赖会增加开发成本，目不符合最具成本效益的要求。

question: Topic 1 A large international university has deployed all of its compute services in the AWS Cloud. These services include Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS, and Amazon DynamoDB. The university currently relies on many custom scripts to back up its infrastructure. However, the university wants to centralize management and automate data backups as much as possible by using AWS native options. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use third-party backup software with an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway virtual tape library.
options.B: Use AWS Backup to configure and monitor all backups for the services in use.
options.C: Use AWS Config to set lifecycle management to take snapshots of all data sources on a schedule.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager State Manager to manage the configuration and monitoring of backup tasks.

explanations.A: 使用第三方备份软件与 AWS Storage Gateway 磁带网关虚拟磁带库。 错误：虽然AWS Storage Gateway畭带网关可以用于备份，但它需要疦三方备份软件来管理备份任务，这与题目要求的“使用AWS原 生选项”不符。 此外，畭带网关主要用于与本地环境集成，而不是集中管理云端服务的备份。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Backup 配置和监控所使用服务的所有备份。 正确：AWS Backup是一个专门设计用于集中管理和自动化备份的服务，支持Amazon EC2、Amazon RDS、Amazon DynamoDB疨 服务。 它完全符合题目要求，可以简化备份管理并提供畁控功能。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Config 设置生命周期管理以按照计划对所有数据源进行快照。 错误：AWS Config主要用于资源配置的审计和合规性检查，而不是备份管理。 虽然可以通过AWS Config触发某些操作，但它并不是备份的最佳选择，也不支持集中化备份管理。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager State Manager 管理备份任务的配置和监控。 错误：AWS Systems Manager State Manager主要用于管理实例的状态和配置，而不是专门设计用于备份任务。 它无法提供集中化的备份管理功能，也不支持直接备份服务数据。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to build a map of its IT infrastructure to identify and enforce policies on resources that pose security risks. The company's security team must be able to query data in the IT infrastructure map and quickly identify security risks. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon RDS to store the data. Use SQL to query the data to identify security risks.
options.B: Use Amazon Neptune to store the data. Use SPARQL to query the data to identify security risks.
options.C: Use Amazon Redshift to store the data. Use SQL to query the data to identify security risks.
options.D: Use Amazon DynamoDB to store the data. Use PartiQL to query the data to identify security risks.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon RDS存储数据，使用SQL查询数据以识别安全风险。 Amazon RDS是关系型数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据并使用SQL查询。 虽然可以满足查询需求，但RDS需要管理数据库实例（如备份、维护等），运维开销较高。 因此不符合“最少运维开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon Neptune存储数据，使用SPARQL查询数据以识别安全风险。 Amazon Neptune是图数据库服务，专门设计用于存储和查询图形数据。 SPARQL是一种查询语言，适合处理图形数据，能够快速查询和识别复杂关系中的安全风险。 Neptune是托管服务，运维开销低，符合“最少运维开销”的要求。 这是最佳选项。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon Redshift存储数据，使用SQL查询数据以识别安全风险。 Amazon Redshift是数据仓库服务，适合处理大规模分析型查询。 虽然可以使用SQL查询，但Redshift主要用于分析而非实时查询，目需要管理集群，运维开销较高。 不符合“最少运维开销”的要求。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon DynamoDB存储数据，使用PartiQL查询数据以识别安全风险。 Amazon DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库服务，适合存储键值对和文档数据。 PartiQL是一种查询语言，支持对DynamoDB数据进行查询。 虽然DynamoDB是托管服务，运维开销低，但它不适合处理复杂关系型或图形数据查询。 因此不符合本题的需求。

question: Topic 1 A large company wants to provide its globally located developers separate, limited size, managed PostgreSQL databases for development purposes. The databases will be low volume. The developers need the databases only when they are actively working. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Give the developers the ability to launch separate Amazon Aurora instances. Set up a process to shut down Aurora instances at the end of the workday and to start Aurora instances at the beginning of the next workday.
options.B: Develop an AWS Service Catalog product that enforces size restrictions for launching Amazon Aurora instances. Give the developers access to launch the product when they need a development database.
options.C: Create an Amazon Aurora Serverless cluster. Develop an AWS Service Catalog product to launch databases in the cluster with the default capacity settings. Grant the developers access to the product.
options.D: Monitor AWS Trusted Advisor checks for idle Amazon RDS databases. Create a process to terminate identified idle RDS databases.

explanations.A: 给开发人员启动单独的Amazon Aurora实例，并设置流程关闭和启动实例： 错误：虽然可以通过手动启动和关闭Aurora实例来节畎成本，但Aurora实例的启动和关闭仍然会产椹固定的存储成本，并且管理流 程复杂，无法完全满足“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: 开发AWS Service Catalog产品，限制Aurora实例大小： 错误：虽然可以通过Service Catalog限制实例大小，但Aurora实例仍然是按实例计费，无法根据实际使用情况动态调整成本，目开 发人员可能会启动多个实例，增加成本。
explanations.C: 创建Amazon Aurora Serverless集群，并通过AWS Service Catalog启动数据库： 正确：Aurora Serverless是按需计费的数据库服务，能够根据实际使用情况动态调整容量，避免票置资源梸费。结合AWS Service Catalog，可以为开发人员提供受控的按需数据库资源，满足成本效益要求。
explanations.D: 监控AWS Trusted Advisor检查票置RDS数据库并终止： 错误：虽然可以通过畁控票置数据库来节畎成本，但此方法依赖于开发人员主动创建和管理数据库，无法提供按需的自动化解决方 案，目Aurora Serverless更适合低流量场景。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a web application that serves a content management system. The content management system runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Users are constantly adding and updating files, blogs, and other website assets in the content management system. A solutions architect must implement a solution in which all the EC2 instances share up-to-date website content with the least possible lag time. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the EC2 user data in the Auto Scaling group lifecycle policy to copy the website assets from the EC2 instance that was launched most recently. Configure the ALB to make changes to the website assets only in the newest EC2 instance.
options.B: Copy the website assets to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure each EC2 instance to mount the EFS file system locally. Configure the website hosting application to reference the website assets that are stored in the EFS file system.
options.C: Copy the website assets to an Amazon S3 bucket. Ensure that each EC2 instance downloads the website assets from the S3 bucket to the attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Run the S3 sync command once each hour to keep files up to date.
options.D: Restore an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshot with the website assets. Attach the EBS snapshot as a secondary EBS volume when a new EC2 instance is launched. Configure the website hosting application to reference the IT认证轻松过淘宝: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com [A\&4: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userld=2645260430 ”微信: Examtopics website assets that are stored in the secondary EBS volume.

explanations.A: 更新Auto Scaling组生命周期策略中的EC2用户数据，以从最邮启动的EC2实例复制网站资源。 错误原因：此方案依赖于单个 EC2 实例作为源，可能导致单点故障问题。此外，ALB 无法直接管理文件同步，目这种方式无法保证 低延迟和高可用性。

explanations.D: 使用包含网站资源的Amazon EBS快照进行恢复。 错误原因：Amazon EBS 是块存储服务，无法在多个 EC2 实例之间共享。每个实例都需要单独的 EBS 卷，这种方式无法实现文件的 实时共享和更新。

question: Topic 1 A company's web application consists of multiple Amazon EC2 instances that run behind an Application Load Balancer in a VPC. An Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance contains the data. The company needs the ability to automatically detect and respond to suspicious or unexpected behavior in its AWS environment. The company already has added AWS WAF to its architecture. What should a solutions architect do next to protect against threats?

options.A: Use Amazon GuardDuty to perform threat detection. Configure Amazon EventBridge to filter for GuardDuty findings and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to adjust the AWS WAF rules. {FQ Amazon GuardDuty
options.B: Use AWS Firewall Manager to perform threat detection. Configure Amazon EventBridge to filter for Firewall Manager findings and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to adjust the AWS WAF web ACL.
options.C: Use Amazon Inspector to perform threat detection and to update the AWS WAF rules. Create a VPC network ACL to limit access to the web application.
options.D: Use Amazon Macie to perform threat detection and to update the AWS WAF rules. Create a VPC network ACL to limit access to the web application.

explanations.A: Use Amazon GuardDuty to perform threat detection. Configure Amazon EventBridge to filter for GuardDuty findings and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to adjust the AWS WAF rules. 正确：Amazon GuardDuty是AWS的托管威胁检测服务，专门用于检测恶意活动和异常行为。 正确：Amazon EventBridge可以过滤GuardDuty的发现，并触发AWS Lambda函数来调整AWS WAF规则，从而自动响应威胁。 此选项符合题目要求，提供了自动化威胁检测和响应的解决方案。
explanations.B: Use AWS Firewall Manager to perform threat detection. Configure Amazon EventBridge to filter for Firewall Manager findings and to invoke an AWS Lambda function to adjust the AWS WAF web ACL. 错误：AWS Firewall Manager主要用于集中管理和部署安全策略，而不是专门用于威胁检测。 错误：Firewall Manager的功能与题目要求的自动威胁检测和响应不完全匹配。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Inspector to perform threat detection and to update the AWS WAF rules. Create a VPC network ACL to limit access to the web application. 错误：Amazon Inspector主要用于评估EC2实例的安全漏洞，而不是实时威胁检测。 错误：创建VPC网络ACL虽然可以限制访问，但与题目要求的自动化威胁检测和响应无关。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Macie to perform threat detection and to update the AWS WAF rules. Create a VPC network ACL to limit access to the web application. 错误：Amazon Macie主要用于数据分类和敏感数据保护，而不是针对网络威胁的检测。 错误：创建VPC网络ACL与题目要求的自动化威胁检测和响应无关。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to run a group of Amazon EC2 instances that connect to an Amazon Aurora database. The company has built an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the EC2 instances and the Aurora DB cluster. The company wants to allow the instances to authenticate to the database in a secure way. The company does not want to maintain static database credentials. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a database user with a user name and password. Add parameters for the database user name and password to the CloudFormation template. Pass the parameters to the EC2 instances when the instances are launched.
options.B: Create a database user with a user name and password. Store the user name and password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the EC2 instances to retrieve the database credentials from Parameter Store.
options.C: Configure the DB cluster to use IAM database authentication. Create a database user to use with IAM authentication. Associate a role with the EC2 instances to allow applications on the instances to access the database.
options.D: Configure the DB cluster to use IAM database authentication with an IAM user. Create a database user that has a name that matches the IAM user. Associate the IAM user with the EC2 instances to allow applications on the instances to access the database.

explanations.A: 创建一个具有用户名和密码的数据库用户。在 CloudFormation 模板中添加数据库用户名和密码的参数。在实例启动时将参数传 递给 EC2 实例。 分析： 此选项需要手动维护静态数据库认证，违背了题目要求“不想维护静态数据库认证”。 虽然可以通过CloudFormation模板传递参数，但仍然需要手动管理用户名和密畡，增加了操作复杂性。 结论： 错误。
explanations.B: 创建一个具有用户名和密码的数据库用户。将用户名和密码存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。配置 EC2 实 例从 Parameter Store 中检索数据库认证。 分析： 此选项使用了AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store来存储认证，增强了安全性。 然而，仍然需要维护静态数据库认证，违背了题目要求“不想维护静态数据库认证”。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: 配置数据库集群以使用 IAM 数据库身份验证。创建一个用于 IAM 身份验证的数据库用户。将角色与 EC2 实例关联，以允许实 例上的应用程序访问数据库。 分析： 此选项使用了Amazon Aurora的IAM数据库身份验证功能，避免了静态认证的维护。 通过IAM角色关甛EC2实例，应用程序可以安全地访问数据库，符合题目要求。 操作复杂性最低，因为IAM身份验证是AWS原生支持的功能，目自动化程度高。 结论： 正确。
explanations.D: 配置数据库集群以使用具有 IAM 用户的 IAM 数据库身份验证。创建一个名称与 IAM 用户匹配的数据库用户。将 IAM 用户与 EC2 实例关联，以允许实例上的应用程序访问数据库。 分析： 此选项试图将IAM用户直接与EC2实例关甛，但IAM用户通常用于人类用户，而不是应用程序或服务。 正确的做法是使用IAM角色，而不是IAM用户来关甛EC2实例。 此选项增加了操作复杂性，并且不符合最佳实践。 结论： 错误。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to configure its Amazon CloudFront distribution to use SSL/TLS certificates. The company does not want to use the default domain name for the distribution. Instead, the company wants to use a different domain name for the distribution. Which solution will deploy the certificate without incurring any additional costs?

options.A: Request an Amazon issued private certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region.
options.B: Request an Amazon issued private certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-west-1 Region.
options.C: Request an Amazon issued public certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region.
options.D: Request an Amazon issued public certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-west-1 Region.

explanations.A: Request an Amazon issued private certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region. 错误：CloudFront 不支持使用私有证书。私有证书通常用于内部应用，而 CloudFront 需要公共证书以支持外部访问。
explanations.B: Request an Amazon issued private certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-west-1 Region. 错误：与选项 A 的问题相同，CloudFront 不支持私有证书。此外，ACM 的证书必须在 us-east-1 区域中创建才能与 CloudFront 集 成。
explanations.C: Request an Amazon issued public certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region. 正确：CloudFront 支持公共证书，并且这些证书必须通过 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 在 us-east-1 区域中创建。使用公共证书 不会产生额外成本。
explanations.D: Request an Amazon issued public certificate from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-west-1 Region. 错误：虽然是公共证书，但 CloudFront 要求证书必须在 us-east-1 区域中创建才能与其集成。

question: Topic 1 A company creates operations data and stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. For the company's annual audit, an external consultant needs to access an annual report that is stored in the S3 bucket. The external consultant needs to access the report for 7 days. The company must implement a solution to allow the external consultant access to only the report. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket that is configured to host a public static website. Migrate the operations data to the new S3 bucket. Share the S3 website URL with the external consultant.
options.B: Enable public access to the S3 bucket for 7 days. Remove access to the S3 bucket when the external consultant completes the audit.
options.C: Create a new IAM user that has access to the report in the S3 bucket. Provide the access keys to the external consultant. Revoke the access keys after 7 days.
options.D: Generate a presigned URL that has the required access to the location of the report on the S3 bucket. Share the presigned URL with the external consultant.

explanations.A: 创建一个新的 S3 存储橘并配置为公共静态网站。 错误：此选项需要额外创建一个新的S3存储橘并迁移数据，增加了操作复杂性。 错误：将数据公开为静态网疛可能会暴需数据，违反最小权限原则。
explanations.B: 启用 S3 存储橘的公共访问权限 7 天。 错误：启用公共访问权限会使整个存储橘的数据暴需给所有人，安全性极低。 错误：无法限制访问到特定的报告文件，违反最小权限原则。
explanations.C: 创建一个新的 IAM 用户并提供访问密钥。 错误：创建新的IAM用户并管理其访问密钥增加了操作复杂性。 错误：需要手动撤销访问密钥，容易出现操作失误或延迟。
explanations.D: 生成一个预签名 URL 并分享给外部顾问。 正确：预疮名URL可以提供对特定文件的临时访问权限，符合最小权限原则。 正确：预疮名URL的有效期可以设置为7天，满足需求。 正确：操作简单，无需额外创建资源或管理用户。

question: Topic 1 A company plans to run a high performance computing (HPC) workload on Amazon EC2 Instances. The workload requires low- latency network performance and high network throughput with tightly coupled node-to-node communication. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the EC2 instances to be part of a cluster placement group.
options.B: Launch the EC2 instances with Dedicated Instance tenancy.
options.C: Launch the EC2 instances as Spot Instances.
options.D: Configure an On-Demand Capacity Reservation when the EC2 instances are launched.

explanations.A: Configure the EC2 instances to be part of a cluster placement group. 正确：Cluster Placement Group是专门为需要低延迟、高知吐量的工作负载设计的。它允许EC2实例在物理硬件上紧密分布，从而 优化节点间通人性能。
explanations.B: Launch the EC2 instances with Dedicated Instance tenancy. 错误：Dedicated Instance tenancy主要用于隔离实例以满足合规性或安全性需求，与网络性能优化无直接关系。
explanations.C: Launch the EC2 instances as Spot Instances. 错误：Spot Instances是成本优化选项，与网络性能优化无直接关系。它无法保证低延迟或高知吐量。
explanations.D: Configure an On-Demand Capacity Reservation when the EC2 instances are launched. 错误：On-Demand Capacity Reservation用于确保实例容量可用性，与网络性能优化无直接关系。

question: Topic 1 A company has primary and secondary data centers that are 500 miles (804.7 km) apart and interconnected with high-speed fiber- optic cable. The company needs a highly available and secure network connection between its data centers and a VPC on AWS for a mission-critical workload. A solutions architect must choose a connection solution that provides maximum resiliency. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Two AWs Direct Connect connections from the primary data center terminating at two Direct Connect locations on two separate devices 两个AWS Direct Connect
options.B: A single AWS Direct Connect connection from each of the primary and secondary data centers terminating at one Direct Connect location on the same device — AWS Direct Connect
options.C: Two AWS Direct Connect connections from each of the primary and secondary data centers terminating at two Direct Connect locations on two separate devices PAS AWS Direct Connect
options.D: A single AWS Direct Connect connection from each of the primary and secondary data centers terminating at one Direct Connect location on two separate devices 一个AWS Direct Connect

explanations.A: 两个AWS Direct Connect连接从主数据中心终止于两个Direct Connect位置上的两个独立设备 优点：提供了宛余，因为有两个连接和两个设备。 缺点：只考虑了主数据中心，没有考虑辅助数据中心的宛余，无法满足最大化的可用性要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 一个AWS Direct Connect连接从主数据中心和辅助数据中心分别终止于同一设备上的一个Direct Connect位置 优点：提供了主数据中心和辅助数据中心的连接。 缺点：两个连接都终止于同一设备，设备故障会导致连接中断，无法满足高可用性要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 两个AWS Direct Connect连接从主数据中心和辅助数据中心分别终止于两个Direct Connect位置上的两个独立设备 优点：提供了主数据中心和辅助数据中心的连接，同时每个数据中心都有两个连接，终止于两个独立设备，最大化了宛余和可用 性。 缺点：无明显缺点。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: 一个AWS Direct Connect连接从主数据中心和辅助数据中心分别终止于两个独立设备上的一个Direct Connect位置 优点：提供了主数据中心和辅助数据中心的连接。 缺点：每个数据中心只有一个连接，无法提供足够的宛余，目连接终止于同一个Direct Connect位置，位置故障会导致连接中断。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company runs several Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances that have high utilization. The RDS DB instances run in member accounts that are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company's finance team has access to the organization's management account and member accounts. The finance team wants to find ways to optimize costs by using AWS Trusted Advisor. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations in the management account.
options.B: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations in the member accounts where the RDS DB instances are running.
options.C: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization. #34 Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。
options.D: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances. #3 Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。
options.E: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for compute optimization. Crosscheck the results by using AWS Compute Optimizer.

explanations.A: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations in the management account. 分析：正确。管理账户可以查看整个组织的Trusted Advisor建议，适合集中管理和优化成本。
explanations.B: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations in the member accounts where the RDS DB instances are running. 分析：错 误。虽然成员账户可以查看自己的Trusted Advisor建议，但题目要求的是集中优化成本，管理账户更适合此场景。
explanations.C: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization. 分析：正确。Reserved Instance Optimization检查可以帮助识别是否可以通过预留实例节省成本，是优化RDS成本的重要方法。
explanations.D: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances. 分析：错误。Idle DB Instances检查适用于未充分利 用的数据库实例，但题目提到的是高利用率的实例，因此不适用。
explanations.E: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for compute optimization. Crosscheck the results by using AWS Compute Optimizer. 分析：错误。Compute optimization主要针对EC2实例优化，与RDS数据库实例无关。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is creating an application. The application will run on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets across multiple Availability Zones in a VPC. The EC2 instances will frequently access large files that contain confidential information. These files are stored in Amazon S3 buckets for processing. The solutions architect must optimize the network architecture to minimize data transfer costs. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. In the route tables for the private subnets, add an entry for the gateway endpoint.
options.B: Create a single NAT gateway in a public subnet. In the route tables for the private subnets, add a default route that points to the NAT gateway.
options.C: Create an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPIn the route tables for the private subnets, add an entry for the interface endpoint.
options.D: Create one NAT gateway for each Availability Zone in public subnets. In each of the route tables for the private subnets, add a default route that points to the NAT gateway in the same Availability Zone.

explanations.A: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. In the route tables for the private subnets, add an entry for the gateway endpoint. 正确：Amazon S3网关终端节点允许EC2实例通过私有网痬直接访问S3，而无需通过互甛网或NAT网关。这种方式不仅优化了网痬 架构，辤避免了数据传输费用，因为流量不会经过互甛网。 符合题目要求：优化网痬架构并最小化数据传输成本。
explanations.B: Create a single NAT gateway in a public subnet. In the route tables for the private subnets, add a default route that points to the NAT gateway. 错误：NAT网关用于允许私有子网中的资源访问互甛网，但访问S3时会产生额外的传输费用，因为流量需要通过NAT网关。 不符合题目要求：无法最小化数据传输成本。
explanations.C: Create an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. In the route tables for the private subnets, add an entry for the interface endpoint. 错误：AWS PrivateLink接口终端节点通常用于访问特定服务（如API Gateway或自定义服务），而不是用于访问Amazon S3。对于 S3，网关终端节点是更合适的选择。 不符合题目要求：无法优化网痬架构或最小化数据传输成本。
explanations.D: Create one NAT gateway for each Availability Zone in public subnets. In each of the route tables for the private subnets, add a default route that points to the NAT gateway in the same Availability Zone. 错误：虽然为每个可用区创建NAT网关可以提高可用性，但仍然无法避免数据传输费用，因为流量需要通过NAT网关。 不符合题目要求：无法最小化数据传输成本。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to relocate its on-premises MySQL database to AWS. The database accepts regular imports from a client-facing application, which causes a high volume of write operations. The company is concerned that the amount of traffic might be causing performance issues within the application. How should a solutions architect design the architecture on AWS?

options.A: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with Provisioned IOPS SSD storage. Monitor write operation metrics by using Amazon CloudWatch. Adjust the provisioned IOPS if necessary.
options.B: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with General Purpose SSD storage. Place an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of the DB instance. Configure the application to query ElastiCache instead.
options.C: Provision an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) instance with a memory optimized instance type. Monitor Amazon CloudWatch for performance-related issues. Change the instance class if necessary. ZN Amazon DocumentDB (与 MongoDB 兼容)
options.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system in General Purpose performance mode. Monitor Amazon CloudWatch for IOPS bottlenecks. Change to Provisioned Throughput performance mode if necessary. 4A Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)

explanations.A: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with Provisioned IOPS SSD storage. Monitor write operation metrics by using Amazon CloudWatch. Adjust the provisioned IOPS if necessary. 正确：Provisioned IOPS SSD存储专为高性能、高写入量场景设计，能够提供稳定的IOPS性能。 正确：使用Amazon CloudWatch监控写操作指标是标准的性能监控方法，可以帮助识别瓶矣并调整IOPS配置。 此选项完全符合题目要求，解决了高写入量可能导致的性能问题。
explanations.B: Provision an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with General Purpose SSD storage. Place an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of the DB instance. Configure the application to query ElastiCache instead. 错误：General Purpose SSD存储不适合高写入量场景，性能可能无法满足需求。 错误：ElastiCache主要用于缓存读操作，而题目关注的是写操作性能问题，ElastiCache无法解决写入瓶矣。
explanations.C: Provision an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) instance with a memory optimized instance type. Monitor Amazon CloudWatch for performance-related issues. Change the instance class if necessary. 错误：Amazon DocumentDB是为文档数据库设计的，与MySQL不兼容，无法满足题目要求。 错误：题目明确提到的是MySQL数据库，而不是DocumentDB。
explanations.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system in General Purpose performance mode. Monitor Amazon CloudWatch for IOPS bottlenecks. Change to Provisioned Throughput performance mode if necessary. 错误：Amazon EFS是文件存储服务，与关系型数据库（如MySQL）的需求不匹配。 错误：题目关注的是数据库性能优化，而不是文件存储性能。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application in the AWS Cloud that generates sensitive archival data files. The company wants to rearchitect the application's data storage. The company wants to encrypt the data files and to ensure that third parties do not have access to the data before the data is encrypted and sent to AWS. The company has already created an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the S3 bucket to use client-side encryption with an Amazon S3 managed encryption key. Configure the application to use the S3 bucket to store the archival files.
options.B: Configure the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the application to use the S3 bucket to store the archival files.
options.C: Configure the S3 bucket to use dual-layer server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the application to use the S3 bucket to store the archival files.
options.D: Configure the application to use client-side encryption with a key stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure the application to store the archival files in the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 配置S3存储橘为使用Amazon S3托管加密密钥的客户端加密。 错误：Amazon S3托管加密密迫是服务器端加密的一部分，而不是客户端加密的一部分。 客户端加密要求数据在发送到AWS之前已经被加密，而此选项未提及如何在客户端加密数据。
explanations.B: 配置S3存储橘为使用AWS KMS密钥（SSE-KMS）的服务器端加密。 错误：服务器端加密（SSE-KMS）是在数据到通AWS后进行加密，而题目要求在数据发送到AWS之前进行加密。 此选项未满足“确保疦三方在数据加密之前无法访问”的要求。
explanations.C: 配置S3存储橘为使用AWS KMS密钥（SSE-KMS）的双层服务器端加密。 错误：双层服务器端加密仍然是在数据到通AWS后进行加密，未满足题目要求的客户端加密需求。 此选项未解决数据在传输过程中可能被疦三方访问的问题。
explanations.D: 配置应用程序为使用存储在AWS KMS中的密钥进行客户端加密。 正确：客户端加密确保数据在发送到AWS之前已经被加密，从而满足题目要求。 使用AWS KMS存储密迫是安全的最佳实践，并且可以与客户端加密集成。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon RDS with default backup settings for its database tier. The company needs to make a daily backup of the database to meet regulatory requirements. The company must retain the backups for 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Write an AWS Lambda function to create an RDS snapshot every day.
options.B: Modify the RDS database to have a retention period of 30 days for automated backups.
options.C: Use AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows to modify the RDS backup retention period.
options.D: Create a manual snapshot every day by using the AWS CLI. Modify the RDS backup retention period.

explanations.A: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数每天创建一个 RDS 快照。 正确性：可以通过Lambda函数实现每天创建快照，但需要额外编写代码和维护Lambda函数。 操作开销：较高，因为需要开发、部署和维护Lambda函数。 结论：不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 修改 RDS 数据库以将自动备份的保留期设置为 30 天。 正确性：RDS支持自动备份，并允许设置备份保留期，最多可设置为35天。 操作开销：最低，因为只需修改一个配置，无需额外开发或维护。 结论：符合“最少操作开销”的要求，是正确答案。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows 修改 RDS 备份保留期。 正确性：AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows主要用于计划维护任务，不直接用于修改RDS备份保留期。 操作开销：较高，因为需要配置维护窗口并关联任务。 结论：不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: 通过使用 AWS CLI 每天创建一个手动快照。修改 RDS 备份保留期。 正确性：手动快照可以满足备份需求，但需要每天执行CLI命令，目手动快照与自动备份是独立的机制。 操作开销：较高，因为需要每天手动操作或编写脚本自动化。 结论：不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company that runs its application on AWS uses an Amazon Aurora DB cluster as its database. During peak usage hours when multiple users access and read the data, the monitoring system shows degradation of database performance for the write queries. The company wants to increase the scalability of the application to meet peak usage demands. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a second Aurora DB cluster. Configure a copy job to replicate the users’ data to the new database. Update the application to use the second database to read the data.
options.B: Create an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the existing Aurora DB cluster. Update the application to use the DAX cluster for read-only queries. Write data directly to the Aurora DB cluster.
options.C: Create an Aurora read replica in the existing Aurora DB cluster. Update the application to use the replica endpoint for read- only queries and to use the cluster endpoint for write queries.
options.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Copy the users' data to the Redshift cluster. Update the application to connect to the Redshift cluster and to perform read-only queries on the Redshift cluster.

explanations.A: 创建第二个 Aurora DB 集群。 错误：创建疦二个 Aurora DB 集群会增加成本，因为需要额外的资源来维护疦二个集群。 错误：配置复制作业并更新应用程序逻辑复杂度较高，不是最优解决方案。
explanations.B: 创建 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。 错误：DAX是为Amazon DynamoDB设计的缓存解决方案，而不是Aurora的原生解决方案。 错误：Aurora无法直接与DAX集成，因此此选项不适用。
explanations.C: 创建 Aurora 勀读副本。 正确：Aurora支持创建只读副本，能够分担读操作的负载，从而提高写操作的性能。 正确：只读副本的成本较低，目与现有Aurora集群无痼集成，是最优解决方案。
explanations.D: 创建 Amazon Redshift 集群。 错误：Redshift是专为数据仓库设计的服务，不适合处理事务型数据库的实时读写操作。 错误：将数据复制到Redshift会增加复杂性和成本，不符合题目要求的“成本效益”。

question: Topic 1 A company's near-real-time streaming application is running on AWS. As the data is ingested, a job runs on the data and takes 30 minutes to complete. The workload frequently experiences high latency due to large amounts of incoming data. A solutions architect needs to design a scalable and serverless solution to enhance performance. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest the data.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda with AWS Step Functions to process the data.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to ingest the data.
options.D: Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to process the data.
options.E: Use AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to process the data. {FRAWS Fargate与Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)

explanations.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest the data. 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose是一个完全托管的服务，专门用于流数据的摄入和传输。它支持高知吐量并且可以无缝集成到 其他AWS服务中，非常适合辢实时流数据处理场景。
explanations.B: Use AWS Lambda with AWS Step Functions to process the data. 错误：虽然AWS Lambda和Step Functions可以用于无服务器计算，但Lambda的执行时间限制为15分迩，而题目中提到处理任务需 要30分迩，因此Lambda不适合此场景。
explanations.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to ingest the data. 错误：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移，而不是流数据的摄入。它不适合处理辢实时的流数据场景。
explanations.D: Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to process the data. 错误：虽然EC2实例可以通过Auto Scaling实现可扩展性，但它不是无服务器解决方案，目需要额外的管理工作。题目要求设计一个 无服务器的解决方案，因此不符合要求。
explanations.E: Use AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to process the data. 正确：AWS Fargate是一个无服务器计算引擎，可以与Amazon ECS集成，用于运行容器化应用程序。它支持长时间运行的任务（超 社Lambda的时间限制），并且无需管理底层基础设施，非常适合处理30分迩的任务。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a web application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC. The application needs to write sensitive data to an Amazon $3 bucket. The data cannot be sent over the public internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Create a route in the VPC route table to the endpoint.
options.B: Create an internal Network Load Balancer that has the S3 bucket as the target.
options.C: Deploy the S3 bucket inside the VPCreate a route in the VPC route table to the bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC and an S3 regional endpoint.

explanations.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Create a route in the VPC route table to the endpoint. 正确。Gateway VPC Endpoint允许在不通过公共互联网的情况下，安全地从VPC访问Amazon S3。通过在VPC路由表中添加路由，可以确保流量通 社私有连接到通S3。
explanations.B: Create an internal Network Load Balancer that has the S3 bucket as the target. 错误。Network Load Balancer无法直接将 Amazon S3作为目标。S3是一个托管服务，不能作为负载均衡器的后端目标。
explanations.C: Deploy the S3 bucket inside the VPC. Create a route in the VPC route table to the bucket. 错误。Amazon S3是一个区域性 服务，不能直接部署在VPC内部。S3的访问需要通过VPC Endpoint或其他方式进行。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC and an S3 regional endpoint. 错误。虽然AWS Direct Connect 可以提供专线连接，但它通常用于跨数据中心或企业网络连接到AWS服务，而不是解决VPC内部到S3的访问问题。Direct Connect的 成本较高，目不适用于此场景。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its production workload on Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. A solutions architect needs to analyze the current EBS volume cost and to recommend optimizations. The recommendations need to include estimated monthly saving opportunities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Inspector reporting to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization.
options.B: Use AWS Systems Manager reporting to determine EBS volume recommendations for optimization.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics reporting to determine EBS volume recommendations for optimization.
options.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Inspector reporting to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization. Amazon Inspector主要用于安全性评估和漏洞扫描，而不是成本优化。 此选项与EBS卷的成本优化无关，因此是错误的。
explanations.B: Use AWS Systems Manager reporting to determine EBS volume recommendations for optimization. AWS Systems Manager主要用于管理和自动化操作任务，例如补丁管理和配置管理。 虽然它可以提供一些资源人息，但它并不专门用于EBS卷的成本优化。 此选项不符合题目要求，因此是错误的。
explanations.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics reporting to determine EBS volume recommendations for optimization. Amazon CloudWatch主要用于畁控和收集指标数据，例如性能和使用情况。 虽然它可以提供EBS卷的使用情况数据，但它并不直接提供成本优化建议。 此选项不完全满足题目要求，因此是错误的。
explanations.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization. AWS Compute Optimizer专门用于分析资源使用情况并提供优化建议，包括EBS卷的成本优化。 它可以生成优化建议并提供潜在的节畎机会，完全符合题目要求。 此选项是正确的。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to enhance its ecommerce order-processing application that is deployed on AWS. The application must process each order exactly once without affecting the customer experience during unpredictable traffic surges. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Put all the orders in the SQS queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic. Publish all the orders to the SNS standard topic. Configure the application as a notification target.
options.C: Create a flow by using Amazon AppFlow. Send the orders to the flow. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders.
options.D: Configure AWS X-Ray in the application to track the order requests. Configure the application to process the orders by pulling the orders from Amazon CloudWatch.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Put all the orders in the SQS queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders. 分析： Amazon SQS FIFO队列可以确保消嬟按顺序处理目仅处理一档，符合题目要求“桹个订单必轔处理一档”。 使用AWS Lambda函数作为目标可以实现自动化处理，并且Lambda可以根据流量动嬒扩展，适应流量棦增。 此选项完全满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic. Publish all the orders to the SNS standard topic. Configure the application as a notification target. 分析： Amazon SNS是一个发害/订輗服务，适合寋播消嬟，但无法保证消嬟的顺序或“仅处理一档”。 此选项不符合题目要求，因为无法证保订单处理的唯一性。
explanations.C: Create a flow by using Amazon AppFlow. Send the orders to the flow. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders. 分析： Amazon AppFlow主要用于数据集成和传输，不适合处理实时订单处理场景。 此选项不符合题目要求，因为AppFlow无法证保消嬟的唯一处理或顺序处理。
explanations.D: Configure AWS X-Ray in the application to track the order requests. Configure the application to process the orders by pulling the orders from Amazon CloudWatch. 分析： AWS X-Ray用于分害式跟踪和调试，不适合处理订单队列。 从Amazon CloudWatch拉取订单并处理并不是一个标准的订单处理解决方案，目无法证保唯一性或顺序处理。 此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has two AWS accounts: Production and Development. The company needs to push code changes in the Development account to the Production account. In the alpha phase, only two senior developers on the development team need access to the Production account. In the beta phase, more developers will need access to perform testing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create two policy documents by using the AWS Management Console in each account. Assign the policy to developers who need access.
options.B: Create an IAM role in the Development account. Grant the IAM role access to the Production account. Allow developers to assume the role.
options.C: Create an IAM role in the Production account. Define a trust policy that specifies the Development account. Allow developers to assume the role.
options.D: Create an IAM group in the Production account. Add the group as a principal in a trust policy that specifies the Production account. Add developers to the group.

explanations.A: Create two policy documents by using the AWS Management Console in each account. Assign the policy to developers who need access. 错误：此选项没有涉及跨账户访问的实现，仅在每个账户中创建策略文档并分配给开发人员。这无法满足开发人员从Development 账户访问Production账户的需求。
explanations.B: Create an IAM role in the Development account. Grant the IAM role access to the Production account. Allow developers to assume the role. 错误：IAM角色需要在目标账户（Production账户）中创建，并定义人任策略以允许来源账户（Development账户）中的用户或角 色进行访问。此选项在Development账户中创建角色，逻辑不正确。
explanations.C: Create an IAM role in the Production account. Define a trust policy that specifies the Development account. Allow developers to assume the role. 正确：这是跨账户访问的标准实现方式。在目标账户（Production账户）中创建IAM角色，并定义人任策略以允许来源账户 （Development账户）中的用户或角色进行访问。开发人员可以通过AssumeRole操作来访问Production账户。
explanations.D: Create an IAM group in the Production account. Add the group as a principal in a trust policy that specifies the Production account. Add developers to the group. 错误：IAM组不能作为人任策略中的主体。人任策略只能指定用户、角色或账户作为主体。此选项的实现方式不符合AWS的权限管 理逻辑。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to restrict access to the content of its web application. The company needs to protect the content by using authorization techniques that are available on AWS. The company also wants to implement a serverless architecture for authorization and authentication that has low login latency. The solution must integrate with the web application and serve web content globally. The application currently has a small user base, but the company expects the application's user base to increase. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Cognito for authentication. Implement Lambda@Edge for authorization. Configure Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
options.B: Configure AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Implement AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
options.C: Configure Amazon Cognito for authentication. Implement AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.
options.D: Configure AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Implement Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally.

explanations.A: Configure Amazon Cognito for authentication. Implement Lambda@Edge for authorization. Configure Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally. 正确：Amazon Cognito提供身份验证服务，支持小型用户群并可扩展到更大的用户群。 正确：Lambda@Edge可以在CloudFront边缘节点执行授权逻辑，减少延迟。 正确：Amazon CloudFront可以全球分发内容，满足全球用户访问需求。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Implement AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally. 错误：AWS Directory Service适用于企业内部目录服务集成，不适合小型用户群或全球分发场景。 错误：AWS Lambda虽然可以实现授权，但无法在边缘节点执行，可能导致较高的延迟。 错误：Application Load Balancer无法实现全球分发，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon Cognito for authentication. Implement AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally. 正确：Amazon Cognito适合身份验证需求。 错误：AWS Lambda无法在边缘节点执行授权逻辑，可能导致较高的延迟。 错误：Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration主要用于加速文件上传和下载，不适合直接分发动态Web内容。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Implement Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally. 错误：AWS Directory Service不适合小型用户群或全球分发场景。 正确：Lambda@Edge可以在边缘节点执行授权逻辑。 错误：AWS Elastic Beanstalk无法实现全球分发，无法满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A development team uses multiple AWS accounts for its development, staging, and production environments. Team members have been launching large Amazon EC2 instances that are underutilized. A solutions architect must prevent large instances from being launched in all accounts. How can the solutions architect meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Update the IAM policies to deny the launch of large EC2 instances. Apply the policies to all users.
options.B: Define a resource in AWS Resource Access Manager that prevents the launch of large EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an IAM role in each account that denies the launch of large EC2 instances. Grant the developers IAM group access to the role.
options.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the management account with the default policy. Create a service control policy (SCP) that denies the launch of large EC2 instances, and apply it to the AWS accounts.

explanations.A: 更新IAM策略以拒绝启动大型EC2实例。将策略应用于所有用户。 错误：IAM策略只能作用于单个账户内的用户或角色，无法跨账户集中管理。对于多账户环境，IAM策略的管理复杂度较高，目无 法实现集中控制。
explanations.B: 在AWS Resource Access Manager中定义一个资源，阻止启动大型EC2实例。 错误：AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) 的主要功能是共享资源，而不是限制资源的使用。它无法直接用于限制EC2实例的类 型。
explanations.C: 在每个账户中创建一个IAM角色，拒绝启动大型EC2实例。授予开发人员IAM组访问该角色的权限。 错误：这种方法需要在每个账户中单独配置IAM角色，操作复杂目无法实现集中管理。对于多账户环境，SCP是更合适的解决方 案。
explanations.D: 在管理账户中使用默正策略创建一个AWS Organizations组织。创建一个服务控制策略（SCP），拒绝启动大型EC2实例，并将 其应用于AWS账户。 正确：AWS Organizations允许集中管理多个账户，并通过SCP实现跨账户的权限控制。SCP可以限制账户级别的操作，例如禁止启 动大型EC2实例。这种方法操作简单且具有最低的运维开销。

question: Topic 1 A company has migrated a fleet of hundreds of on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to Amazon EC2 instances. The instances run a diverse fleet of Windows Server versions along with several Linux distributions. The company wants a solution that will automate inventory and updates of the operating systems. The company also needs a summary of common vulnerabilities of each instance for regular monthly reviews. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to manage all the EC2 instances. Configure AWS Security Hub to produce monthly reports.
