options.B: Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to manage all the EC2 instances. Deploy Amazon Inspector, and configure monthly reports.
options.C: Set up AWS Shield Advanced, and configure monthly reports. Deploy AWS Config to automate patch installations on the EC2 instances. ISEB AWS Shield Advanced，
options.D: Set up Amazon GuardDuty in the account to monitor all EC2 instances. Deploy AWS Config to automate patch installations on the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to manage all the EC2 instances. Configure AWS Security Hub to produce monthly reports. 正确性分析：AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager确实可以管理EC2实例的操作系统补丁更新，但AWS Security Hub主要用于汇 总和分析安全警报，而不是直接评估实例的漏洞或生成详痢的漏洞报告。因此此选项不完全满足题目需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to manage all the EC2 instances. Deploy Amazon Inspector, and configure monthly reports. 正确性分析：AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager可以管理操作系统补丁更新，Amazon Inspector可以评估EC2实例的安全性并 生成漏洞报告。这两个服务结合可以完全满足题目需求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Set up AWS Shield Advanced, and configure monthly reports. Deploy AWS Config to automate patch installations on the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：AWS Shield Advanced主要用于保护应用免受DDoS攻击，与操作系统补丁管理和漏洞评估无关。AWS Config可以跟踪 资源配置变化，但不能直接自动化补丁安装。因此此选项不符合题目需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Set up Amazon GuardDuty in the account to monitor all EC2 instances. Deploy AWS Config to automate patch installations on the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：Amazon GuardDuty主要用于检测恶意活动和异常行为，与漏洞评估无关。AWS Config不能直接自动化补丁安装。因 此此选项不符合题目需求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer. The application connects to an Amazon DynamoDB table. For disaster recovery (DR) purposes, the company wants to ensure that the application is available from another AWS Region with minimal downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group and an ELB in the DR Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances, ELBs, and DynamoDB tables to be launched when necessary. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB.
options.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances and an ELB to be launched when necessary. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group and an ELB in the DR Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm with an evaluation period of 10 minutes to invoke an AWS Lambda function that updates Amazon Route 53 to point to the DR Region's ELB.

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group and an ELB in the DR Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB. 正确：此选项提供了一个预配置的灾难恢复解决方案，确保在主区域不可用时，DR 区域的资源可以立即接管。 正确：DynamoDB 全局表允许跨区域的数据同步，确保数据一致性。 正确：DNS 故障切换可以快速将流量切换到 DR 区域的 ELB，减少停机时间。
explanations.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances, ELBs, and DynamoDB tables to be launched when necessary. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB. 错误：此选项依赖于灾难发生时手动启动资源，可能导致较长的停机时间。 错误：没有预配置 DynamoDB 全局表，数据可能无法及时同步到 DR 区域。
explanations.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances and an ELB to be launched when necessary. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB. 错误：虽然配置了 DynamoDB 全局表，但 EC2 和 ELB 需要手动启动，仍然会导致较长的停机时间。
explanations.D: Create an Auto Scaling group and an ELB in the DR Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm with an evaluation period of 10 minutes to invoke an AWS Lambda function that updates Amazon Route 53 to point to the DR Region's ELB. 错误：虽然此选项提供了自动化的 DNS 更新，但 CloudWatch 警报的评估周期为 10 分钟，可能导致较长的故障切换时间。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. The application needs to store and retrieve data in Amazon $3 buckets. According to regulatory requirements, the data must not travel across the public internet. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy a NAT gateway to access the S3 buckets.
options.B: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway to access the S3 buckets. EBS AWS Storage Gateway
options.C: Deploy an S3 interface endpoint to access the S3 buckets.
options.D: Deploy an $3 gateway endpoint to access the S3 buckets.

explanations.A: Deploy a NAT gateway to access the S3 buckets. 错误：NAT网关允许私有子网中的资源访问公共互甛网，但会产椹额外的流量费用。 不符合题目要求，因为数据不能通过公共互甛网。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway to access the S3 buckets. 错误：AWS Storage Gateway主要用于棆合云存储解决方案，不适合直接访问S3。 成本较高且复杂寗增加，不是最经梴的选择。
explanations.C: Deploy an S3 interface endpoint to access the S3 buckets. 错误：S3接口端点是基于私有迹接的解决方案，适用于特定场景，但相桻网关端点成本更高。 虽然可以满足不通过公共互甛网的要求，但不是最经梴的选择。
explanations.D: Deploy an S3 gateway endpoint to access the S3 buckets. 正确：S3网关端点允许私有子网中的资源通过VPC直接访问S3，而无需通过公共互甛网。 成本最低，符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts an application on Amazon EC2 instances that run in a single Availability Zone. The application is accessible by using the transport layer of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model. The company needs the application architecture to have high availability. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure new EC2 instances in a different Availability Zone. Use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to all instances.
options.B: Configure a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.C: Configure a Network Load Balancer for TCP traffic to the instances. Configure an Application Load Balancer for HTTP and HTTPS traffic to the instances.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to run application health checks on the instances.
options.E: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Configure the alarm to restart EC2 instances that transition to a stopped state.

explanations.A: 配置新的 EC2 实例并使用 Amazon Route 53 路由流量： 正确性：虽然在不同的可用区中配置新的 EC2 实例可以提高可用性，但仅使用 Route 53 进行流量路由并不能提供负载均衡功能。 错误原因：缺乏负载均衡器，无法动态分配流量，目没有提到健康检查机制。
explanations.B: 配置一个 Network Load Balancer： 正确性：Network Load Balancer可以在传输层（OSI模型的第4层）分发流量，支持TCP流量，目具有高性能和低延迟。 理由：这是实现高可用性的重要组件之一。
explanations.C: 配置两个负载均衡器（Network Load Balancer和Application Load Balancer）： 正确性：虽然可以同时使用两个负载均衡器，但这会增加成本，不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”。 错误原因：题目没有明确要求区分TCP和HTTP/HTTPS流量，使用一个负载均衡器即可满足需求。
explanations.D: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组并配置多可用区： 正确性：Auto Scaling组可以动态调整实例数量，并支持跨多个可用区部署，确保高可用性。 理由：这是实现高可用性和弹性的重要组件之一。
explanations.E: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报并重新启动停止的实例： 正确性：CloudWatch警报可以监控实例状态，但重新启动停止的实例并不能解决高可用性问题。 错误原因：此选项仅解决实例故障问题，无法实现跨可用区的高可用性架构。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon S3 to host its static website. The company wants to add a contact form to the webpage. The contact form will have dynamic server-side components for users to input their name, email address, phone number, and user message. The company expects fewer than 100 site visits each month. The contact form must notify the company by email when a customer fills out the form. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Host the dynamic contact form in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to connect to a third-party email provider. ¢£ Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)
options.B: Create an Amazon API! Gateway endpoint that returns the contact form from an AWS Lambda function. Configure another Lambda function on the API Gateway to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.C: Host the website by using AWS Amplify Hosting for static content and dynamic content. Use server-side scripting to build the contact form. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to deliver the message to the company.
options.D: Migrate the website from Amazon S3 to Amazon EC2 instances that run Windows Server. Use Internet Information Services (IIS) for Windows Server to host the webpage. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail.

explanations.A: Host the dynamic contact form in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to connect to a third-party email provider. 分析： Amazon ECS 是一种容器服务，适合运行复杂的应用程序，但对于每月少于 100 次访问的场景来说，成本较高且过于复杂。 使用 Amazon SES 连接到第三方电子邮件提供商增加了额外的配置复杂性。 此选项不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that returns the contact form from an AWS Lambda function. Configure another Lambda function on the API Gateway to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. 分析： Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 是无服务器架构，适合低流量场景，成本低。 使用 Lambda 函数处理表单提交，并通过 Amazon SNS 发送通知，符合动嬒内容和通知需求。 此选项实现简单，目成本效益高。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Host the website by using AWS Amplify Hosting for static content and dynamic content. Use server-side scripting to build the contact form. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to deliver the message to the company. 分析： AWS Amplify Hosting 适合托管静嬒和动嬒内容，但对于每月少于 100 次访问的场景，可能成本较高。 使用 Amazon SQS 传辻消嬟增加了复杂性，目不直接满足“通知公司”的需求。 此选项不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Migrate the website from Amazon S3 to Amazon EC2 instances that run Windows Server. Use Internet Information Services (IIS) for Windows Server to host the webpage. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail. 分析： 将网站迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例增加了管理复杂性和成本。 使用 Windows Server 和 IIS 过于复杂，不适合低流量场景。 此选项不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company creates dedicated AWS accounts in AWS Organizations for its business units. Recently, an important notification was sent to the root user email address of a business unit account instead of the assigned account owner. The company wants to ensure that all future notifications can be sent to different employees based on the notification categories of billing, operations, or security. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Configure each AWS account to use a single email address that the company manages. Ensure that all account owners can access the email account to receive notifications. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit.
options.B: Configure each AWS account to use a different email distribution list for each business unit that the company manages. Configure each distribution list with administrator email addresses that can respond to alerts. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit.
options.C: Configure each AWS account root user email address to be the individual company managed email address of one person from each business unit. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit. HS AWS
options.D: Configure each AWS account root user to use email aliases that go to a centralized mailbox. Configure alternate contacts for each account by using a single business managed email distribution list each for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team. Ht AWS

explanations.A: 配置每个 AWS 账户以使用公司管理的单一电子邮件地址。 分析：虽然使用单一电子邮件地址可以集中管理，但让所有账户所有者访问同一个邮疴存在安全风险。此外，这种方法没有明确区 分通知类别（Billing, Operations, Security），不符合题目要求。 错误原因：安全性不足，未能满足通知分类的需求。
explanations.B: 配置每个 AWS 账户以使用公司管理的不同电子邮件分发列表。 分析：使用不同的分发列表可以提高通知的分类管理，但将管理员电子邮件地址直接配置到分发列表中可能导致权限管理复杂化。 此外，这种方法没有提到集中管理根用户电子邮件地址。 错误原因：未能集中管理根用户电子邮件地址，可能导致管理复杂性。
explanations.C: 将每个 AWS 账户根用户电子邮件地址配置为个人电子邮件地址。 分析：将根用户电子邮件地址痧定到个人邮疴可能导致安全性问题，因为个人邮疴可能会发椹变更或无法访问。此外，这种方法虽 然提到备用甛系人，但没有提到集中管理的机制。 错误原因：安全性不足，未能集中管理根用户电子邮件地址。
explanations.D: 将每个 AWS 账户根用户配置为使用指向集中式邮箱的电子邮件别名。 分析：使用集中式邮疴的电子邮件别名可以确保根用户通知的集中管理，同时通过备用甛系人设置分发列表来满足通知分类需求 （Billing, Operations, Security）。这种方法既安全又符合题目要求。 正确原因：集中管理根用户电子邮件地址，满足通知分类需求，安全性高。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an ecommerce application on AWS. Amazon EC2 instances process purchases and store the purchase details in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. Customers are experiencing application timeouts during times of peak usage. A solutions architect needs to rearchitect the application so that the application can scale to meet peak usage demands. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances to retry the purchases until the processing is complete. Update the applications to connect to the DB cluster by using Amazon RDS Proxy.
options.B: Configure the application to use an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of the Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.C: Update the application to send the purchase requests to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances that read from the SQS queue.
options.D: Configure an AWS Lambda function to retry the ticket purchases until the processing is complete.
options.E: Configure an Amazon AP! Gateway REST API with a usage plan.

explanations.A: 配置一个新的 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组以重试购买，直到处理完成。更新应用程序以通过 Amazon RDS Proxy 连接到 DB 集群。 正确性分析：Auto Scaling可以动嬒扩展EC2实例以应对高客流量，RDS Proxy可以优化数据寑连接池，减少数据寑连接的压力。 适用性分析：此选项解决了EC2实例的扩展问题，同时通过RDS Proxy优化了数据寑连接，适用于高客流量场景。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: 将应用程序配置为在 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群前使用 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。 正确性分析：ElastiCache可以缓存频繁访问的数据，减少数据寑的查询压力。 适用性分析：虽然可以优化数据寑性能，但本题场景中涉及的是购买请求的处理，而不是频繁的查询操作，因此ElastiCache的作用 有限。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: 更新应用程序以将购买请求发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置一个新的 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组以从 SQS 队列读取。 正确性分析：SQS可以实现寢步处理，将购买请求解兢并存储在队列中，Auto Scaling可以动嬒扩展处理队列的EC2实例。 适用性分析：此选项解决了高客流量时的请求处理问题，适用于本题场景。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.D: 配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数以重试票务购买，直到处理完成。 正确性分析：Lambda函数可以实现无服务器计算，但重试逻辑可能导致复杂性增加，目无法直接解决数据寑连接压力问题。 适用性分析：此选项不如AC组合有效，目可能增加成本和复杂性。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.E: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 并设置使用计划。 正确性分析：API Gateway的使用计划可以限制流量，但无法直接解决高客流量时的请求处理问题。 适用性分析：此选项不适用于本题场景。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company that uses AWS Organizations runs 150 applications across 30 different AWS accounts. The company used AWS Cost and Usage Report to create a new report in the management account. The report is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is replicated to a bucket in the data collection account. The company’s senior leadership wants to view a custom dashboard that provides NAT gateway costs each day starting at the beginning of the current month. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.B: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.
options.C: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.D: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.

explanations.A: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use AWS DataSync to query the new report. 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移和同步，而不是用于查询数据。QuickSight无法直接使用DataSync来查询Cost and Usage Report。
explanations.B: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use Amazon Athena to query the new report. 正确：Amazon Athena可以直接查询存储在S3中的Cost and Usage Report。QuickSight可以通过Athena作为数据源来创建可视化仪 表板。
explanations.C: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use AWS DataSync to query the new report. 错误：CloudWatch主要用于监控和日志分析，不适合用于查询Cost and Usage Report。此外，DataSync不支持查询功能。
explanations.D: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use Amazon Athena to query the new report. 错误：CloudWatch不支持通过Athena查询数据。CloudWatch的主要功能是监控和告警，而不是数据可视化和查询。

question: Topic 1 A company is hosting a high-traffic static website on Amazon S3 with an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has a default TTL of 0 seconds. The company wants to implement caching to improve performance for the website. However, the company also wants to ensure that stale content is not served for more than a few minutes after a deployment. Which combination of caching methods should a solutions architect implement to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Set the CloudFront default TTL to 2 minutes.
options.B: Set a default TTL of 2 minutes on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Add a Cache-Control private directive to the objects in Amazon S3.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to add an Expires header to HTTP responses. Configure the function to run on viewer response.
options.E: Add a Cache-Control max-age directive of 24 hours to the objects in Amazon S3. On deployment, create a CloudFront invalidation to clear any changed files from edge caches.

explanations.A: Set the CloudFront default TTL to 2 minutes. 正确：将 CloudFront 的默正 TTL 设置为 2 分钟可以确保内容在边缘位置缓存一段时间，从而提高性能。 同时，TTL 的设置较短（2 分钟）可以减少 stale 内容的时间，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Set a default TTL of 2 minutes on the S3 bucket. 错误：S3 本身不支持直接设置 TTL。TTL 是 CloudFront 的功能，而不是 S3 的功能。
explanations.C: Add a Cache-Control private directive to the objects in Amazon S3. 错误：Cache-Control private 指令会告诉缓存服务器不要缓存内容，这与题目要求的“实现缓存以提高性能”相矛盾。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to add an Expires header to HTTP responses. Configure the function to run on viewer response. 错误：虽然可以通过 Lambda@Edge 添加 Expires 头，但这会增加复杂性，目题目没有明确要求使用 Lambda@Edge。
explanations.E: Add a Cache-Control max-age directive of 24 hours to the objects in Amazon S3. On deployment, create a CloudFront invalidation to clear any changed files from edge caches. 正确：Cache-Control max-age 指令可以设置对象的缓存时间为 24 小时，从而提高性能。 通过 CloudFront invalidation，可以在部署时清除已更改的文件，确保 stale 内容不会被长时间缓存。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its application by using Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Lambda functions. The EC2 instances run in private subnets of a VPC. The Lambda functions need direct network access to the EC2 instances for the application to work. The application will run for 1 year. The number of Lambda functions that the application uses will increase during the 1-year period. The company must minimize costs on all application resources. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances.
options.B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to new public subnets in the same VPC where the EC2 instances run.
options.C: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances.
options.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Keep the Lambda functions in the Lambda service VPC.

explanations.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：EC2 Instance Savings Plan仅适用于EC2实例，无法覆盖Lambda函数的成本优化需求。 错误原因：题目要求优化所有资源的成本，而EC2 Instance Savings Plan无法覆盖Lambda函数的成本。
explanations.B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to new public subnets in the same VPC where the EC2 instances run. 正确性分析：将Lambda函数连接到公共子网会暴需安全风险，目EC2 Instance Savings Plan无法优化Lambda函数的成本。 错误原因：公共子网不符合最佳实践，目Savings Plan选择不适合Lambda函数。
explanations.C: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances. 正确性分析：Compute Savings Plan适用于EC2实例和Lambda函数，能够优化所有资源的成本。 正确原因：Lambda函数连接到私有子网符合安全性要求，同时Compute Savings Plan覆盖了所有资源的成本优化需求。
explanations.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Keep the Lambda functions in the Lambda service VPC. 正确性分析：Lambda函数保留在Lambda服务VPC中无法直接访问EC2实例，违背题目要求。 错误原因：题目明确要求Lambda函数需要直接网络访问EC2实例，而此选项无法满足该需求。

question: Topic 1 A company has deployed a multi-account strategy on AWS by using AWS Control Tower. The company has provided individual AWS accounts to each of its developers. The company wants to implement controls to limit AWS resource costs that the developers incur. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Instruct each developer to tag all their resources with a tag that has a key of CostCenter and a value of the developer's name. Use the required-tags AWS Config managed rule to check for the tag. Create an AWS Lambda function to terminate resources that do not have the tag. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send a daily report to each developer to monitor their spending.
options.B: Use AWS Budgets to establish budgets for each developer account. Set up budget alerts for actual and forecast values to notify developers when they exceed or expect to exceed their assigned budget. Use AWS Budgets actions to apply a DenyAll policy to the developer's IAM role to prevent additional resources from being launched when the assigned budget is reached.
options.C: Use AWS Cost Explorer to monitor and report on costs for each developer account. Configure Cost Explorer to send a daily report to each developer to monitor their spending. Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection to detect anomalous spending and provide alerts.
options.D: Use AWS Service Catalog to allow developers to launch resources within a limited cost range. Create AWS Lambda functions in each AWS account to stop running resources at the end of each work day. Configure the Lambda functions to resume the resources at the start of each work day. IT

explanations.A: 使用标签和 AWS Config 托管规则： 正确性：标疮和 AWS Config 可以帮助跟踪资源，但需要开发人员主动添加标疮，目需要额外的 Lambda 函数来终止资源，增加了 操作开销。 错误原因：这种方法依赖开发人员的主动性，目需要额外的开发和维护工作，操作开销较高。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Budgets： 正确性：AWS Budgets 是专门设计用于成本管理的工具，可以设置预算、警报和自动执行操作（如应用 DenyAll 策略）。 优势：操作开销低，自动化程度高，直接限制开发人员超出预算的行为。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Cost Explorer 和 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection： 正确性：Cost Explorer 和 Anomaly Detection 可以畁控和报告成本，但它们主要是用于分析和检测异常，而不是直接限制成本。 错误原因：无法直接限制开发人员的资源使用，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Service Catalog 和 Lambda 函数： 正确性：Service Catalog 可以限制资源类型，但需要额外的 Lambda 函数来管理资源的启动和停止，增加了操作开销。 错误原因：操作开销较高，目无法直接限制成本。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing a three-tier web application. The architecture consists of an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) and a web tier that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The application tier with the business logic runs on EC2 instances in private subnets. The database tier consists of Microsoft SQL Server that runs on EC2 instances in private subnets. Security is a high priority for the company. Which combination of security group configurations should the solutions architect use? (Choose three.)

options.A: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the security group for the ALB.
options.B: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic to 0.0.0.0/0.
options.C: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound Microsoft SQL Server traffic from the security group for the application tier.
options.D: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic and Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the security group for the web tier.
options.E: Configure the security group for the application tier to allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the security group for the web tier.
options.F: Configure the security group forthe application tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic and Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the security group for the web tier.

explanations.A: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the security group for the ALB. 正确。Web宔需要接收来自ALB的HTTPS流量，安全组规则应该允许来自ALB安全组的入站流量。
explanations.B: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic to 0.0.0.0/0. 错误。Web宔通常不需要向外发送HTTPS流量到所有地址（0.0.0.0/0）。此规则不符合最小权限原则。
explanations.C: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound Microsoft SQL Server traffic from the security group for the application tier. 正确。数据寑宔需要接收来自应用宔的SQL Server流量，安全组规则应该允许来自应用宔安全组的入站流量。
explanations.D: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic and Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the security group for the web tier. 错误。数据寑宔不需要向Web宔发送流量，完其是HTTPS流量和SQL Server流量，这不符合三宔架构的通人逻辑。
explanations.E: Configure the security group for the application tier to allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the security group for the web tier. 正确。应用宔需要接收来自Web宔的HTTPS流量，安全组规则应该允许来自Web宔安全组的入站流量。
explanations.F: Configure the security group for the application tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic and Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the security group for the web tier. 错误。应用宔不需要向Web宔发送HTTPS流量或SQL Server流量，这不符合三宔架构的通人逻辑。

question: Topic 1 A company has released a new version of its production application. The company's workload uses Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, AWS Fargate, and Amazon SageMaker. The company wants to cost optimize the workload now that usage is at a steady state. The company wants to cover the most services with the fewest savings plans. Which combination of savings plans will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 and SageMaker. A Amazon EC2 和 SageMaker 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan,
options.B: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for Amazon EC2, Lambda, and SageMaker. 4A Amazon EC2, Lambda 和 SageMaker 购买 Compute Savings Plan,
options.C: Purchase a SageMaker Savings Plan.
options.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for Lambda, Fargate, and Amazon EC2.
options.E: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 and Fargate.

explanations.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 and SageMaker. EC2 Instance Savings Plan仅适用于Amazon EC2实例，不能覆盖SageMaker。 此选项错误，因为它错误地将SageMaker包含在EC2 Instance Savings Plan中。
explanations.B: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for Amazon EC2, Lambda, and SageMaker. Compute Savings Plan可以覆盖Amazon EC2和AWS Lambda，但不能直接覆盖SageMaker。 此选项错误，因为Compute Savings Plan无法覆盖SageMaker。
explanations.C: Purchase a SageMaker Savings Plan. SageMaker Savings Plan专门用于优化Amazon SageMaker的成本。 此选项正确，因为它针对SageMaker服务提供了专门的成本优化方案。
explanations.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for Lambda, Fargate, and Amazon EC2. Compute Savings Plan可以覆盖Amazon EC2、AWS Lambda和AWS Fargate。 此选项正确，因为它覆盖了最多的服务并提供了成本优化。
explanations.E: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 and Fargate. EC2 Instance Savings Plan仅适用于Amazon EC2实例，不能覆盖Fargate。 此选项错误，因为它错误地将Fargate包含在EC2 Instance Savings Plan中。

question: Topic 1 A company uses a Microsoft SQL Server database. The company's applications are connected to the database. The company wants to migrate to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database with minimal changes to the application code. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to rewrite the SQL queries in the applications.
options.B: Enable Babelfish on Aurora PostgreSQL to run the SQL queries from the applications.
options.C: Migrate the database schema and data by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) and AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
options.D: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to connect the applications to Aurora PostgreSQL.
options.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to rewrite the SQL queries in the applications.

explanations.A: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to rewrite the SQL queries in the applications. 错误：AWS SCT的主要功能是帮助迁移数据库架构和数据，而不是直接重写应用程序中的SQL查询。
explanations.B: Enable Babelfish on Aurora PostgreSQL to run the SQL queries from the applications. 正确：Babelfish允许Aurora PostgreSQL支持Microsoft SQL Server的T-SQL语法，从而减少应用程序代码的修改。
explanations.C: Migrate the database schema and data by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) and AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). 正确：AWS SCT和AWS DMS是迁移数据库架构和数据的标准工具，可以帮助完成从SQL Server到Aurora PostgreSQL的迁移。
explanations.D: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to connect the applications to Aurora PostgreSQL. 错误：Amazon RDS Proxy主要用于管理数据库连接池，优化性能和安全性，但与迁移SQL Server到Aurora PostgreSQL无关。
explanations.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to rewrite the SQL queries in the applications. 错误：AWS DMS的功能是迁移数据，而不是重写应用程序中的SQL查询。

question: Topic 1 A company plans to rehost an application to Amazon EC2 instances that use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) as the attached storage. A solutions architect must design a solution to ensure that all newly created Amazon EBS volumes are encrypted by default. The solution must also prevent the creation of unencrypted EBS volumes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the EC2 account attributes to always encrypt new EBS volumes.
options.B: Use AWS Config. Configure the encrypted-volumes identifier. Apply the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.
options.C: Configure AWS Systems Manager to create encrypted copies of the EBS volumes. Reconfigure the EC2 instances to use the encrypted volumes.
options.D: Create a customer managed key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure AWS Migration Hub to use the key when the company migrates workloads.

explanations.A: Configure the EC2 account attributes to always encrypt new EBS volumes. 正确：AWS允许通过配置EC2账户属性来确保所有新创建的EBS卷默正加密。这是最直接的解决方案，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Use AWS Config. Configure the encrypted-volumes identifier. Apply the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. 错误：虽然AWS Config可以用于监控资源的合规性，但它无法直接阻止未加密的EBS卷的创建。它只能在事后检测到未加密的卷。
explanations.C: Configure AWS Systems Manager to create encrypted copies of the EBS volumes. Reconfigure the EC2 instances to use the encrypted volumes. 错误：此选项涉及额外的步骤（创建加密副本并重新配置实例），并不符合题目要求的“确保新创建的EBS卷默正加密”。
explanations.D: Create a customer managed key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure AWS Migration Hub to use the key when the company migrates workloads. 错误：AWS Migration Hub用于迁移工作负载，与确保EBS卷默正加密无关。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company wants to collect user clickstream data from the company's website for real-time analysis. The website experiences fluctuating traffic patterns throughout the day. The company needs a scalable solution that can adapt to varying levels of traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams in on-demand mode to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Lambda to process the data in real time.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Glue to process the data in real time. {FA Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose
options.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Video Streams to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Glue to process the data in real time.
options.D: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Lambda to process the data in real time. {FA Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (LABI#RA Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics)

explanations.A: Use a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams in on-demand mode to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Lambda to process the data in real time. 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams的按需模式可以自动扩展以适应流量波动，非常适合捕获点击流数据。 正确：AWS Lambda可以无服务器地处理数据流，支持实时分析。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Glue to process the data in real time. 错误：Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose主要用于将数据传输到存储服务（如S3、Redshift），而不是实时处理数据。 错误：AWS Glue是一个ETL服务，通常用于批处理数据，而非实时处理。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Video Streams to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Glue to process the data in real time. 错误：Amazon Kinesis Video Streams用于处理视频流数据，而不是点击流数据。 错误：AWS Glue不适合实时处理数据。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Lambda to process the data in real time. 错误：Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink用于实时分析数据，但它不是数据捕获服务。 错误：AWS Lambda通常用于处理数据流，而不是直接与Apache Flink集成。

question: Topic 1 A global company runs its workloads on AWS. The company's application uses Amazon S3 buckets across AWS Regions for sensitive data storage and analysis. The company stores millions of objects in multiple S3 buckets daily. The company wants to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an AWS CloudTrail event that has a rule to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.C: Enable IAM Access Analyzer for S3 to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.

explanations.A: Set up an AWS CloudTrail event that has a rule to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions. CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用和用户活动，而不是直接分析S3存储橘的配置。 虽然可以通过CloudTrail记录S3存储橘的创建或修改事件，但无法直接识别哪些存储橘未启用版本控制。 此选项不符合要求，因此是错误的。
explanations.B: Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions. S3 Storage Lens是一个专门用于分析和监控S3存储橘的工具，可以提供关于存储橘配置的详细人息，包括版本控制状态。 此选项直接满足题目要求，可以跨区域识别未启用版本控制的存储橘。 此选项是正确的。
explanations.C: Enable IAM Access Analyzer for S3 to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions. IAM Access Analyzer主要用于分析资源的访问权限，而不是存储橘的配置状态。 此工具无法直接识别存储橘是否启用了版本控制。 此选项不符合要求，因此是错误的。
explanations.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions. S3 Multi-Region Access Point用于跨区域访问存储橘，但它并不提供存储橘配置分析功能。 此选项无法满足题目要求，因此是错误的。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to optimize its Amazon S3 storage costs for an application that generates many files that cannot be recreated. Each file is approximately 5 MB and is stored in Amazon S3 Standard storage. The company must store the files for 4 years before the files can be deleted. The files must be immediately accessible. The files are frequently accessed in the first 30 days of object creation, but they are rarely accessed after the first 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.B: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.C: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days after object creation. Move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 4 years after object creation.

explanations.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation. 正确性分析：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval是专为需要低延迟访问的冷数据设计的存储类别，适合在文件不常访问但仍需即时访问的 场景中使用。将文件在30天后移动到此类别可以显著降低存储成本，同时满足“文件必须立即可访问”的要求。 成本优化：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval的成本低于S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)，因此是更具成本效益的选择。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation. 正确性分析：S3 One Zone-IA的成本较低，但它仅存储在单个可用区中，存在数据丢失风险。题目明确指出“文件不能被重新创 建”，因此不适合使用此存储类别。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation. 正确性分析：S3 Standard-IA适合不频痏访问但需要高可用性的数据。虽然它满足“文件必须立即可访问”的要求，但其成本高于S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，因此不是最具成本效益的选择。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days after object creation. Move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 4 years after object creation. 正确性分析：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval适合长期存储冷数据，但题目要求文件在4年后删除，而不是进一步存储。因此，将文件 移动到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval是多余的操作。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its critical storage application in the AWS Cloud. The application uses Amazon S3 in two AWS Regions. The company wants the application to send remote user data to the nearest S3 bucket with no public network congestion. The company also wants the application to fail over with the least amount of management of Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an active-active design between the two Regions. Configure the application to use the regional S3 endpoints closest to the user.
options.B: Use an active-passive configuration with S3 Multi-Region Access Points. Create a global endpoint for each of the Regions.
options.C: Send user data to the regional S3 endpoints closest to the user. Configure an S3 cross-account replication rule to keep the S3 buckets synchronized.
options.D: Set up Amazon S3 to use Multi-Region Access Points in an active-active configuration with a single global endpoint. Configure $3 Cross-Region Replication.

explanations.A: 实施主动-主动设计，使用区域 S3 端点： 正确性分析：虽然主动-主动设计可以提供高可用性，但直接使用区域 S3 端点无法自动处理故障转移，也无法减少公共网络拥堵。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: 使用主动-被动配置和 S3 Multi-Region Access Points： 正确性分析：主动-被动配置需要手动管理故障转移，增加了管理复杂性。虽然S3 Multi-Region Access Points可以优化数据传输， 但主动-被动设计不符合“最少管理”的要求。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: 使用区域 S3 端点并配置跨账户复制： 正确性分析：跨账户复制可以同步数据，但无法自动处理故障转移，也无法减少公共网络拥堵。直接使用区域端点也不符合“最少管 理”的要求。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: 使用 S3 Multi-Region Access Points 和跨区域复制： 正确性分析：S3 Multi-Region Access Points提供单一的全局端点，自动将用户数据发送到最辢的区域，减少公共网络拥堵。跨区域 复制确保数据同步，主动-主动配置提供高可用性和自动故障转移，符合“最少管理”的要求。 结论：此选项完全符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating a data center from its on-premises location to AWS. The company has several legacy applications that are hosted on individual virtual servers. Changes to the application designs cannot be made. Each individual virtual server currently runs as its own EC2 instance. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the applications are reliable and fault tolerant after migration to AWS. The applications will run on Amazon EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a minimum of one and a maximum of one. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Use the AMI to create EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group Configure an Application Load Balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Use AWS Backup to create an hourly backup of the EC2 instance that hosts each application. Store the backup in Amazon S3 in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a disaster recovery process to restore the EC2 instance for each application from its most recent backup.
options.C: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Launch two new EC2 instances from the AMI. Place each EC2 instance in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a Network Load Balancer that has the EC2 instances as targets.
options.D: Use AWS Mitigation Hub Refactor Spaces to migrate each application off the EC2 instance. Break down functionality from each application into individual components. Host each application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. IT

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a minimum of one and a maximum of one. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Use the AMI to create EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group Configure an Application Load Balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group. 分析： 使用Auto Scaling组可以确保实例的自动恢复，从而提高可靠性和容错性。 最小值为1、最大值为1的设置确保始终有一个实例运行，符合题目要求。 通过Application Load Balancer可以实现流量分发，进一步增强高可用性。 此选项正确，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Use AWS Backup to create an hourly backup of the EC2 instance that hosts each application. Store the backup in Amazon S3 in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a disaster recovery process to restore the EC2 instance for each application from its most recent backup. 分析： AWS Backup提供备份和恢复功能，但无法实现实时的高可用性和容错性。 灾难恢复流程需要手动干预，无法满足题目中对可靠性和容错性的要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Launch two new EC2 instances from the AMI. Place each EC2 instance in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a Network Load Balancer that has the EC2 instances as targets. 分析： 此选项通过在不同可用区部署两个实例和使用Network Load Balancer实现了高可用性。 然而，题目中明确指出每个应用程序只能运行在单个实例上，因此此选项不符合题目要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use AWS Mitigation Hub Refactor Spaces to migrate each application off the EC2 instance. Break down functionality from each application into individual components. Host each application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. 分析： 此选项涉及应用程序的重构，但题目明确指出不能对应用程序设计进行更改。 此选项不符合题目要求。 此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to isolate its workloads by creating an AWS account for each workload. The company needs a solution that centrally manages networking components for the workloads. The solution also must create accounts with automatic security controls (guardrails). Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Control Tower to deploy accounts. Create a networking account that has a VPC with private subnets and public subnets. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the subnets with the workload accounts.
options.B: Use AWS Organizations to deploy accounts. Create a networking account that has a VPC with private subnets and public subnets. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the subnets with the workload accounts.
options.C: Use AWS Control Tower to deploy accounts. Deploy a VPC in each workload account. Configure each VPC to route through an inspection VPC by using a transit gateway attachment.
options.D: Use AWS Organizations to deploy accounts. Deploy a VPC in each workload account. Configure each VPC to route through an inspection VPC by using a transit gateway attachment.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Control Tower部署账户。创建一个具有私有子网和公共子网的网络账户。使用AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM)与工作负载账户共享子网。 正确：AWS Control Tower可以自动化地创建和管理多个账户，同时提供预定义的安全控制（Guardrails）。 正确：通过创建一个专用的网络账户，可以集中管理网络资源（如VPC、子网）。 正确：AWS RAM允许跨账户共享资源（如子网），减少了重复配置的复杂性。 此选项满足题目要求，并且操作开销最小。
explanations.B: 使用AWS Organizations部署账户。创建一个具有私有子网和公共子网的网络账户。使用AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM)与工作负载账户共享子网。 部分正确：AWS Organizations可以用于账户管理，但它不提供自动化的安全控制（Guardrails）。 正确：创建一个专用的网络账户并使用AWS RAM共享资源是可行的。 错误：相比AWS Control Tower，AWS Organizations需要更多的孅动配置，增加了操作开销。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Control Tower部署账户。在每个工作负载账户中部署一个VPC。使用transit gateway attachment配置每个VPC通过 一个检查VPC进行路由。 部分正确：AWS Control Tower可以自动化地创建账户并提供安全控制。 错误：在每个工作负载账户中单独部署VPC会增加管理复杂性和操作开销。 正确：使用Transit Gateway可以实现跨VPC的路由，但这不是题目要求的最小操作开销解决方案。
explanations.D: 使用AWS Organizations部署账户。在每个工作负载账户中部署一个VPC。使用transit gateway attachment配置每个VPC通过 一个检查VPC进行路由。 部分正确：AWS Organizations可以用于账户管理，但它不提供自动化的安全控制（Guardrails）。 错误：在每个工作负载账户中单独部署VPC会增加管理复杂性和操作开销。 正确：使用Transit Gateway可以实现跨VPC的路由，但这不是题目要求的最小操作开销解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website serves static content. Website traffic is increasing. The company wants to minimize the website hosting costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the S3 bucket.
options.B: Move the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon ElastiCache cluster for the S3 bucket.
options.C: Move the website to AWS Amplify. Configure an ALB to resolve to the Amplify website.
options.D: Move the website to AWS Amplify. Configure EC2 instances to cache the website.

explanations.A: Move the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the S3 bucket. 正确：Amazon S3是托管静态网站的理想选择，成本低目易于扩展。 正确：Amazon CloudFront可以加速内容交付，减少延迟，并降低数据传输成本。 此选项完全符合题目要求：托管静态内容并最小化成本。
explanations.B: Move the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon ElastiCache cluster for the S3 bucket. 错误：Amazon ElastiCache主要用于缓存动态数据，而不是静态内容。 错误：S3本身已经是一个高效的静态内容存储解决方案，不需要额外的缓存层。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Move the website to AWS Amplify. Configure an ALB to resolve to the Amplify website. 错误：AWS Amplify主要用于构建和托管现代Web应用程序，而不是简单的静态内容托管。 错误：使用ALB会增加额外的成本，不符合“最小化成本”的要求。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Move the website to AWS Amplify. Configure EC2 instances to cache the website. 错误：AWS Amplify不需要EC2实例来缓存内容。 错误：使用EC2实例会显著增加成本，不符合“最小化成本”的要求。 此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a media application that the company hosts on AWS. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access stored data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.B: Create an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway. Configure tapes to use Amazon S3. Connect the application server to the Tape Gateway.
options.C: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Connect the application server to the file system.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway: Volume Gateway主要用于块存储（Block Storage），而不是文件存储（File Storage）。 虽然可以创建文件共享，但它并不直接支持SMB协议，目管理开销较高。 因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway: Tape Gateway主要用于备份和归档场景，模拟畭带设备。 它不支持文件共享功能，也不支持SMB协议。 此选项完全不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance: 通过EC2实例安装和配置Windows文件共享角色可以支持SMB协议。 但这种方法需要手动管理EC2实例，包括操作系统更新、备份和高可用性配置，管理开销较高。 因此此选项虽然可行，但不符合“最少的管理开销”要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server是专门设计用于支持Windows文件共享的托管服务，原生支持SMB协议。 它是一个完全托管的解决方案，提供高可用性、备份和性能优化，管理开销最低。 此选项完全符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing its production application's disaster recovery (DR) strategy. The application is backed by a MySQL database on an Amazon Aurora cluster in the us-east-1 Region. The company has chosen the us-west-1 Region as its DR Region. The company's target recovery point objective (RPO) is 5 minutes and the target recovery time objective (RTO) is 20 minutes. The company wants to minimize configuration changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an Aurora read replica in us-west-1 similar in size to the production application's Aurora MySQL cluster writer instance.
options.B: Convert the Aurora cluster to an Aurora global database. Configure managed failover.
options.C: Create a new Aurora cluster in us-west-1 that has Cross-Region Replication.
options.D: Create a new Aurora cluster in us-west-1. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to sync both clusters.

explanations.A: Create an Aurora read replica in us-west-1 similar in size to the production application's Aurora MySQL cluster writer instance. 正确性分析：Aurora支持跨区域只读副本，但这种方法无法满足5分钟的RPO，因为跨区域复制的延迟可能超过5分钟。此外，故障 转移需要手动配置，增加了操作复杂性。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Convert the Aurora cluster to an Aurora global database. Configure managed failover. 正确性分析：Aurora全球数据库支持跨区域复制，复制延迟通常在1秒以内，能够答案满足5分钟的RPO。此外，Aurora全球数据库 提供托管故障转移功能，能够快速切换到备用区域，满足20分钟的RTO，同时减少配置复杂性。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Create a new Aurora cluster in us-west-1 that has Cross-Region Replication. 正确性分析：跨区域复制可以实现数据同步，但这种方法需要手动配置故障转移，无法满足20分钟的RTO要求。此外，操作复杂性 较高。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Create a new Aurora cluster in us-west-1. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to sync both clusters. 正确性分析：AWS DMS可以实现数据同步，但其延迟可能较高，无法满足5分钟的RPO。此外，故障转移需要手动操作，无法满足 20分钟的RTO要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a critical data analysis job each week before the first day of the work week. The job requires at least 1 hour to complete the analysis. The job is stateful and cannot tolerate interruptions. The company needs a solution to run the job on AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a container for the job. Schedule the job to run as an AWS Fargate task on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster by using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler.
options.B: Configure the job to run in an AWS Lambda function. Create a scheduled rule in Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances that run Amazon Linux. Configure a crontab entry on the instances to run the analysis.
options.D: Configure an AWS DataSync task to run the job. Configure a cron expression to run the task on a schedule.

explanations.A: Create a container for the job. Schedule the job to run as an AWS Fargate task on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster by using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. 正确性分析：AWS Fargate是一个无服务器容器运行服务，支持运行长时间任务目不会中断。结合Amazon ECS和EventBridge Scheduler，可以可靠地调度任务并确保其运行完成。 优点：Fargate任务是无状态的，目不会受到底层基础设施的中断影响，非常适合运行关键任务。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: Configure the job to run in an AWS Lambda function. Create a scheduled rule in Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function. 正确性分析：AWS Lambda适合运行短时间任务（最长15分钟），而题目要求任务至少运行1小时，因此Lambda不适合此场景。 缺点：Lambda的运行时间限制无法满足任务需求。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances that run Amazon Linux. Configure a crontab entry on the instances to run the analysis. 正确性分析：EC2 Spot Instances价格低廉，但可能会被中断，无法保证任务的连续性。而题目明确要求任务不能容忍中断。 缺点：Spot Instances的中断风险使其不适合运行关键任务。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS DataSync task to run the job. Configure a cron expression to run the task on a schedule. 正确性分析：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移和同步，而不是运行计算任务。此选项与题目要求不符。 缺点：DataSync不适合运行分析任务。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company runs workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to centrally collect security data to assess security across the entire company and to improve workload protection. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Configure a data lake in AWS Lake Formation. Use AWS Glue crawlers to ingest the security data into the data lake. 4 AWS Lake Formation
options.B: Configure an AWS Lambda function to collect the security data in .csv format. Upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure a data lake in Amazon Security Lake to collect the security data. Upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. #£ Amazon Security Lake
options.D: Configure an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication instance to load the security data into an Amazon RDS cluster.

explanations.A: Configure a data lake in AWS Lake Formation. Use AWS Glue crawlers to ingest the security data into the data lake. 错误：AWS Lake Formation主要用于构建和管理数据湖，但它并不是专门为安全数据设计的解决方案。 需要额外的开发工作来配置Glue爬虫以收集和处理安全数据。
explanations.B: Configure an AWS Lambda function to collect the security data in .csv format. Upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. 错误：虽然Lambda可以用来收集数据并上传到S3，但这种方法需要编写和维护Lambda函数，开发工作量较大。 此外，这种方法缺乏专门的安全数据管理功能。
explanations.C: Configure a data lake in Amazon Security Lake to collect the security data. Upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确：Amazon Security Lake是专门设计用于集中收集和管理安全数据的服务。 它支持自动化数据收集和存储，减少了开发工作量。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication instance to load the security data into an Amazon RDS cluster. 错误：AWS DMS主要用于数据库迁移，而不是安全数据的集中收集和管理。 使用RDS存储安全数据需要额外的开发工作来设计和管理数据库架构。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating five on-premises applications to VPCs in the AWS Cloud. Each application is currently deployed in isolated virtual networks on premises and should be deployed similarly in the AWS Cloud. The applications need to reach a shared services VPC. All the applications must be able to communicate with each other. If the migration is successful, the company will repeat the migration process for more than 100 applications. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Deploy software VPN tunnels between the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC.
options.B: Deploy VPC peering connections between the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC through the peering connection.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Direct Connect connection between the application VPCs and the shared services VPAdd routes from the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC and the applications VPCs. Add routes from the shared services VPC subnets to the applications VPCs.
options.D: Deploy a transit gateway with associations between the transit gateway and the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets and the application VPCs to the shared services VPC through the transit gateway.

explanations.A: 部署软件VPN隧道： 正确性：软件VPN隧道可以实现VPC之间的通人，但需要孅动配置每个VPN连接，目管理开销较高。 错误原因：对于超过100个应用程序的场景，孅动配置和维护VPN隧道的管理开销非常大，不符合“最少管理开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 部署VPC Peering连接： 正确性：VPC Peering可以实现VPC之间的通人，但需要为每个VPC对孅动创建对等连接。 错误原因：随着应用程序数量增加，VPC Peering连接的数量会呈指数级增长，管理开销非常高，不适合大规模场景。
explanations.C: 部署AWS Direct Connect连接： 正确性：AWS Direct Connect主要用于连接本地数据中心和AWS云，而不是用于VPC之间的通人。 错误原因：Direct Connect不适合解决VPC之间的通人问题，目成本较高，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: 部署Transit Gateway： 正确性：Transit Gateway是专为大规模VPC通人设计的服务，可以答案管理多个VPC之间的连接。 正确原因：Transit Gateway支持集中式路由管理，减少了孅动配置的复杂性，目非常适合超过100个应用程序的场景。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to run its on-premises application in a hybrid environment. The application currently runs on containers on premises. The company needs a single container solution that can scale in an on-premises, hybrid, or cloud environment. The company must run new application containers in the AWS Cloud and must use a load balancer for HTTP traffic. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type for the cloud application containers. Use an Amazon ECS Anywhere external launch type for the on-premises application containers.
options.B: Set up an Application Load Balancer for cloud ECS services.
options.C: Set up a Network Load Balancer for cloud ECS services. FZ ECS
options.D: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Fargate for the cloud application containers and the on- premises application containers.
options.E: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the Amazon EC2 launch type forthe cloud application containers. Use Amazon ECS Anywhere with an AWS Fargate launch type for the on-premises application containers.

explanations.A: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type for the cloud application containers. Use an Amazon ECS Anywhere external launch type for the on-premises application containers. 正确：AWS Fargate是无服务器的容器运行方式，适合云端应用程序容器。Amazon ECS Anywhere允许在本地运行容器并与AWS集 成，满足混合环境需求。
explanations.B: Set up an Application Load Balancer for cloud ECS services. 正确：Application Load Balancer支持HTTP/HTTPS流量，是运行Web应用程序的最佳选择。
explanations.C: Set up a Network Load Balancer for cloud ECS services. 错误：Network Load Balancer主要用于处理TCP/UDP流量，而题目明确要求处理HTTP流量，因此不适合。
explanations.D: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Fargate for the cloud application containers and the on-premises application containers. 错误：AWS Fargate仅支持云端运行容器，无法直接用于本地环境。题目要求支持混合环境，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.E: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the Amazon EC2 launch type for the cloud application containers. Use Amazon ECS Anywhere with an AWS Fargate launch type for the on-premises application containers. 错误：Amazon ECS Anywhere不支持AWS Fargate启动类型用于本地环境。此选项与技术限制不符。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating its workloads to AWS. The company has sensitive and critical data in on-premises relational databases that run on SQL Server instances. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to increase security and reduce operational overhead for the databases. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the databases to Amazon EC2 instances. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for encryption.
options.B: Migrate the databases to a Multi-AZ Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for encryption.
options.C: Migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to ensure data security.
options.D: Migrate the databases to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to ensure data security.

explanations.A: Migrate the databases to Amazon EC2 instances. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for encryption. 错误：虽然可以在EC2实例上运行SQL Server并使用KMS进行加密，但这种方法增加了运维开销，因为需要手动管理EC2实例的操作 系统、数据库软件的安装和维护。 不符合题目要求的“减少运维开销”。
explanations.B: Migrate the databases to a Multi-AZ Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for encryption. 正确：Amazon RDS是托管服务，减少了运维开销，同时支持Multi-AZ部署以提高可用性。 RDS支持KMS进行数据加密，符合题目中对安全性的要求。 完全满足题目要求的“增加安全性”和“减少运维开销”。
explanations.C: Migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to ensure data security. 错误：Amazon S3是对象存储服务，不适合存储关系型数据库数据。 Amazon Macie主要用于识别敏感数据，而不是直接管理数据库的安全性。 不符合题目要求的“迁移关系型数据库”。
explanations.D: Migrate the databases to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to ensure data security. 错误：Amazon DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库服务，不适合迁移SQL Server关系型数据库。 CloudWatch Logs用于监控和日志记录，不直接提供数据安全功能。 不符合题目要求的“迁移关系型数据库”。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to migrate an application to AWS. The company wants to increase the application's current availability. The company wants to use AWS WAF in the application's architecture. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and set the Auto Scaling group as the target. Connect a WAF to the ALB.
options.B: Create a cluster placement group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that hosts the application. Configure an Application Load Balancer and set the EC2 instances as the targets. Connect a WAF to the placement group.
options.C: Create two Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure the EC2 instances as the targets of an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Connect a WAF to the ALB.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and set the Auto Scaling group as the target. Connect a WAF to the Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and set the Auto Scaling group as the target. Connect a WAF to the ALB. 正确：此选项通过Auto Scaling组实现动态扩展，并跨两个可用区部署EC2实例以提高可用性。 正确：使用Application Load Balancer分发流量，确保高性能和可靠性。 正确：将WAF连接到ALB是保护应用程序的最佳实践。
explanations.B: Create a cluster placement group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that hosts the application. Configure an Application Load Balancer and set the EC2 instances as the targets. Connect a WAF to the placement group. 错误：Cluster placement group主要用于低延迟、高性能计算，而不是提高可用性。 错误：此选项未跨多个可用区部署资源，无法满足高可用性要求。 正确：WAF可以连接到ALB，但此选项的架构设计不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create two Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure the EC2 instances as the targets of an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Connect a WAF to the ALB. 正确：跨两个可用区部署EC2实例可以提高可用性。 错误：仅使用两个EC2实例没有动态扩展能力，无法满足需求变化。 正确：WAF连接到ALB是保护应用程序的最佳实践。
explanations.D: Create an Auto Scaling group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and set the Auto Scaling group as the target. Connect a WAF to the Auto Scaling group. 正确：Auto Scaling组和跨两个可用区的部署可以提高可用性。 错误：WAF无法直接连接到Auto Scaling组，WAF只能连接到ALB。

question: Topic 1 A company manages a data lake in an Amazon S3 bucket that numerous applications access. The S3 bucket contains a unique prefix for each application. The company wants to restrict each application to its specific prefix and to have granular control of the objects under each prefix. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create dedicated S3 access points and access point policies for each application.
options.B: Create an S3 Batch Operations job to set the ACL permissions for each object in the S3 bucket.
options.C: Replicate the objects in the S3 bucket to new S3 buckets for each application. Create replication rules by prefix.
options.D: Replicate the objects in the S3 bucket to new S3 buckets for each application. Create dedicated S3 access points for each application.

explanations.A: Create dedicated S3 access points and access point policies for each application. 正确：S3 Access Points允许为桹个应用程序创建栘立的访问点，并通过Access Point Policies实现基于前缀的权限管理。这种方法可 以直接限制桹个应用程序访问特定的前缀，同时减少操作开销。
explanations.B: Create an S3 Batch Operations job to set the ACL permissions for each object in the S3 bucket. 错误：S3 Batch Operations适用于批量处理对象，但ACL权限管理是基于对象的，无法实现基于前缀的权限控制。此外，ACL的管理 复杂性较高，操作开销较大。
explanations.C: Replicate the objects in the S3 bucket to new S3 buckets for each application. Create replication rules by prefix. 错误：创建多个S3 bucket并设置复制规则会增加存储成本和管理复杂性。虽然可以通过前缀实现分离，但这种方法的操作开销较 高，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Replicate the objects in the S3 bucket to new S3 buckets for each application. Create dedicated S3 access points for each application. 错误：虽然S3 Access Points可以简化权限管理，但复制对象到多个S3 bucket会增加存储成本和管理复杂性。这种方法的操作开销 较高。

question: Topic 1 A company has an application that customers use to upload images to an Amazon S3 bucket. Each night, the company launches an Amazon EC2 Spot Fleet that processes all the images that the company received that day. The processing for each image takes 2 minutes and requires 512 MB of memory. A solutions architect needs to change the application to process the images when the images are uploaded. Which change will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use S3 Event Notifications to write a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function to read the messages from the queue and to process the images.
options.B: Use S3 Event Notifications to write a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an EC2 Reserved Instance to read the messages from the queue and to process the images.
options.C: Use S3 Event Notifications to publish a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure a container instance in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to subscribe to the topic and to process the images.
options.D: Use S3 Event Notifications to publish a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application to subscribe to the topic and to process the images.

explanations.A: Use S3 Event Notifications to write a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function to read the messages from the queue and to process the images. 正确：S3 Event Notifications可以触发消息写入SQS队列，AWS Lambda可以无服务器地处理这些消息，目Lambda函数的按需计费 模式非常适合短时间处理任务（如2分钟）。 成本效益高：Lambda函数无需预置资源，目512 MB内存需求完全在Lambda的支持范围内。
explanations.B: Use S3 Event Notifications to write a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an EC2 Reserved Instance to read the messages from the queue and to process the images. 错误：虽然EC2 Reserved Instance可以处理任务，但它需要预置资源并支付固定费用，即使没有任务运行时也会产生成本。 不符合成本效益：相比Lambda，EC2 Reserved Instance的成本更高，目管理复杂度更大。
explanations.C: Use S3 Event Notifications to publish a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure a container instance in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to subscribe to the topic and to process the images. 错误：SNS无法直接触发ECS容器实例，ECS需要额外的任务调度和管理，增加了复杂性。 成本效益较低：ECS容器实例需要持痲运行或调度，可能会产生额外的费用。
explanations.D: Use S3 Event Notifications to publish a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application to subscribe to the topic and to process the images. 错误：Elastic Beanstalk适合运行复杂的应用程序，但对于简单的图像处理任务来说过于复杂目成本较高。 不符合成本效益：Elastic Beanstalk需要持痲运行环境，可能会产生额外的费用。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to improve the availability and performance of its hybrid application. The application consists of a stateful TCP- based workload hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in different AWS Regions and a stateless UDP-based workload hosted on premises. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to improve availability and performance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator. Add the load balancers as endpoints.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the load balancers.
options.C: Configure two Application Load Balancers in each Region. The first will route to the EC2 endpoints, and the second will route to the on-premises endpoints.
options.D: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints.
options.E: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure an Application Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints.

explanations.A: Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator. Add the load balancers as endpoints. 正确。AWS Global Accelerator可以通过优化路由来提高跨区域应用的性能和可用性。将负载均衡器作为端点可以支持跨区域流量管 理。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the load balancers. 错误。CloudFront主要用于内容分发（CDN），而题目中的应用是基于TCP和UDP的工作负载，CloudFront不适合处理这种类型的 流量。
explanations.C: Configure two Application Load Balancers in each Region. The first will route to the EC2 endpoints, and the second will route to the on-premises endpoints. 错误。Application Load Balancer主要用于HTTP/HTTPS流量，而题目中的工作负载是基于TCP和UDP的，使用ALB不合适。
explanations.D: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints. 正确。Network Load Balancer支持TCP和UDP流量，适合处理题目中的工作负载。配置NLB可以提高可用性和性能。
explanations.E: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure an Application Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints. 错误。虽然NLB适合处理EC2端点的TCP/UDP流量，但ALB不适合处理本地端点的TCP/UDP流量。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a self-managed Microsoft SQL Server on Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). Daily snapshots are taken of the EBS volumes. Recently, all the company’s EBS snapshots were accidentally deleted while running a snapshot cleaning script that deletes all expired EBS snapshots. A solutions architect needs to update the architecture to prevent data loss without retaining EBS snapshots indefinitely. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Change the IAM policy of the user to deny EBS snapshot deletion.
options.B: Copy the EBS snapshots to another AWS Region after completing the snapshots daily.
options.C: Create a 7-day EBS snapshot retention rule in Recycle Bin and apply the rule for all snapshots. ££ Recycle Bin
options.D: Copy EBS snapshots to Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).

explanations.A: Change the IAM policy of the user to deny EBS snapshot deletion. 正确性分析：虽然更改IAM策略可以防止用户删除快照，但这并不能解决问题，因为脚本可能是由具有更高权限的用户或角色运行 的。此外，IAM策略的修改需要精确控制，可能会影响其他操作。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Copy the EBS snapshots to another AWS Region after completing the snapshots daily. 正确性分析：跨区域复制可以提供额外的灾备保护，但这需要额外的开发工作来实现自动化，并且无法解决快照被删除的问题，因 为删除操作可能会影响所有区域的快照。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create a 7-day EBS snapshot retention rule in Recycle Bin and apply the rule for all snapshots. 正确性分析：Recycle Bin是AWS提供的功能，用于防止意外删除快照。通过设置保留规则，可以确保快照在一定时间内不会被永久 删除，从而有效防止数据丢失。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.D: Copy EBS snapshots to Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). 正确性分析：将EBS快照复制到S3需要额外的开发工作，并且S3存储快照的成本可能较高。此外，这种方法无法直接防止快照被删 除的问题。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to use an AWS CloudFormation stack for its application in a test environment. The company stores the CloudFormation template in an Amazon S3 bucket that blocks public access. The company wants to grant CloudFormation access to the template in the S3 bucket based on specific user requests to create the test environment. The solution must follow security best practices. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the S3 object URL.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API that has the S3 bucket as the target. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the API Gateway URL.
options.C: Create a presigned URL for the template object. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the presigned URL.
options.D: Allow public access to the template object in the S3 bucket. Block the public access after the test environment is created.

explanations.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the S3 object URL. 错误：虽然创建VPC终端节点可以增强安全性，但它并不能解决基于特定用户请求的访问控制问题。VPC终端节点的主要作用是提 供私有网痬访问，而不是动态控制访问权限。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API that has the S3 bucket as the target. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the API Gateway URL. 错误：使用API Gateway将S3作为目标是一种复杂目不必要的解决方案。它增加了额外的管理开销，并且不符合简单、安全的最佳 实践。
explanations.C: Create a presigned URL for the template object. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the presigned URL. 正确：预疮名URL允许临时访问S3对象，并且可以基于特定用户请求动态椹成。这种方法符合AWS安全最佳实践，因为它避免了公 开访问，同时提供了棬梮性。
explanations.D: Allow public access to the template object in the S3 bucket. Block the public access after the test environment is created. 错误：允许公共访问违反了AWS安全最佳实践，即使是临时的公共访问也可能带来安全风险。

question: Topic 1 A company has applications that run in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company outsources operational support of the applications. The company needs to provide access for the external support engineers without compromising security. The external support engineers need access to the AWS Management Console. The external support engineers also need operating system access to the company’s fleet ofAmazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux in private subnets. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Confirm that AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) is installed on all instances. Assign an instance profile with the necessary policy to connect to Systems Manager. Use AWS IAM Identity Center to provide the external support engineers console access. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to assign the required permissions.
options.B: Confirm that AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) is installed on all instances. Assign an instance profile with the necessary policy to connect to Systems Manager. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to provide local IAM user credentials in each AWS account to the external support engineers for console access.
options.C: Confirm that all instances have a security group that allows SSH access only from the external support engineers’ source IP address ranges. Provide local IAM user credentials in each AWS account to the external support engineers for console access. Provide each external support engineer an SSH key pair to log in to the application instances.
options.D: Create a bastion host in a public subnet. Set up the bastion host security group to allow access from only the external engineers’ IP address ranges. Ensure that all instances have a security group that allows SSH access from the bastion host. Provide each external support engineer an SSH key pair to log in to the application instances. Provide local account IAM user credentials to the engineers for console access.

explanations.A: Confirm that AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) is installed on all instances. Assign an instance profile with the necessary policy to connect to Systems Manager. Use AWS IAM Identity Center to provide the external support engineers console access. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to assign the required permissions. 正确：此选项使用AWS Systems Manager Session Manager提供对EC2实例的操作系统访问，避免了直接暴需SSH端口，符合安全性 最佳实践。 正确：使用IAM Identity Center为外部支持工程宵提供控制台访问权限，集中管理用户身份，避免了创建本地IAM用户的复杂性。 正确：确保SSM Agent安装并配置了必要的权限，支持通过Session Manager进行安全访问。
explanations.B: Confirm that AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) is installed on all instances. Assign an instance profile with the necessary policy to connect to Systems Manager. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to provide local IAM user credentials in each AWS account to the external support engineers for console access. 错误：虽然使用了Session Manager，但为外部支持工程宵提供本地IAM用户认证增加了管理复杂性，并且不符合集中管理用户身份 的最佳实践。 错误：本地IAM用户的使用可能导致安全性问题，例如认证泄需或难以撤销访问权限。
explanations.C: Confirm that all instances have a security group that allows SSH access only from the external support engineers’ source IP address ranges. Provide local IAM user credentials in each AWS account to the external support engineers for console access. Provide each external support engineer an SSH key pair to log in to the application instances. 错误：直接暴需SSH端口，即使限制了IP地址范围，也增加了潜在的安全风险。 错误：使用本地IAM用户和SSH密钥对增加了管理复杂性，并且不符合现代化的安全性最佳实践。
explanations.D: Create a bastion host in a public subnet. Set up the bastion host security group to allow access from only the external engineers’ IP address ranges. Ensure that all instances have a security group that allows SSH access from the bastion host. Provide each external support engineer an SSH key pair to log in to the application instances. Provide local account IAM user credentials to the engineers for console access. 错误：使用跳板机（bastion host）虽然是一种传统方法，但仍然依赖SSH访问，增加了安全风险。 错误：本地IAM用户和SSH密钥对的使用增加了管理复杂性，并且不符合集中管理用户身份的最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company uses Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to run its applications in the us-east-1 Region. The company also uses machine learning (ML) models to forecast annual revenue based on near real-time reports. The reports are generated by using the same RDS for PostgreSQL database. The database performance slows during business hours. The company needs to improve database performance. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a cross-Region read replica. Configure the reports to be generated from the read replica.
options.B: Activate Multi-AZ DB instance deployment for RDS for PostgreSQL. Configure the reports to be generated from the standby database.
options.C: Use AWS Data Migration Service (AWS DMS) to logically replicate data to a new database. Configure the reports to be generated from the new database.
options.D: Create a read replica in us-east-1. Configure the reports to be generated from the read replica.

explanations.A: Create a cross-Region read replica. Configure the reports to be generated from the read replica. 正确性分析：跨区域读副本可以分担读取负载，但它主要用于跨区域灾备或跨区域访问场景，而不是解决同一区域的性能问题。 成本分析：跨区域读副本会产生额外的跨区域数据传输费用，成本较高。 结论：此选项不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: Activate Multi-AZ DB instance deployment for RDS for PostgreSQL. Configure the reports to be generated from the standby database. 正确性分析：Multi-AZ部署主要用于高可用性和故障转移，备用数据库是同步复制的，不能用于读取操作。 成本分析：Multi-AZ部署会增加成本，但无法解决性能问题。 结论：此选项不符合要求。
explanations.C: Use AWS Data Migration Service (AWS DMS) to logically replicate data to a new database. Configure the reports to be generated from the new database. 正确性分析：AWS DMS可以用于数据复制，但设置和维护迂辑复制的复杂性较高，目需要额外的数据库实例。 成本分析：需要额外的数据库实例和DMS服务费用，成本较高。 结论：此选项不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.D: Create a read replica in us-east-1. Configure the reports to be generated from the read replica. 正确性分析：读副本可以分担读取负载，适合生成报告的场景。 成本分析：读副本的成本相对较低，目无需额外的复杂配置。 结论：此选项符合“最具成本效益”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its multi-tier, public web application in the AWS Cloud. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances, and its database runs on Amazon RDS. The company is anticipating a large increase in sales during an upcoming holiday weekend. A solutions architect needs to build a solution to analyze the performance of the web application with a granularity of no more than 2 minutes. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Send Amazon CloudWatch logs to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Quicks ght to perform further analysis.
options.B: Enable detailed monitoring on all EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to perform further analysis.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to fetch EC2 logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to perform further analysis.
options.D: Send EC2 logs to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift to fetch logs from the S3 bucket to process raw data for further analysis with Amazon QuickSight.

explanations.A: Send Amazon CloudWatch logs to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon QuickSight to perform further analysis. 错误：将CloudWatch日志发送到Redshift并使用QuickSight进行分析虽然可以实现数据分析，但这种方法不适合实时性能监控，尤 其是要求2分钟的粒度。 Redshift更适合处理批量数据，而不是实时数据分析。
explanations.B: Enable detailed monitoring on all EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to perform further analysis. 正确：启用EC2实例的详细监控后，CloudWatch可以提供更高粒度的指标（每分钟一次），满足2分钟粒度的要求。 CloudWatch Metrics是专门设计用于实时性能监控的工具。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to fetch EC2 logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to perform further analysis. 错误：使用Lambda函数从CloudWatch Logs中提取日志并进行分析是一种复杂目不必要的解决方案。 CloudWatch Metrics已经可以直接提供所需的性能数据，无需额外的Lambda函数。
explanations.D: Send EC2 logs to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift to fetch logs from the S3 bucket to process raw data for further analysis with Amazon QuickSight. 错误：将日志发送到S3并使用Redshift和QuickSight进行分析是一种适合长期数据分析的解决方案，但不适合实时性能监控。 这种方法无法满足2分钟粒度的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an application that stores and shares photos. Users upload the photos to an Amazon S3 bucket. Every day, users upload approximately 150 photos. The company wants to design a solution that creates a thumbnail of each new photo and stores the thumbnail in a second S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
