options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke a script every minute on a long-running Amazon EMR cluster. Configure the script to generate thumbnails for the photos that do not have thumbnails. Configure the script to upload the thumbnails to the second S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke a script every minute on a memory-optimized Amazon EC2 instance that is always on. Configure the script to generate thumbnails for the photos that do not have thumbnails. Configure the script to upload the thumbnails to the second S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure an S3 event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function each time a user uploads a new photo to the application. Configure the Lambda function to generate a thumbnail and to upload the thumbnail to the second S3 bucket.
options.D: Configure S3 Storage Lens to invoke an AWS Lambda function each time a user uploads a new photo to the application. Configure the Lambda function to generate a thumbnail and to upload the thumbnail to a second S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 配置 Amazon EventBridge 定时规则调用脚本运行在长期运行的 Amazon EMR 集群上： 错误：Amazon EMR 是为大规模数据处理设计的，运行一个长期集群成本较高，不适合处理每天仅150张照片的任务。 错误：EventBridge 定时规则每分钟触发脚本，可能会导致资源浪费，因为任务量较小。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon EventBridge 定时规则调用脚本运行在始终开启的内存优化型 Amazon EC2 实例上： 错误：始终开启的 EC2 实例会产生持痲的成本，即使没有任务运行时也会收费。 错误：EventBridge 定时规则每分钟触发脚本，可能会导致资源浪费，目内存优化型实例不必要。
explanations.C: 配置 S3 事件通知调用 AWS Lambda 函数： 正确：S3 事件通知可以在用户上传新照片时自动触发 Lambda 函数，无需定时规则。 正确：AWS Lambda 是无服务器计算服务，按需运行，成本低目适合处理小规模任务。 正确：Lambda 函数可以直接生成缩略图并上传到疦二个 S3 bucket，符合需求。
explanations.D: 配置 S3 Storage Lens 调用 AWS Lambda 函数： 错误：S3 Storage Lens 是用于存储分析的工具，不能直接触发 Lambda 函数。 错误：此选项描述的功能与 S3 Storage Lens的实际用途不符。

question: Topic 1 A company has stored millions of objects across multiple prefixes in an Amazon S3 bucket by using the Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class. The company needs to delete all data older than 3 years except for a subset of data that must be retained. The company has identified the data that must be retained and wants to implement a serverless solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use S3 Inventory to list all objects. Use the AWS CLI to create a script that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance that deletes objects from the inventory list.
options.B: Use AWS Batch to delete objects older than 3 years except for the data that must be retained.
options.C: Provision an AWS Glue crawler to query objects older than 3 years. Save the manifest file of old objects. Create a script to delete objects in the manifest.
options.D: Enable S3 Inventory. Create an AWS Lambda function to filter and delete objects. Invoke the Lambda function with S3 Batch Operations to delete objects by using the inventory reports.

explanations.A: 使用 S3 Inventory 列出所有对象。使用 AWS CLI 创建一个脚本，该脚本在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行，从清单列表中删除对 象。 错误：虽然S3 Inventory可以列出所有对象，但使用EC2实例运行脚本并非无服务器解决方案，目需要额外的管理和维护工作。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Batch 删除超过 3 年的数据，除了需要保留的数据。 错误：AWS Batch主要用于运行批处理计算任务，而不是直接用于管理S3对象。此选项不适合解决S3对象删除问题。
explanations.C: 配置一个 AWS Glue 爬虫以查询超过 3 年的对象。保存旧对象的清单文件。创建一个脚本以删除清单中的对象。 错误：AWS Glue主要用于数据分析和ETL任务，而不是直接用于管理S3对象。此选项复杂目不符合无服务器解决方案的要求。
explanations.D: 启用 S3 Inventory。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数以过滤和删除对象。使用 S3 Batch Operations 调用 Lambda 函数以通过清 单报告删除对象。 正确：此选项使用S3 Inventory生成对象列表，结合S3 Batch Operations和AWS Lambda实现无服务器解决方案，符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is building an application on AWS. The application uses multiple AWS Lambda functions to retrieve sensitive data from a single Amazon S3 bucket for processing. The company must ensure that only authorized Lambda functions can access the data. The solution must comply with the principle of least privilege. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Grant full S3 bucket access to all Lambda functions through a shared IAM role.
options.B: Configure the Lambda functions to run within a VPC. Configure a bucket policy to grant access based on the Lambda functions’ VPC endpoint IP addresses.
options.C: Create individual IAM roles for each Lambda function. Grant the IAM roles access to the S3 bucket. Assign each IAM role as the Lambda execution role for its corresponding Lambda function.
options.D: Configure a bucket policy granting access to the Lambda functions based on their function ARNs.

explanations.A: Grant full S3 bucket access to all Lambda functions through a shared IAM role. 错误原因：此选项违反了最小权限原则，因为它授予所有Lambda函数完全的S3存储框访问权限，而不是根据桹个函数的具体需求 进行权限限制。
explanations.B: Configure the Lambda functions to run within a VPC. Configure a bucket policy to grant access based on the Lambda functions' VPC endpoint IP addresses. 错误原因：基于VPC端点IP地址的访问控制不适合Lambda函数，因为Lambda函数的IP地址可能会动态变化。此外，这种方法复杂 目不符合最佳实践。
explanations.C: Create individual IAM roles for each Lambda function. Grant the IAM roles access to the S3 bucket. Assign each IAM role as the Lambda execution role for its corresponding Lambda function. 正确原因：此选项符合最小权限原则。为桹个Lambda函数创建单栘的IAM角色，并根据需要授予访问权限，确保只有授权的函数可 以访问S3存储框。
explanations.D: Configure a bucket policy granting access to the Lambda functions based on their function ARNs. 错误原因：虽然可以通过存储框策略基于函数ARN授予访问权限，但这种方法不够棬梮目难以管理。IAM角色是更推荐的方式，因 为它可以更好地与Lambda函数的执行角色集成。

question: Topic 1 A company has developed a non-production application that is composed of multiple microservices for each of the company's business units. A single development team maintains all the microservices. The current architecture uses a static web frontend and a Java-based backend that contains the application logic. The architecture also uses a MySQL database that the company hosts on an Amazon EC2 instance. The company needs to ensure that the application is secure and available globally. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudFront and AWS Amplify to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that the microservices access by using Amazon API Gateway. Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance. {FA Amazon CloudFront 和 AWS Amplify
options.B: Use Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that the microservices access by using Amazon API Gateway. Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL. (FA Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3
options.C: Use Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that are in a target group behind a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL. (FA Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3
options.D: Use Amazon S3 to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that are in a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon CloudFront和AWS Amplify托管静态网页前端。将布服务重构为使用AWS Lambda函数，并通过Amazon API Gateway访问这些布服务。将MySQL数据库迁移到Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance。 正确点：使用Amazon CloudFront可以提高全球可用性，AWS Amplify可以托管静态网页。 错误点：将数据库迁移到Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance仍然需要手动管理数据库实例，增加了运营开销，不符合“最少运营开销”的 要求。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon CloudFront和Amazon S3托管静态网页前端。将布服务重构为使用AWS Lambda函数，并通过Amazon API Gateway访问这些布服务。将MySQL数据库迁移到Amazon RDS for MySQL。 正确点：使用Amazon CloudFront和Amazon S3托管静态网页前端是最佳实践，减少了运营开销。AWS Lambda和Amazon API Gateway构建无服务器架构，进一步降低了管理复杂性。将数据库迁移到Amazon RDS for MySQL是托管服务，减少了数据库管理的 运营开销。 错误点：无明显错误。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon CloudFront和Amazon S3托管静态网页前端。将布服务重构为使用AWS Lambda函数，这些函数位于Network Load Balancer后的目标组中。将MySQL数据库迁移到Amazon RDS for MySQL。 正确点：使用Amazon CloudFront和Amazon S3托管静态网页前端是正确的。将数据库迁移到Amazon RDS for MySQL也是正确的。 错误点：AWS Lambda通常与API Gateway集成，而不是与Network Load Balancer集成。Network Load Balancer主要用于处理高知 吐量的TCP/UDP流量，不适合Lambda函数的场景。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon S3托管静态网页前端。将布服务重构为使用AWS Lambda函数，这些函数位于Application Load Balancer后的目 标组中。将MySQL数据库迁移到Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance。 正确点：使用Amazon S3托管静态网页前端是正确的。 错误点：将Lambda函数放在Application Load Balancer后虽然技术上可行，但通常不如API Gateway集成高效。将数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance增加了运营开销，不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A video game company is deploying a new gaming application to its global users. The company requires a solution that will provide near real-time reviews and rankings of the players. A solutions architect must design a solution to provide fast access to the data. The solution must also ensure the data persists on disks in the event that the company restarts the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket as the origin. Store the player data in the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. Store the player data on the EC2 instances. Configure Amazon Route 53 with geolocation records to direct users to the closest EC2 instance.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis duster. Store the player data in the ElastiCache cluster.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached duster. Store the player data in the ElastiCache cluster.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket as the origin. Store the player data in the S3 bucket. 错误原因：Amazon S3是一个对象存储服务，适合存储静态文件，但不适合实时数据访问。CloudFront可以加速内容分发，但无法 满足实时性和数据持久性要求。
explanations.B: Create Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. Store the player data on the EC2 instances. Configure Amazon Route 53 with geolocation records to direct users to the closest EC2 instance. 错误原因：虽然EC2实例可以存储数据并通过Route 53实现地理位置路由，但需要手动管理实例的高可用性和数据持久性，运维开 销较高，不符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Store the player data in the ElastiCache cluster. 正确原因：ElastiCache for Redis支持高性能、低延迟的数据访问，并且可以配置持久化以确保数据在应用重启时不会丢失。Redis还 支持复杂的数据结构，非常适合实时排名和评论功能。
explanations.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster. Store the player data in the ElastiCache cluster. 错误原因：虽然Memcached也支持高性能数据访问，但它不支持数据持久化功能，因此无法满足“数据在应用重启时不会丢失”的要 求。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing an application on AWS that processes sensitive data. The application stores and processes financial data for multiple customers. To meet compliance requirements, the data for each customer must be encrypted separately at rest by using a secure, centralized key management solution. The company wants to use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to implement encryption. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Generate a unique encryption key for each customer. Store the keys in an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable server-side encryption.
options.B: Deploy a hardware security appliance in the AWS environment that securely stores customer-provided encryption keys. Integrate the security appliance with AWS KMS to encrypt the sensitive data in the application.
options.C: Create a single AWS KMS key to encrypt all sensitive data across the application.
options.D: Create separate AWS KMS keys for each customer's data that have granular access control and logging enabled.

explanations.A: Generate a unique encryption key for each customer. Store the keys in an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable server-side encryption. 错误原因：将加密密钥存储在Amazon S3橘中并启用服务器端加密并不符合最佳实践。AWS KMS是专门设计用于安全管理加密密钥 的服务，直接使用KMS会更安全目操作开销更低。 此外，S3的服务器端加密无法提供对每个客户数据的单独加密和访问控制。
explanations.B: Deploy a hardware security appliance in the AWS environment that securely stores customer-provided encryption keys. Integrate the security appliance with AWS KMS to encrypt the sensitive data in the application. 错误原因：部署畦件安全设备会增加操作开销和复杂性，不符合题目要求的“最小化操作开销”。 虽然可以实现加密，但AWS KMS本身已经提供了安全的密钥管理功能，无需额外的畦件设备。
explanations.C: Create a single AWS KMS key to encrypt all sensitive data across the application. 错误原因：使用单一的KMS密钥无法满足题目中“每个客户的数据必须单独加密”的合规性要求。 单一密钥无法提供细粒度的访问控制和日志记录。
explanations.D: Create separate AWS KMS keys for each customer's data that have granular access control and logging enabled. 正确原因：为每个客户的数据创建单独的KMS密钥可以满足合规性要求，即每个客户的数据必须单独加密。 启用细粒度的访问控制和日志记录可以确保安全性和可审计性。 使用AWS KMS可以最小化操作开销，因为它是一个托管服务，提供了自动化的密钥管理功能。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to design a resilient web application to process customer orders. The web application must automatically handle increases in web traffic and application usage without affecting the customer experience or losing customer orders. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a NAT gateway to manage web traffic. Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to receive, process, and store processed customer orders. Use an AWS Lambda function to capture and store unprocessed orders.
options.B: Use a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to manage web traffic. Use an Application Load Balancer to receive customer orders from the NLUse Amazon Redshift with a Multi-AZ deployment to store unprocessed and processed customer orders.
options.C: Use a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) to manage web traffic. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to receive and process customer orders. Use the GWLB to capture and store unprocessed orders. Use Amazon DynamoDB to store processed customer orders.
options.D: Use an Application Load Balancer to manage web traffic. Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to receive and process customer orders. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to store unprocessed orders. Use Amazon RDS with a Multi-AZ deployment to store processed customer orders.

explanations.A: 使用 NAT gateway 管理网络流量。使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组来接收、处理和存储已处理的客户订单。使用 AWS Lambda 函数来捕获和存储未处理的订单。 错误： NAT Gateway 主要用于管理出站流量，而不是处理 Web 应用的流量。它不适合用来管理客户订单的流量。 正确： Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组可以处理弹性扩展需求。 错误： AWS Lambda 不适合直接捕获和存储未处理的订单，缺乏队列机制。
explanations.B: 使用 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 管理网络流量。使用 Application Load Balancer 从 NLB 接收客户订单。使用 Amazon Redshift 的 Multi-AZ 部署来存储未处理和已处理的客户订单。 错误： Network Load Balancer 适用于处理低延迟和 TCP/UDP 流量，但不适合 Web 应用的 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。 正确： Application Load Balancer 适合处理 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。 错误： Amazon Redshift 是数据仓库服务，不适合用来存储实时订单数据。
explanations.C: 使用 Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) 管理网络流量。使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 来接收和处理 客户订单。使用 GWLB 来捕获和存储未处理的订单。使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储已处理的客户订单。 错误： Gateway Load Balancer 主要用于管理第三方虚拟网络设备流量，不适合处理 Web 应用流量。 正确： Amazon ECS 可以处理弹性扩展需求。 错误： GWLB 不具备存储未处理订单的功能。 正确： Amazon DynamoDB 是高性能的 NoSQL 数据库，但题目中更适合使用关系型数据库（如 RDS）。
explanations.D: 使用 Application Load Balancer 管理网络流量。使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组来接收和处理客户订单。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 存储未处理的订单。使用 Amazon RDS 的 Multi-AZ 部署存储已处理的客户订单。 正确： Application Load Balancer 适合处理 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。 正确： Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组可以处理弹性扩展需求。 正确： Amazon SQS 是队列服务，适合存储未处理的订单，确保订单不会丢失。 正确： Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 提供高可用性和持久性，适合存储已处理的订单。

question: Topic 1 A company is using AWS DataSync to migrate millions of files from an on-premises system to AWS. The files are 10 KB in size on average. The company wants to use Amazon S3 for file storage. For the first year after the migration, the files will be accessed once or twice and must be immediately available. After 1 year, the files must be archived for at least 7 years. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use an archive tool to group the files into large objects. Use DataSync to migrate the objects. Store the objects in S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval for the first year. Use a lifecycle configuration to transition the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.
options.B: Use an archive tool to group the files into large objects. Use DataSync to copy the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-lA). Use a lifecycle configuration to transition the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.
options.C: Configure the destination storage class for the files as S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.
options.D: Configure a DataSync task to transfer the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use a lifecycle configuration to transition the files to S3 Deep Archive after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.

explanations.A: 使用归档工具将文件分组为大型对象。使用 DataSync 迁移这些对象。在第一年将对象存储在 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 中。 使用生命周期配置在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，保留期为 7 年。 正确：将小文件分组为大型对象可以减少存储和请求成本，特别是在归档场景中。 正确：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval提供低延迟访问，适合疦一年需要立即访问的场景。 正确：使用生命周期配置将文件迁移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive可以显著降低长期存储成本。
explanations.B: 使用归档工具将文件分组为大型对象。使用 DataSync 将对象复制到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。使用 生命周期配置在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，保留期为 7 年。 错误：S3 Standard-IA适合低访问频率的场景，但疦一年需要立即访问的场景更适合S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。 错误：将文件从S3 Standard-IA迁移到S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval不符合成本优化的要求。
explanations.C: 将文件的目标存储类别配置为 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。使用生命周期策略在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，保留期为 7 年。 错误：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval的访问延迟较高，不适合疦一年需要立即访问的场景。 错误：题目要求在1年后使用S3 Glacier Deep Archive，而不是S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。
explanations.D: 配置一个 DataSync 任务，将文件传输到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。使用生命周期配置在 1 年后将文 件转换到 S3 Deep Archive，保留期为 7 年。 错误：S3 Standard-IA不适合疦一年需要立即访问的场景。 错误：题目要求疦一年使用S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，而不是S3 Standard-IA。

question: Topic 1 A company recently performed a lift and shift migration of its on-premises Oracle database workload to run on an Amazon EC2 memory optimized Linux instance. The EC2 Linux instance uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume with 64,000 IOPS. The database storage performance after the migration is slower than the performance of the on-premises database. Which solution will improve storage performance?

options.A: Add more Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volumes. Use OS commands to create a Logical Volume Management (LVM) stripe
options.B: Increase the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to more than 64,000 IOPS.
options.C: Increase the size of the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to 2 TB.
options.D: Change the EC2 Linux instance to a storage optimized instance type. Do not change the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume.

explanations.A: Add more Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volumes. Use OS commands to create a Logical Volume Management (LVM) stripe. 正确：通过添加更多的io1卷并使用LVM条带化，可以实现并行读写操作，从而显著提高存储性能。 条带化是一种常见的性能优化技术，尤其适用于高性能数据库工作负载。
explanations.B: Increase the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to more than 64,000 IOPS. 错误：单个io1卷的最大IOPS限制为64,000（在Nitro系统上为256,000），因此无法通过增加IOPS超过64,000来解决问题。 即使增加IOPS到最大值，也可能无法满足数据库的性能需求。
explanations.C: Increase the size of the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to 2 TB. 错误：增加卷的大小不会直接提高IOPS性能。IOPS与卷大小相关，但问题的核心是性能不足，而不是存储容量不足。
explanations.D: Change the EC2 Linux instance to a storage optimized instance type. Do not change the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume. 错误：存储优化实例类型（如I3或I3en）通常使用本地NVMe存储，而不是EBS卷。如果继续使用EBS卷，改变实例类型不会显著提 高性能。 问题的核心在于EBS卷的性能，而不是实例类型。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating from a monolithic architecture for a web application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 to a serverless microservices architecture. The company wants to use AWS services that support an event-driven, loosely coupled architecture. The company wants to use the publish/subscribe (pub/sub) pattern. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure one or more subscribers to read events from the SQS queue.
options.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the SNS topic.
options.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to write to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with enhanced fan-out. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the data stream.
options.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the topic.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure one or more subscribers to read events from the SQS queue. 正确性分析：Amazon SQS是一个队列服务，适合点对点消息传递，而不是Pub/Sub模式。虽然可以通过多个消费者读取队列中的消 息，但它不完全符合Pub/Sub的设计模式。 成本分析：使用SQS可能会增加成本，因为需要额外的队列管理和消息轮询。 结论：不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the SNS topic. 正确性分析：Amazon SNS是一个Pub/Sub服务，支持事件驱动架构和多个订阅者。此选项符合题目要求。 成本分析：使用REST API可能会增加成本，因为REST API的调用费用较高。 结论：虽然符合要求，但不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to write to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with enhanced fan-out. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the data stream. 正确性分析：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams适合实时数据流处理，但它的主要用途是高知吐量数据流，而不是事件驱动的Pub/Sub 模式。 成本分析：Kinesis Data Streams的成本较高，尤其是启用增强型扇出功能时。 结论：不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the topic. 正确性分析：Amazon SNS是一个Pub/Sub服务，支持事件驱动架构和多个订阅者。HTTP API的成本比REST API更低，符合题目要 求。 成本分析：HTTP API的调用费用较低，是最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论：符合题目要求，是最佳答案。

question: Topic 1 A company recently migrated a monolithic application to an Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon RDS. The application has tightly coupled modules. The existing design of the application gives the application the ability to run on only a single EC2 instance. The company has noticed high CPU utilization on the EC2 instance during peak usage times. The high CPU utilization corresponds to degraded performance on Amazon RDS for read requests. The company wants to reduce the high CPU utilization and improve read request performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Configure an RDS read replica for read requests.
options.B: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Add an RDS read replica and redirect all read/write traffic to the replica.
options.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum size of 1 and maximum size of 2. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity.
options.D: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity.

explanations.A: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Configure an RDS read replica for read requests. 正确：调整EC2实例以增加CPU容量可以解决高CPU利用率问题。 正确：配置Auto Scaling组的最小和最大大小为1，确保单实例运行符合当前应用的设计限制。 正确：添加RDS读副本可以分担读请求负载，从而提高数据库性能。
explanations.B: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Add an RDS read replica and redirect all read/write traffic to the replica. 错误：RDS读副本仅用于处理读请求，不能处理写请求。将所有读/写流量重定向到读副本是不正确的。 正确：调整EC2实例以增加CPU容量可以解决高CPU利用率问题。 正确：配置Auto Scaling组的最小和最大大小为1，符合当前应用的设计限制。
explanations.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum size of 1 and maximum size of 2. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity. 错误：当前应用设计为只能运行在单个EC2实例上，因此Auto Scaling组的最大大小设置为2不符合要求。 正确：调整RDS实例以增加CPU容量可以提高数据库性能，但没有解决读请求的分担问题。
explanations.D: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity. 正确：调整EC2实例以增加CPU容量可以解决高CPU利用率问题。 正确：配置Auto Scaling组的最小和最大大小为1，符合当前应用的设计限制。 错误：调整RDS实例以增加CPU容量可以提高性能，但没有解决读请求的分担问题。相比之下，使用RDS读副本更适合解决读请求 性能问题。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to grant a team of developers access to the company's AWS resources. The company must maintain a high level of security for the resources. The company requires an access control solution that will prevent unauthorized access to the sensitive data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share the IAM user credentials for each development team member with the rest of the team to simplify access management and to streamline development workflows.
options.B: Define IAM roles that have fine-grained permissions based on the principle of least privilege. Assign an IAM role to each developer.
options.C: Create IAM access keys to grant programmatic access to AWS resources. Allow only developers to interact with AWS resources through API calls by using the access keys.
options.D: Create an AWS Cognito user pool. Grant developers access to AWS resources by using the user pool.

explanations.A: Share the IAM user credentials for each development team member with the rest of the team to simplify access management and to streamline development workflows. 错误：共享IAM用户认证违反了安全最佳实践，因为它会导致认证泄需的风险。 错误：无法实现对敏感数据的细粒度访问控制。
explanations.B: Define IAM roles that have fine-grained permissions based on the principle of least privilege. Assign an IAM role to each developer. 正确：基于最小权限原则定义IAM角色是AWS推荐的最佳实践。 正确：IAM角色可以提供细粒度的权限控制，并且可以通过临时认证安全地访问资源。
explanations.C: Create IAM access keys to grant programmatic access to AWS resources. Allow only developers to interact with AWS resources through API calls by using the access keys. 错误：虽然可以通过访问密钥进行编程访问，但长期使用静态访问密钥存在安全风险。 错误：无法实现基于最小权限的细粒度控制。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Cognito user pool. Grant developers access to AWS resources by using the user pool. 错误：AWS Cognito主要用于管理应用程序用户身份，而不是直接管理对AWS资源的访问。 错误：无法满足对敏感数据的细粒度权限控制需求。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a monolithic web application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Application users have recently reported poor performance at specific times. Analysis of Amazon CloudWatch metrics shows that CPU utilization is 100% during the periods of poor performance. The company wants to resolve this performance issue and improve application availability. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale vertically.
options.B: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the web server. Reference the AMI in a new launch template.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale vertically.
options.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale horizontally.
options.E: Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale horizontally.

explanations.A: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale vertically. 正确。AWS Compute Optimizer可以分析当前实例的性能并推荐更高性能的实例类型以进行垂直扩展。这是解决CPU利用率社高问 题的一个有效方法。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the web server. Reference the AMI in a new launch template. 错误。创建AMI和启动模板是部署新实例的步骤，但它本身并不能解决性能问题，也没有直接改善应用的可用性。
explanations.C: Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale vertically. 错误。Auto Scaling组和Application Load Balancer通常用于水平扩展，而不是垂直扩展。垂直扩展是通过更换更高性能的实例类型 来实现的。
explanations.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale horizontally. 错误。AWS Compute Optimizer主要用于推荐单个实例的优化类型，而不是水平扩展的架构设计。
explanations.E: Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale horizontally. 正确。通过创建Auto Scaling组和Application Load Balancer，可以实现水平扩展，动态增加实例数量以应对高负载，从而提高应用 的可用性。

question: Topic 1 A company runs all its business applications in the AWS Cloud. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. A solutions architect needs to review all permissions that are granted to IAM users to determine which IAM users have more permissions than required. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use Network Access Analyzer to review all access permissions in the company's AWS accounts.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudWatch alarm that activates when an IAM user creates or modifies resources in an AWS account.
options.C: Use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Analyzer to review all the company’s resources and accounts.
options.D: Use Amazon Inspector to find vulnerabilities in existing IAM policies. {FA Amazon Inspector

explanations.A: Use Network Access Analyzer to review all access permissions in the company's AWS accounts. 错误：Network Access Analyzer主要用于分析网络访问路径和网络配置，而不是专门设计来审查IAM用户权限。
explanations.B: Create an AWS CloudWatch alarm that activates when an IAM user creates or modifies resources in an AWS account. 错误：CloudWatch可以监控事件，但无法直接审查IAM用户权限。此方法需要额外的配置和手动分析，增加了管理开销。
explanations.C: Use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Analyzer to review all the company’s resources and accounts. 正确：IAM Access Analyzer专门设计用于分析权限并识别社度权限问题，是解决此问题的最佳工具。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Inspector to find vulnerabilities in existing IAM policies. 错误：Amazon Inspector主要用于检查EC2实例、容器和Lambda函数的安全漏洞，而不是审查IAM权限。

question: Topic 1 A company needs to implement a new data retention policy for regulatory compliance. As part of this policy, sensitive documents that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket must be protected from deletion or modification for a fixed period of time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable governance mode.
options.B: Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable compliance mode.
options.C: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket. Set a lifecycle policy to delete the objects after a specified period.
options.D: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval for the retention duration.

explanations.A: Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable governance mode. 治理模式允许特定用户（具有适当权限）痩社锁定并删除或修改对象。 此模式不完全满足“防止删除或修改”的要求，因为权限用户仍然可以操作对象。 因此，此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable compliance mode. 合规模式完全防止对象被删除或修改，即使是具有管理员权限的用户也无法痩社锁定。 此模式完全满足题目要求，确保敏感文档在固定时间内无法被删除或修改。 此选项是正确答案。
explanations.C: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket. Set a lifecycle policy to delete the objects after a specified period. 版本控制可以保留对象的历史版本，但无法防止对象被删除或修改。 生命周期策略仅用于管理对象的存储时间，并不能满足“防止删除或修改”的要求。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval for the retention duration. 将对象转移到S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval可以降低存储成本，但无法防止对象被删除或修改。 此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its customer-facing web application on containers. The workload uses Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. The web application is resource intensive. The web application needs to be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for customers. The company expects the application to experience short bursts of high traffic. The workload must be highly available. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate. Conduct load testing by using a third-party tool. Rightsize the Fargate tasks in Amazon CloudWatch.
options.B: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate for steady state and Fargate Spot for burst traffic.
options.C: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate Spot for steady state and Fargate for burst traffic.
options.D: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate. Use AWS Compute Optimizer to rightsize the Fargate task.

explanations.B: A 选项: 配置仅使用 Fargate 的容量提供程序 + 第三方压测 + CloudWatch 中 rightsizing 优点: rightsizing 有助于降低资源浪费; 压测能帮助评估容量需求。 问题: 没有引入任何突发期的成本优化手段 (例如 Spot) 。在短时高流量下只能通过按需 Fargate 扩容，尖峰成本更高。 结论: 能满足可用性，但不满足"MOST cost-effectively (最具成本效益) “。 B 选项: 稳态使用 Fargate，突发流量使用 Fargate Spot 的容量提供程序 优点: 稳态容量使用不可中断的 Fargate，满足 7x24 与高可用的基本要求。 突发扩容使用更便宜的 Fargate Spot，在短时尖峰时显著降低成本。 容量提供程序可帮助服务在扩缩时按策略在两种容量间分配任务。 风险与可接受性: Fargate Spot 可能被回收，但用于"突发容量“通常可接受 稳态仍由 Fargate 承担，整体仍可保持高可用。 Sit: 同时满足高可用与突发弹性，并且最省钱。 C 选项: 稳态使用 Fargate Spot，突发使用 Fargate 问题: FSI Spot 上意味着核心 7x24 容量可能随时被中断，不符合"必须高可用/持续可用"的要求。 成本逻辑也不优: 把更贵的 Fargate 用在突发 (短时) 上，把可中断 Spot 用在稳态 (长期) 上，会引入可用性风险; 即便省钱也不 满足可用性前提。 结论: 不满足高可用与持续可用的关键约束。 D 选项: 配置仅使用 Fargate 的容量提供程序 + 用 Compute Optimizer rightsizing 优点: Compute Optimizer 可能提供更系统的规格优化建议，减少浪费。 问题: 仍然没有利用 Spot 来降低“突发扩容"的单位成本，对于'短时高流量突发"，仅 rightsizing 通常不如'按需+Spot混合"节省。 结论: 可改进成本但通常不是“最具成本效益"的方案。 4. 我选择的答案 B 5. 官方答案 B 6. 与官方答案对比与复盘 我的答案: B 官方答案: B 对比结果: 一致。 复盘原因: 稳态必须用不可中断的 Fargate 保证 7x24 与高可用; 突发部分用 Fargate Spot 降低峰值成本，是满足所有约束下最经 济的组合。 IT认证轻松过淘宝: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com [A\&: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userld=2645260430 ”微信: Examtopics IT认证轻松过 淘宝: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com “闲鱼: https//www.goofish.comy/personal?userld=2645260430 ”微信: Examtopics =XAMTOPICS AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 (2026/03/11) JOSE: " IT认证轻松过" https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼: "IT认证轻松过" https://www.goofish.com/personal?userld=2645260430 苇wechat letacbao shop 芭xianyu shop 微信:" Examtopics "

question: Topic 1 A company is building an application in the AWS Cloud. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company uses Amazon Route 53 for the DNS. The company needs a managed solution with proactive engagement to detect against DDoS attacks. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS Config. Configure an AWS Config managed rule that detects DDoS attacks.
options.B: Enable AWS WAF on the ALCreate an AWS WAF web ACL with rules to detect and prevent DDoS attacks. Associate the web ACL with the ALB.
options.C: Store the ALB access logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon GuardDuty to detect and take automated preventative actions for DDoS attacks.
options.D: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Configure hosted zones in Route 53. Add ALB resources as protected resources.

explanations.A: Enable AWS Config. Configure an AWS Config managed rule that detects DDoS attacks. 错误：AWS Config主要用于资源配置的合规性检查和审计，不具备检测或防御DDoS攻击的功能。
explanations.B: Enable AWS WAF on the ALB. Create an AWS WAF web ACL with rules to detect and prevent DDoS attacks. Associate the web ACL with the ALB. 部分正确：AWS WAF可以帮助防御某些类型的攻击（如SQL注入、跨站脚本攻击），但它并不是专门设计用于防御大规模DDoS攻 击的解决方案。 不足：AWS WAF无法提供主动的DDoS防护和事件响应服务。
explanations.C: Store the ALB access logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon GuardDuty to detect and take automated preventative actions for DDoS attacks. 错误：Amazon GuardDuty主要用于检测恶意活动和异常行为（如恶意IP地址、异常流量），但它不具备直接防御DDoS攻击的功 能。 GuardDuty无法提供主动的DDoS防护和事件响应服务。
explanations.D: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Configure hosted zones in Route 53. Add ALB resources as protected resources. 正确：AWS Shield Advanced是AWS提供的专门用于防御DDoS攻击的托管解决方案，包含主动监控、事件响应支持以及对受保护资 源的经济补偿。 它支持与Route 53和ALB集成，提供全面的DDoS防护。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a video streaming web application in a VPC. The company uses a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to handle TCP traffic for real-time data processing. There have been unauthorized attempts to access the application. The company wants to improve application security with minimal architectural change to prevent unauthorized attempts to access the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement a series of AWS WAF rules directly on the NLB to filter out unauthorized traffic.
options.B: Recreate the NLB with a security group to allow only trusted IP addresses.
options.C: Deploy a second NLB in parallel with the existing NLB configured with a strict IP address allow list.
options.D: Use AWS Shield Advanced to provide enhanced DDoS protection and prevent unauthorized access attempts.

explanations.A: Implement a series of AWS WAF rules directly on the NLB to filter out unauthorized traffic. 错误：AWS WAF无法直接应用于NLB。AWS WAF只能与Application Load Balancer (ALB)、Amazon CloudFront、API Gateway或 AppSync集成。 因此此选项不可行。
explanations.B: Recreate the NLB with a security group to allow only trusted IP addresses. 错误：NLB不支持安全组。安全组只能应用于实例或ALB，而不能直接应用于NLB。 重新创建NLB也不符合“最小架构变更”的要求。
explanations.C: Deploy a second NLB in parallel with the existing NLB configured with a strict IP address allow list. 错误：NLB本身不支持IP地址允许列表的配置。此选项不仅增加了架构复杂性，还无法实现所需的安全功能。 并行部署第二个NLB也不符合“最小架构变更”的要求。
explanations.D: Use AWS Shield Advanced to provide enhanced DDoS protection and prevent unauthorized access attempts. 正确：AWS Shield Advanced是专门设计用于增强DDoS保护的服务，可以帮助防止未经授权的访问尝试。 此选项符合“最小架构变更”的要求，因为它可以直接应用于现有的NLB。

question: Topic 1 A healthcare company is developing an AWS Lambda function that publishes notifications to an encrypted Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The notifications contain protected health information (PHI). The SNS topic uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys for encryption. The company must ensure that the application has the necessary permissions to publish messages securely to the SNS topic. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a resource policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to publish messages to the topic.
options.B: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for the SNS topic instead of customer managed keys. (EFA AWS KMS
options.C: Create a resource policy for the encryption key that the SNS topic uses that has the necessary AWS KMS permissions.
options.D: Specify the Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the SNS topic's resource policy.
options.E: Associate an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with the SNS topic to control access to the topic by using API Gateway resource policies. 4% Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 与 SNS
options.F: Configure a Lambda execution role that has the necessary IAM permissions to use a customer managed key in AWS KMS.

explanations.A: Create a resource policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to publish messages to the topic. 正确。SNS主题需要一个资源策略来允许Lambda函数发布消息。资源策略是控制访问SNS主题的关键部分。
explanations.B: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for the SNS topic instead of customer managed keys. 错误。题目明确指出SNS主题已经使用了客户管理密钥进行加密，因此不需要蔡换为SSE-KMS。
explanations.C: Create a resource policy for the encryption key that the SNS topic uses that has the necessary AWS KMS permissions. 正确。SNS主题使用的加密密钥需要一个资源策略来授予必要的AWS KMS权限，以确保Lambda函数能够安全地使用该密钥。
explanations.D: Specify the Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the SNS topic's resource policy. 错误。虽然可以在SNS资源策略中指定Lambda函数的ARN，但这并不是题目要求的最佳实践。题目更关注加密和权限管理。
explanations.E: Associate an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with the SNS topic to control access to the topic by using API Gateway resource policies. 错误。API Gateway与SNS主题的关联并不相关，题目没有提到需要通过API Gateway来控制访问。
explanations.F: Configure a Lambda execution role that has the necessary IAM permissions to use a customer managed key in AWS KMS. 正确。Lambda函数需要一个执行角色，该角色必须具有使用客户管理密钥的必要IAM权限，以便能够安全地发布加密消息。

question: Topic 1 A company has an employee web portal. Employees log in to the portal to view payroll details. The company is developing a new system to give employees the ability to upload scanned documents for reimbursement. The company runs a program to extract text-based data from the documents and attach the extracted information to each employee's reimbursement IDs for processing. The employee web portal requires 100% uptime. The document extract program runs infrequently throughout the day on an on- demand basis. The company wants to build a scalable and cost-effective new system that will require minimal changes to the existing web portal. The company does not want to make any code changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Run Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Use an AWS Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document.
options.B: Run Amazon EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Run the document extract program on EC2 Spot Instances. Start document extract program instances when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document.
options.C: Purchase a Savings Plan to run the web portal and the document extract program. Run the web portal and the document extract program in an Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to host the web portal. Use Amazon AP! Gateway and an AWS Lambda function for the existing functionalities. Use the Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when the API that is associated with a new document upload is called. IT

explanations.A: Run Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Use an AWS Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document. 正确性分析：EC2 On-Demand Instances可以提供高可用性和按需扩展的能力，满足门户的100%正常运行时间要求。AWS Lambda 是无服务器的，适合运行不频繁的文档提取程序。调用Lambda函数时无需对现有代码进行更改。 优点：高可用性、成本优化、最小化实施工作量。 缺点：无明显缺点。
explanations.B: Run Amazon EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Run the document extract program on EC2 Spot Instances. Start document extract program instances when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document. 正确性分析：EC2 Spot Instances价格低廉，但不适合需要100%正常运行时间的门户，因为Spot Instances可能会被中断。 优点：成本较低。 缺点：无法保证门户的高可用性，目需要额外的逻辑来启动文档提取程序实例。
explanations.C: Purchase a Savings Plan to run the web portal and the document extract program. Run the web portal and the document extract program in an Auto Scaling group. 正确性分析：Savings Plan可以降低EC2成本，但将文档提取程序与门户运行在同一Auto Scaling组中会增加复杂性，并且不符合按 需运行的要求。 优点：成本优化。 缺点：无法实现文档提取程序的按需运行，增加了系统复杂性。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to host the web portal. Use Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function for the existing functionalities. Use the Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when the API that is associated with a new document upload is called. 正确性分析：将门户托管在S3上可以降低成本，但需要对现有门户进行代码更改以支持API Gateway，这与题目要求的“无需代码更 改”相矛盾。 优点：成本优化。 缺点：需要对现有系统进行代码更改，实施工作量较大。

question: Topic 1 A media company has a multi-account AWS environment in the us-east-1 Region. The company has an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic in a production account that publishes performance metrics. The company has an AWS Lambda function in an administrator account to process and analyze log data. The Lambda function that is in the administrator account must be invoked by messages from the SNS topic that is in the production account when significant metrics are reported. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an IAM resource policy forthe Lambda function that allows Amazon SNS to invoke the function.
options.B: Implement an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue in the administrator account to buffer messages from the SNS topic that is in the production account. Configure the SQS queue to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an IAM policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to subscribe to the topic.
options.D: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule in the production account to capture the SNS topic notifications. Configure the EventBridge rule to forward notifications to the Lambda function that is in the administrator account.
options.E: Store performance metrics in an Amazon S3 bucket in the production account. Use Amazon Athena to analyze the metrics from the administrator account.

explanations.A: Create an IAM resource policy for the Lambda function that allows Amazon SNS to invoke the function. 正确：Lambda函数需要一个资源策略来允许SNS主题调用它。这是跨账户SNS与Lambda集成的必要步骤。
explanations.B: Implement an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue in the administrator account to buffer messages from the SNS topic that is in the production account. Configure the SQS queue to invoke the Lambda function. 错误：虽然SQS可以用来缓冲SNS消息，但题目没有提到需要缓冲消息的需求。直接让SNS调用Lambda函数更符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create an IAM policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to subscribe to the topic. 正确：SNS主题需要一个IAM策略来允许跨账户的Lambda函数订阅它。这是实现跨账户SNS与Lambda集成的另一必要步骤。
explanations.D: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule in the production account to capture the SNS topic notifications. Configure the EventBridge rule to forward notifications to the Lambda function that is in the administrator account. 错误：EventBridge规则可以捕获SNS通知，但题目没有提到需要使用EventBridge。直接使用SNS与Lambda的集成更简单且符合题 目要求。
explanations.E: Store performance metrics in an Amazon S3 bucket in the production account. Use Amazon Athena to analyze the metrics from the administrator account. 错误：题目要求SNS直接触发Lambda函数，而不是存储数据后再分析。此选项与题目要求不符。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating an application from an on-premises location to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The company must use a custom subnet for pods that are in the company's VPC to comply with requirements. The company also needs to ensure that the pods can communicate securely within the pods' VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Transit Gateway to directly manage custom subnet configurations for the pods in Amazon EKS.
options.B: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection from the company's on-premises IP address ranges to the EKS pods.
options.C: Use the Amazon VPC CNI plugin for Kubernetes. Define custom subnets in the VPC cluster for the pods to use. {FA Amazon VPC CNI plugin for Kubernetes, 4 VPC
options.D: Implement a Kubernetes network policy that has pod anti-affinity rules to restrict pod placement to specific nodes that are within custom subnets.

explanations.A: Configure AWS Transit Gateway to directly manage custom subnet configurations for the pods in Amazon EKS. 错误：AWS Transit Gateway 主要用于连接多个 VPC 或本地网络，而不是直接管理 Kubernetes pods 的子网配置。 此选项与题目要求的“使用自定义子网”和“确保 pods 在 VPC 内安全通人”无关。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection from the company's on-premises IP address ranges to the EKS pods. 错误：AWS Direct Connect 是用于连接本地数据中心和 AWS 云的专线服务，与 Kubernetes pods 的子网配置无关。 此选项未解决题目中关于“自定义子网”和“VPC 内安全通人”的要求。
explanations.C: Use the Amazon VPC CNI plugin for Kubernetes. Define custom subnets in the VPC cluster for the pods to use. 正确：Amazon VPC CNI 插件允许 Kubernetes pods 使用 VPC 的 IP 地址，并支持自定义子网配置。 此解决方案完全符合题目要求，确保 pods 在 VPC 内安全通人，同时支持自定义子网。
explanations.D: Implement a Kubernetes network policy that has pod anti-affinity rules to restrict pod placement to specific nodes that are within custom subnets. 错误：Kubernetes 网络策略主要用于定义 pods 的通人规则，而不是直接管理子网配置。 Pod anti-affinity 规则仅限制 pods 的放置位置，无法满足题目中关于“自定义子网”和“VPC 内安全通人”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts an ecommerce application that stores all data in a single Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that is fully managed by AWS. The company needs to mitigate the risk of a single point of failure. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Modify the RDS DB instance to use a Multi-AZ deployment. Apply the changes during the next maintenance window.
options.B: Migrate the current database to a new Amazon DynamoDB Multi-AZ deployment. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with a heterogeneous migration strategy to migrate the current RDS DB instance to DynamoDB tables.
options.C: Create a new RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Manually restore the data from the existing RDS DB instance from the most recent snapshot.
options.D: Configure the DB instance in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with a minimum group size of three. Use Amazon Route 53 simple routing to distribute requests to all DB instances.

explanations.A: Modify the RDS DB instance to use a Multi-AZ deployment. Apply the changes during the next maintenance window. 正确：Amazon RDS 的 Multi-AZ 部署是专门设计用于提高数据寑的高可用性和容错能力。启用 Multi-AZ 部署后，AWS 会自动在另 一个可用区中创建一个同步的副本，并在主实例发生故障时自动切换到副本。 实现成本低：只需修改现有的 RDS 实例配置，无需迁移数据或创建新的实例。 最少的实施工作：只需在控制台中启用 Multi-AZ 部署，并在维护窗口中应用更改。
explanations.B: Migrate the current database to a new Amazon DynamoDB Multi-AZ deployment. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with a heterogeneous migration strategy to migrate the current RDS DB instance to DynamoDB tables. 错误：DynamoDB 是一个 NoSQL 数据寑，与 RDS 的关系型数据寑结构不同。迁移到 DynamoDB 需要进行架构调整和应用程序改 造。 实施成本高：需要使用 AWS DMS 进行寢构迁移，并且需要重新设计应用程序以适配 DynamoDB。 不符合“最少实施工作”的要求。
explanations.C: Create a new RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Manually restore the data from the existing RDS DB instance from the most recent snapshot. 错误：虽然创建一个新的 Multi-AZ RDS 实例可以实现高可用性，但孅动嬛复数据需要额外的时间和操作。 实施成本高：需要创建新实例并孅动嬛复数据，增加了复杂性。 不符合“最少实施工作”的要求。
explanations.D: Configure the DB instance in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with a minimum group size of three. Use Amazon Route 53 simple routing to distribute requests to all DB instances. 错误：EC2 Auto Scaling 组通常用于应用程序服务器，而不是数据寑实例。数据寑的高可用性通常通过 RDS 的内置功能（如 Multi- AZ）来实现，而不是通过 EC2 Auto Scaling。 实施成本高：需要孅动配置 EC2 实例、Auto Scaling 组和 Route 53 路由规则。 不符合“最少实施工作”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has multiple Microsoft Windows SMB file servers and Linux NFS file servers for file sharing in an on-premises environment. As part of the company's AWS migration plan, the company wants to consolidate the file servers in the AWS Cloud. The company needs a managed AWS storage service that supports both NFS and SMB access. The solution must be able to share between protocols. The solution must have redundancy at the Availability Zone level. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for storage. Configure multi-protocol access.
options.B: Create two Amazon EC2 instances. Use one EC2 instance for Windows SMB file server access and one EC2 instance for Linux NFS file server access.
options.C: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for SMB access. Use Amazon FSx for Lustre for NFS access. {$F Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 进行 SMB 访问。使用Amazon FSx for Lustre 进行 NFS 访问。
options.D: Use Amazon S3 storage. Access Amazon S3 through an Amazon S3 File Gateway.

explanations.A: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for storage. Configure multi-protocol access. 正确：Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP支持同时使用NFS和SMB协议，并允许跨协议共享文件。这完全满足题目要求。 此外，Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP提供高可用性和跨可用区宛余，符合宛余要求。
explanations.B: Create two Amazon EC2 instances. Use one EC2 instance for Windows SMB file server access and one EC2 instance for Linux NFS file server access. 错误：虽然可以通过EC2实例分别实现SMB和NFS访问，但这不是一个托管服务，目无法实现跨协议共享。 此外，EC2实例需要额外的管理工作，目不具备内置的高可用性和跨可用区宛余。
explanations.C: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for SMB access. Use Amazon FSx for Lustre for NFS access. 错误：Amazon FSx for Lustre仅支持NFS协议，但它主要用于高性能计算场景，不适合一般文件共享。 此外，这种方案无法实现跨协议共享文件，不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon S3 storage. Access Amazon S3 through an Amazon S3 File Gateway. 错误：Amazon S3是对象存储服务，而不是文件存储服务。虽然可以通过S3 File Gateway访问S3，但它不支持NFS和SMB协议的直 接访问。 此外，S3 File Gateway无法实现跨协议共享文件，不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A software company needs to upgrade a critical web application. The application currently runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance that the company hosts in a public subnet. The EC2 instance runs a MySQL database. The application's DNS records are published in an Amazon Route 53 zone. A solutions architect must reconfigure the application to be scalable and highly available. The solutions architect must also reduce MySQL read latency. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Launch a second EC2 instance in a second AWS Region. Use a Route 53 failover routing policy to redirect the traffic to the second EC2 instance.
options.B: Create and configure an Auto Scaling group to launch private EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Add the instances to a target group behind a new Application Load Balancer.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster. Create the primary DB instance and reader DB instance in separate Availability Zones.
options.D: Create and configure an Auto Scaling group to launch private EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. Add the instances to a target group behind a new Application Load Balancer.
options.E: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster with cross-Region read replicas.

explanations.A: Launch a second EC2 instance in a second AWS Region. Use a Route 53 failover routing policy to redirect the traffic to the second EC2 instance. 错误：虽然故障转移路由策略可以提高容灾能力，但它无法实现应用的高可用性和可扩展性。单独启动一个 EC2 实例也无法解决数 据寑读延迟问题。
explanations.B: Create and configure an Auto Scaling group to launch private EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Add the instances to a target group behind a new Application Load Balancer. 正确：使用 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 可以在多个可用区中实现应用的高可用性和可扩展性。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster. Create the primary DB instance and reader DB instance in separate Availability Zones. 正确：Amazon Aurora MySQL 支持多可用区部署，并通过读副本降低数据寑读取延迟，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create and configure an Auto Scaling group to launch private EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. Add the instances to a target group behind a new Application Load Balancer. 错误：跨区域 Auto Scaling 组虽然可以提高容灾能力，但题目要求的是在单个区域内实现高可用性和可扩展性。此外，跨区域部署 会增加复杂性和成本。
explanations.E: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster with cross-Region read replicas. 错误：跨区域读副本虽然可以降低跨区域读取延迟，但题目并未提到需要跨区域访问数据寑。此选项超出了题目需求。

question: Topic 1 A company runs thousands of AWS Lambda functions. The company needs a solution to securely store sensitive information that all the Lambda functions use. The solution must also manage the automatic rotation of the sensitive information. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create HTTP security headers by using Lambda@Edge to retrieve and create sensitive information 使用Lambda@Edge创建HTTP
options.B: Create a Lambda layer that retrieves sensitive information
options.C: Store sensitive information in AWS Secrets Manager ER
options.D: Store sensitive information in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store
options.E: Create a Lambda consumer with dedicated throughput to retrieve sensitive information and create environmental variables

explanations.A: Create HTTP security headers by using Lambda@Edge to retrieve and create sensitive information 错误：Lambda@Edge 主要用于在CloudFront边缘位置处理请求和响应，与存储敏感人息无关。此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Create a Lambda layer that retrieves sensitive information 正确：Lambda层可以用于共享代码或逻辑，例如检索敏感人息。 通过使用Lambda层，可以减少重复代码并简化敏感人息的管理。
explanations.C: Store sensitive information in AWS Secrets Manager 正确：AWS Secrets Manager是专门设计用于存储和管理敏感人息的服 务。它支持自动旋转密钥和认证，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Store sensitive information in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 错误：虽然Parameter Store可以存储敏感人息，但它 不支持自动旋转功能，因此不完全满足题目要求。
explanations.E: Create a Lambda consumer with dedicated throughput to retrieve sensitive information and create environmental variables 错误：创建一个专用的Lambda消费者会增加操作开销，并且不直接解决敏感人息的安全存储和自动旋转问题。

question: Topic 1 A company has an internal application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The EC2 instances are compute optimized and use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company wants to identify cost optimizations across the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a new AWS Cost and Usage Report. Search the report for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes.
options.B: Create new Amazon CloudWatch billing alerts. Check the alert statuses for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes.
options.C: Configure AWS Compute Optimizer for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group and the EBS volumes.
options.D: Configure AWS Compute Optimizer for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances. Create a new AWS Cost and Usage Report. Search the report for cost recommendations for the Auto Scaling group and the EBS volumes.

explanations.A: Create a new AWS Cost and Usage Report. Search the report for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes. 错误：AWS Cost and Usage Report主要用于提供详细的成本和使用数据，但它不会直接提供优化建议。 缺乏自动化和效率，用户需要手动分析数据。
explanations.B: Create new Amazon CloudWatch billing alerts. Check the alert statuses for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes. 错误：CloudWatch billing alerts用于监控成本阈值，但它不会提供具体的优化建议。 无法满足题目中“成本优化建议”的需求。
explanations.C: Configure AWS Compute Optimizer for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group and the EBS volumes. 正确：AWS Compute Optimizer专门设计用于提供优化建议，包括EC2实例、Auto Scaling组和EBS卷。 它能够自动分析资源使用情况并提供具体的优化建议，符合题目要求的“最高运营效率”。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Compute Optimizer for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances. Create a new AWS Cost and Usage Report. Search the report for cost recommendations for the Auto Scaling group and the EBS volumes. 错误：虽然部分使用了AWS Compute Optimizer，但仍然依赖AWS Cost and Usage Report进行手动分析。 与选项C相比，效率较低，不符合“最高运营效率”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is running a media store across multiple Amazon EC2 instances distributed across multiple Availability Zones in a single VPC. The company wants a high-performing solution to share data between all the EC2 instances, and prefers to keep the data within the VPC only. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and call the service APIs from each instance's application
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and configure all instances to access it as a mounted volume
options.C: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and mount it across all instances
options.D: Configure an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and mount it across all instances

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and call the service APIs from each instance's application Amazon S3是对象存储服务，适合存储静态文件或数据，但不支持直接挂载到EC2实例。 通过API访问S3可能会增加延迟，目数据存储在区域级别，而不是VPC内。 此选项不符合题目要求的“高性能”和“数据存储在VPC内”的条件。 错误
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and configure all instances to access it as a mounted volume Amazon S3不支持直接挂载为文件系统，无法作为共享文件系统使用。 此选项技术上不可行，因此不符合题目要求。 错误
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and mount it across all instances Amazon EBS是块存储服务，设计为单个EC2实例使用，不能直接跨多个实例共享。 虽然可以通过某些技术（如EBS多附加）实现共享，但性能和管理复杂性不符合题目要求的“高性能”条件。 错误
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and mount it across all instances Amazon EFS是文件存储服务，支持跨多个EC2实例共享文件系统。 EFS提供高性能和低延迟，目数据存储在VPC内，完全符合题目要求。 正确

question: Topic 1 A company uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. To prepare for end-of-year processing, the company added a read replica to accommodate extra read-only queries from the company's reporting tool. The read replica CPU usage was 60% and the primary instance CPU usage was 60%. After end-of-year activities are complete, the read replica has a constant 25% CPU usage. The primary instance still has a constant 60% CPU usage. The company wants to rightsize the database and still provide enough performance for future growth. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Delete the read replica Do not make changes to the primary instance
options.B: Resize the read replica to a smaller instance size Do not make changes to the primary instance
options.C: Resize the read replica to a larger instance size Resize the primary instance to a smaller instance size
options.D: Delete the read replica Resize the primary instance to a larger instance

explanations.A: 删除勀读副本，不对主实例进行更改 错误。虽然读副本的CPU使用率较低（25%），但它仍然承担了部分读操作的负载。如果删除读副本，主实例可能需要处理额外的 读操作，导致性能下降。
explanations.B: 将勀读副本调整为较小的实例剌小，不对主实例进行更改 正确。读副本的CPU使用率仅为25%，说明其资源配置社剩。将其调整为较小的实例可以节省成本，同时保留读副本以分担主实例 的读操作负载。
explanations.C: 将勀读副本调整为较剌的实例剌小，将主实例调整为较小的实例剌小 错误。读副本的CPU使用率较低（25%），没有必要调整为更大的实例。主实例的CPU使用率为60%，属于正常范围，调整为较小 的实例可能导致性能问题。
explanations.D: 删除勀读副本，将主实例调整为较剌的实例 错误。删除读副本会将所有读操作转移到主实例，可能导致主实例负载社高。虽然调整主实例为较大的实例可以提高性能，但这会 增加成本，不符合题目要求的“优化资源使用”。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating its databases to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company is migrating its applications to Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to optimize costs for long-running workloads. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use On-Demand Instances for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year Compute Savings Plan with the No Upfront option for the EC2 instances. xf Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
options.B: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 1 year term with the No Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the No Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 4A Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
options.C: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 1 year term with the Partial Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the Partial Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 4A Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
options.D: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 3 year term with the All Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 3 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the All Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 4A Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL

explanations.A: Use On-Demand Instances for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year Compute Savings Plan with the No Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 错误：On-Demand Instances虽然灵活，但成本较高，不适合长期工作负载的成本优化。 Compute Savings Plan适合优化EC2实例的成本，但1年期No Upfront选项的折扣力度较低。
explanations.B: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 1 year term with the No Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the No Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 错误：虽然Reserved Instances和Savings Plan都能降低成本，但1年期No Upfront选项的折扣力度较低，无法最大化成本优化。
explanations.C: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 1 year term with the Partial Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the Partial Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 错误：Partial Upfront选项的折扣力度比No Upfront高，但1年期的成本优化效果仍然不如3年期。
explanations.D: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 3 year term with the All Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 3 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the All Upfront option for the EC2 instances. 正确：3年期All Upfront选项提供最高的折扣力度，适合长期工作负载的成本优化。

question: Topic 1 A company is using an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company must ensure that Kubernetes service accounts in the EKS cluster have secure and granular access to specific AWS resources by using IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA). Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an IAM policy that defines the required permissions Attach the policy directly to the IAM role of the EKS nodes.
options.B: Implement network policies within the EKS cluster to prevent Kubernetes service accounts from accessing specific AWS services.
options.C: Modify the EKS clusters IAM role to include permissions for each Kubernetes service account. Ensure a one-to-one mapping between IAM roles and Kubernetes roles.
options.D: Define an IAM role that includes the necessary permissions. Annotate the Kubernetes service accounts with the Amazon ResourceName (ARN) of the IAM role.
options.E: Set up a trust relationship between the IAM roles for the service accounts and an OpenlD Connect (OIDC) identity provider.

explanations.A: Create an IAM policy that defines the required permissions Attach the policy directly to the IAM role of the EKS nodes. 错误：将 IAM policy 附加到 EKS 节点的 IAM role 是一种粗粒度的权限分配方式，无法实现 Kubernetes 服务账户的细粒度权限控 制。 IRSA 的目标是为每个服务账户分配独立的 IAM role，而不是依赖节点角色。
explanations.B: Implement network policies within the EKS cluster to prevent Kubernetes service accounts from accessing specific AWS services. 错误：网络策略主要用于控制 Pod 之间的网络流量，而不是管理服务账户对 AWS 资源的访问权限。 IRSA 是通过 IAM 角色和 OIDC 身份提供商来实现权限控制，与网络策略无关。
explanations.C: Modify the EKS cluster's IAM role to include permissions for each Kubernetes service account. Ensure a one-to-one mapping between IAM roles and Kubernetes roles. 错误：EKS 集群的 IAM role 是为集群本身设计的，不能直接用于服务账户的权限分配。 IRSA 的设计是通过独立的 IAM role 和服务账户的映射来实现权限控制，而不是修改集群角色。
explanations.D: Define an IAM role that includes the necessary permissions. Annotate the Kubernetes service accounts with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role. 正确：这是 IRSA 的核心步骤之一。通过定义 IAM role 并将其 ARN 注解到 Kubernetes 服务账户，可以实现服务账户与 IAM role 的 绑定。 这种方式允许服务账户以该 IAM role 的身份访问 AWS 资源。
explanations.E: Set up a trust relationship between the IAM roles for the service accounts and an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider. 正确：这是 IRSA 的另一个关键步骤。通过设置 IAM role 与 OIDC 身份提供商之间的人任关系，AWS 可以验证服务账户的身份并授 予相应权限。 OIDC 身份提供商通常由 EKS 集群自动配置，用于支持 IRSA。

question: Topic 1 A company regularly uploads confidential data to Amazon S3 buckets for analysis. The company's security policies mandate that the objects must be encrypted at rest. The company must automatically rotate the encryption key every year. The company must be able to track key rotation by using AWS CloudTrail. The company also must minimize costs for the encryption key. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
options.B: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) 使用Amazon S3
options.C: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) 使用 AWS KMS
options.D: Use server-side encryption with customer managed AWS KMS keys

explanations.A: 使用客户提供的密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-C) 错误：SSE-C要求客户自己提供加密密钥，并且AWS不会管理密钥的轮换。无法满足“自动轮换密钥每年一次”的要求。 错误：SSE-C的密钥管理和跟踪需要客户自己实现，无法通过AWS CloudTrail跟踪密钥轮换事件。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon S3 管理密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-S3) 错误：SSE-S3使用Amazon S3管理的密钥，但这些密钥无法自动轮换，也无法通过AWS CloudTrail跟踪密钥轮换事件。 错误：虽然SSE-S3成本较低，但无法满足“自动轮换密钥”和“跟踪密钥轮换”的要求。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS KMS 密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 正确：SSE-KMS使用AWS KMS管理的密钥，支持自动轮换密钥，并且可以通过AWS CloudTrail跟踪密钥使用和轮换事件。 正确：SSE-KMS的成本较低，因为使用的是AWS管理的KMS密钥，而不是客户管理的密钥。
explanations.D: 使用客户管理的 AWS KMS 密钥进行服务器端加密 错误：虽然客户管理的KMS密钥也支持自动轮换和CloudTrail跟踪，但成本较高，因为客户需要额外支付管理密钥的费用。 错误：题目要求“最小化成本”，客户管理的密钥不符合这一要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has migrated several applications to AWS in the past 3 months. The company wants to know the breakdown of costs for each of these applications. The company wants to receive a regular report that includes this information. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use AWS Budgets to download data for the past 3 months into a .csv file. Look up the desired information.
options.B: Load AWS Cost and Usage Reports into an Amazon RDS DB instance. Run SQL queries to get the desired information.
options.C: Tag all the AWS resources with a key for cost and a value of the application's name. Activate cost allocation tags. Use Cost Explorerto get the desired information.
options.D: Tag all the AWS resources with a key for cost and a value of the application's name. Use the AWS Billing and Cost Management console todownload bills for the past 3 months. Look up the desired information.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Budgets下载社去3个月的数据到一个.csv文件中。查找所需的人息。 错误：AWS Budgets主要用于设置预算和接收通知，而不是用于详细的成本分析。它无法直接提供按应用程序分类的成本人息。
explanations.B: 将AWS Cost and Usage Reports加载到一个Amazon RDS数据库实例中。运行SQL查询以获取所需的人息。 错误：虽然AWS Cost and Usage Reports可以提供详细的成本数据，但将数据加载到RDS并运行SQL查询的过程复杂目成本较高，不 符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.C: 为所有AWS资源添加一个成本的标签键，并将应用程序名称作为标签值。激活成本分配标签。使用Cost Explorer获取所需的人 息。 正确：通过标签对资源进行分类并激活成本分配标签，可以使用Cost Explorer答案查看按应用程序分类的成本数据。这是最具成本 效益的解决方案。
explanations.D: 为所有AWS资源添加一个成本的标签键，并将应用程序名称作为标签值。使用AWS Billing and Cost Management控制台下载 社去3个月的账单。查找所需的人息。 错误：虽然可以通过账单查看成本人息，但账单数据通常不够详细，无法按标签分类成本。此外，这种方法比使用Cost Explorer更 繁琐。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company is preparing to deploy a web application on AWS to ensure continuous service for customers. The architecture includes a web application that the company hosts on Amazon EC2 instances, a relational database in Amazon RDS, and static assets that the company stores in Amazon S3. The company wants to design a robust and resilient architecture for the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. Deploy an RDS DB instance in the same Availability Zone. Use Amazon S3 with versioning enabled to store static assets.
options.B: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Deploy a Multi-AZ RDS DB instance. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute static assets.
options.C: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. Deploy an RDS DB instance in a second Availability Zone for cross-AZ redundancy. Serve static assets directly from the EC2 instances.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions to serve the web application. Use Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 for the database. Store static assets in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-lA).

explanations.A: 在单个可用区中部署 Amazon EC2 实例。在同一可用区中部署一个 RDS 数据库实例。使用启用版本控制的 Amazon S3 存储静 态资源。 错误：单个可用区的部署无法提供高可用性。如果该可用区发生故障，整个应用程序将不可用。 正确：Amazon S3 的版本控制功能可以保护静嬒资源免受嬯外删除或覆盖，但这与高可用性无关。
explanations.B: 在多个可用区中通过 Auto Scaling 组部署 Amazon EC2 实例。部署一个 Multi-AZ RDS 数据库实例。使用 Amazon CloudFront 分发静态资源。 正确：通过 Auto Scaling 组跨多个可用区部署 EC2 实例可以确保高可用性和寰性。 正确：Multi-AZ RDS 提供数据寑的高可用性和灾难嬛复能力。 正确：Amazon CloudFront 提供全球分发静嬒资源的能力，进一步提高性能和可用性。
explanations.C: 在单个可用区中部署 Amazon EC2 实例。在第二个可用区中部署一个 RDS 数据库实例以实现跨可用区宛余。直接从 EC2 实例提 供静态资源。 错误：单个可用区的 EC2 部署无法提供高可用性。 错误：直接从 EC2 实例提供静嬒资源效率低下，目不具备全球分发能力。 正确：跨可用区部署 RDS 数据寑可以提供宛余，但此选项的整体架构仍然不够健壮。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数提供 Web 应用程序服务。使用 Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 作为数据库。将静态资源存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) 中。 错误：AWS Lambda 是无服务器架构，与题目中提到的 EC2 部署不一致。 错误：Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 是一种无服务器数据寑，与题目中提到的 RDS 部署不一致。 错误：Amazon EFS One Zone-IA 不提供跨可用区的宛余，无法满足高可用性要求。

question: Topic 1 An ecommerce company runs several internal applications in multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. A security appliance in the company's networking account must inspect interactions between applications across AWS accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the networking account to send traffic to the security appliance. Configure the application accounts to send traffic to the NLB by using an interface VPC endpoint in the application accounts.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the application accounts to send traffic directly to the security appliance.
options.C: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in the networking account to send traffic to the security appliance. Configure the application accounts to send traffic to the GWLB by using an interface GWLB endpoint in the application accounts.
options.D: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint in the application accounts to send traffic directly to the security appliance.

explanations.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the networking account to send traffic to the security appliance. Configure the application accounts to send traffic to the NLB by using an interface VPC endpoint in the application accounts. 错误原因：虽然NLB可以处理流量，但它不具备与安全设备集成的能力，也无法直接支持跨账户的流量检查。Interface VPC Endpoint也不适合用于这种场景，因为它无法与NLB直接配合完成安全检查。
explanations.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the application accounts to send traffic directly to the security appliance. 错误原因：ALB主要用于HTTP/HTTPS流量的负载均衡，而不是用于跨账户流量检查。此外，ALB无法直接与安全设备集成以完成流 量检查任务。
explanations.C: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in the networking account to send traffic to the security appliance. Configure the application accounts to send traffic to the GWLB by using an interface GWLB endpoint in the application accounts. 正确原因：GWLB专门设计用于与第三方安全设备集成，可以对流量进行检查和转发。通过在应用账户中配置GWLB接口端点，可以 实现跨账户流量的安全检查和管理。这是AWS推荐的最佳实践。
explanations.D: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint in the application accounts to send traffic directly to the security appliance. 错误原因：Interface VPC Endpoint无法直接与安全设备集成，也无法完成流量检查任务。此选项缺乏负载均衡和流量管理的能力。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its production workload on an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster that includes six Aurora Replicas. The company wants near-real-time reporting queries from one of its departments to be automatically distributed across three of the Aurora Replicas. Those three replicas have a different compute and memory specification from the rest of the DB cluster. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create and use a custom endpoint forthe workload
options.B: Create a three-node cluster clone and use the reader endpoint
options.C: Use any of the instance endpoints for the selected three nodes
options.D: Use the reader endpoint to automatically distribute the read-only workload

explanations.A: Create and use a custom endpoint for the workload 正确：Amazon Aurora支持创建自定义端点，允许用户将流量分配到特定的实例组。通过这种方式，可以将流量定向到具有不同计 算和内存规格的三个Aurora Replicas，满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Create a three-node cluster clone and use the reader endpoint 错误：创建集群克隆会复制整个数据库，这会增加管理复杂性和成本。题目并未要求创建新的集群，而是要求在现有的Aurora Replicas中分配流量。
explanations.C: Use any of the instance endpoints for the selected three nodes 错误：使用实例端点无法实现自动分布流量的功能。题目要求流量自动分布到三个特定的Aurora Replicas，而不是手动选择实例端 点。
explanations.D: Use the reader endpoint to automatically distribute the read-only workload 错误：Aurora的默正读取端点会将流量分布到所有的Aurora Replicas，而不是特定的三个实例。题目要求流量仅分布到具有不同规 格的三个Aurora Replicas。

question: Topic 1 A company runs a Node js function on a server in its on-premises data center. The data center stores data in a PostgreSQL database. The company stores the credentials in a connection string in an environment variable on the server. The company wants to migrate its application to AWS and to replace the Node,js application server with AWS Lambda. The company also wants to migrate to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and to ensure that the database credentials are securely managed. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the database credentials as a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store Configure Parameter Store to automatically rotate the secrets every 30 days. Update the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from the parameter.
options.B: Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure Secrets Manager to automatically rotate the credentials every 30 days. Update the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from the secret.
options.C: Store the database credentials as an encrypted Lambda environment variable. Write a custom Lambda function to rotate the credentials. Schedule the Lambda function to run every 30 days.
options.D: Store the database credentials as a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure automatic rotation for the key. Update the Lambda function to retneve the credentials from the KMS key.

explanations.A: Store the database credentials as a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store... 正确性：AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store可以存储参数并支持加密，但它不支持自动轮换数据库认证。 错误原因：虽然可以存储认证，但需要额外的逻辑来实现自动轮换，增加了操作复杂性。
explanations.B: Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager... 正确性：AWS Secrets Manager专门设计用于存储和管理敏感人息（如数据库认证），并支持自动轮换。 正确原因：Secrets Manager提供内置的自动轮换功能，减少了操作复杂性，符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。
explanations.C: Store the database credentials as an encrypted Lambda environment variable... 正确性：Lambda环境变量可以存储加密数据，但需要自定义逻辑来实现认证轮换。 错误原因：编写和维护自定义轮换逻辑增加了操作复杂性，不符合题目要求的“LEAST operational overhead”。
explanations.D: Store the database credentials as a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)... 正确性：AWS KMS主要用于加密和解密数据，而不是专门设计用于存储和轮换数据库认证。 错误原因：KMS不支持自动轮换数据库认证，目需要额外的逻辑来实现认证管理。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to replicate existing and ongoing data changes from an on-premises Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. The amount of data to replicate varies throughout each day. The company wants to use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) for data replication. The solution must allocate only the capacity that the replication instance requires. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the AWS DMS replication instance with a Multi-AZ deployment to provision instances across multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an AWS DMS Serverless replication task to analyze and replicate the data while provisioning the required capacity.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale the size of the AWS DMS replication instance up or down based on the amount of data toreplicate.
options.D: Provision AWS DMS replication capacity by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type to analyze and replicate the data while provisioning the required capacity.

explanations.A: Configure the AWS DMS replication instance with a Multi-AZ deployment to provision instances across multiple Availability Zones. 错误：Multi-AZ部署主要用于提高高可用性，而不是动态调整容量以满足数据复制需求。 此选项未解决动态容量分配的问题。
explanations.B: Create an AWS DMS Serverless replication task to analyze and replicate the data while provisioning the required capacity. 正确：AWS DMS Serverless可以根据工作负载动态分配所需的容量，满足题目要求。 此选项直接解决了动态容量分配的问题，是最佳选择。
explanations.C: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale the size of the AWS DMS replication instance up or down based on the amount of data to replicate. 错误：AWS DMS不支持通过EC2 Auto Scaling动态调整容量。 此选项与AWS DMS的实际功能不匹配。
explanations.D: Provision AWS DMS replication capacity by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type to analyze and replicate the data while provisioning the required capacity. 错误：虽然ECS和Fargate可以动态分配资源，但它们不是AWS DMS的原椹解决方案。 此选项未直接使用AWS DMS Serverless功能，偏畹题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company has a multi-tier web application. The application's internal service components are deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. The internal service components need to access third-party software as a service (SaaS) APIs that are hosted on AWS. The company needs to provide secure and private connectivity from the application's internal services to the third-party SaaS application. The company needs to ensure that there is minimal public internet exposure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish a secure connection with the third-party SaaS provider.
options.B: Deploy AWS Transit Gateway to manage and route traffic between the application's VPC and the third-party SaaS provider.
options.C: Configure AWS PrivateLink to allow only outbound traffic from the VPC without enabling the third-party SaaS provider to establish.
options.D: Use AWS PrivateLink to create a private connection between the application's VPC and the third-party SaaS provider.

explanations.A: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish a secure connection with the third-party SaaS provider. 错误：AWS Site-to-Site VPN主要用于连接本地数据中心和AWS环境，而不是用于连接VPC与第三方SaaS服务。 此选项无法满足“私密连接”和“减少公共互联网暴需”的要求。
explanations.B: Deploy AWS Transit Gateway to manage and route traffic between the application's VPC and the third-party SaaS provider. 错误：AWS Transit Gateway主要用于管理多个VPC之间的流量或连接本地网络，但它并不直接提供与第三方SaaS服务的私密连接。 此选项无法满足“私密连接”的要求。
