explanations.C: Configure AWS PrivateLink to allow only outbound traffic from the VPC without enabling the third-party SaaS provider to establish. 错误：此选项描述的功能不完全正确。AWS PrivateLink的主要功能是创建私密连接，而不是仅仅限制出站流量。 此选项的描述与AWS PrivateLink的实际功能不符。
explanations.D: Use AWS PrivateLink to create a private connection between the application's VPC and the third-party SaaS provider. 正确：AWS PrivateLink允许VPC与第三方SaaS服务之间建立私密连接，避免流量通过公共互联网。 此选项完全符合题目要求，提供了安全、私密的连接，并减少了公共互联网暴需。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect needs to connect a company's corporate network to its VPC to allow on-premises access to its AWS resources. The solution must provide encryption of all traffic between the corporate network and the VPC at the network layer and the session layer. The solution also must provide security controls to prevent unrestricted access between AWS and the on- premises systems. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Direct Connect to connect to the VPC. Configure the VPC route tables to allow and deny traffic between AWS and on premises as required.
options.B: Create an IAM policy to allow access to the AWS Management Console only from a defined set of corporate IP addresses. Restrict user access based on job responsibility by using an IAM policy and roles.
options.C: Configure AWS Site-to-Site VPN to connect to the VPConfigure route table entries to direct traffic from on premises to the VPConfigure instance security groups and network ACLs to allow only required traffic from on premises.
options.D: Configure AWS Transit Gateway to connect to the VPC. Configure route table entries to direct traffic from on premises to the VPC. Configure instance security groups and network ACLs to allow only required traffic from on premises.

explanations.A: Configure AWS Direct Connect to connect to the VPC. Configure the VPC route tables to allow and deny traffic between AWS and on premises as required. 错误：AWS Direct Connect提供专线连接，但它本身不提供流量加密功能，无法满足题目要求的网络层和会话层加密。 错误：虽然可以通过路由表控制流量，但Direct Connect无法直接实现题目要求的安全控制。
explanations.B: Create an IAM policy to allow access to the AWS Management Console only from a defined set of corporate IP addresses. Restrict user access based on job responsibility by using an IAM policy and roles. 错误：IAM策略和角色是针对用户访问权限的管理，与网络层和会话层的加密无关。 错误：此选项未梾及VPC连接，也未满足题目要求的加密和安全控制。
explanations.C: Configure AWS Site-to-Site VPN to connect to the VPC. Configure route table entries to direct traffic from on premises to the VPC. Configure instance security groups and network ACLs to allow only required traffic from on premises. 正确：AWS Site-to-Site VPN提供网络层和会话层的加密，满足题目要求。 正确：通过路由表、实例安全组和网络ACL可以实现流量控制，满足安全控制要求。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Transit Gateway to connect to the VPC. Configure route table entries to direct traffic from on premises to the VPC. Configure instance security groups and network ACLs to allow only required traffic from on premises. 错误：AWS Transit Gateway可以连接多个VPC和本地网络，但它本身不提供流量加密功能。 错误：虽然可以通过路由表、实例安全组和网络ACL实现流量控制，但未满足题目要求的加密功能。

question: Topic 1 A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from a database in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB cluster. The company needs to make the application more secure with minimal programming effort. The company has created credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the credentials in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Create keys in AWS KMS. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation
options.B: Store the credentials in encrypted local storage. Configure the application to load the database credentials from the local storage. Set up a credentials rotation schedule by creating a cron job.

explanations.B: Create an AWS Trusted Advisor report to identify RDS instances to be started and stopped. Create an AWS Lambda function to start and stop the RDS instances. 错误：AWS Trusted Advisor主要用于提供优化建议，例如成本节约、安全性和性能改进。它不是一个调度工具，无法直接用于基于 时间表的资源管理。 此选项与题目要求的“基于时间表”需求不匹配。
explanations.C: Create AWS Systems Manager State Manager associations to start and stop the RDS instances. 错误：AWS Systems Manager State Manager主要用于管理实例的状态配置，例如安装软件或应用补丁。它不适合用于基于时间表 的资源启动和停止。 此选项的功能与题目要求的“基于时间表”需求不匹配。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the RDS instances. 正确：Amazon EventBridge可以基于时间表触发事件，非常适合实现基于时间的资源调度。 通过EventBridge规则，可以设置在工作时间启动RDS实例，在非工作时间停止RDS实例，从而满足题目要求。 结合AWS Lambda函数，可以实现对RDS实例的启动和停止操作。

question: Topic 1 A consumer survey company has gathered data for several years from a specific geographic region. The company stores this data in an Amazon S3 bucket in an AWS Region. The company has started to share this data with a marketing firm in a new geographic region. The company has granted the firm's AWS account access to the $3 bucket. The company wants to minimize the data transfer costs when the marketing firm requests data from the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the Requester Pays feature on the company’s $3 bucket.
options.B: Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the company’s S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm's S3 buckets.
options.C: Configure AWS Resource Access Manager to share the S3 bucket with the marketing firm AWS account.
options.D: Configure the company’s S3 bucket to use S3 Intelligent-Tiering Sync the S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm's S3 buckets.

explanations.A: Configure the Requester Pays feature on the company’s S3 bucket. 正确：Requester Pays功能允许数据请求者承担数据传输费用，而不是数据拥有者。这符合题目要求，即最小化公司承担的传输成 本。
explanations.B: Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the company’s S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm’s S3 buckets. 错误：CRR会将数据复制到另一个区域的S3 bucket，这会产生额外的存储和传输成本，不符合题目要求的“最小化数据传输成本”。
explanations.C: Configure AWS Resource Access Manager to share the S3 bucket with the marketing firm AWS account. 错误：AWS Resource Access Manager用于共享资源（如VPC、子网疨），但不适用于直接共享S3 bucket。此选项与题目要求无 关。
explanations.D: Configure the company’s S3 bucket to use S3 Intelligent-Tiering Sync the S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm’s S3 buckets. 错误：S3 Intelligent-Tiering是用于优化存储成本的功能，与数据传输成本无关。同步到另一个S3 bucket会增加额外的存储和传输 成本。

question: Topic 1 A company uses AWS to host its public ecommerce website. The website uses an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator for traffic from the internet. The Global Accelerator accelerator forwards the traffic to an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is the entry point for an Auto Scaling group. The company recently identified a DDoS attack on the website. The company needs a solution to mitigate future attacks. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Configure an AWS WAF web ACL for the Global Accelerator accelerator to block traffic by using rate-based rules 为 Global Accelerator
options.B: Configure an AWS Lambda function to read the ALB metrics to block attacks by updating a VPC network ACL
options.C: Configure an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB to block traffic by using rate-based rules 在 ALB
options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the Global Accelerator accelerator 在 Global Accelerator

explanations.A: Configure an AWS WAF web ACL for the Global Accelerator accelerator to block traffic by using rate-based rules 错误：虽然AWS WAF可以配置在Global Accelerator上，但Global Accelerator本身并不直接支持Web ACL。AWS WAF通常与ALB或 CloudFront结合使用。 此外，配置WAF在Global Accelerator上需要额外的复杂性，违背了“最少实施努力”的要求。
explanations.B: Configure an AWS Lambda function to read the ALB metrics to block attacks by updating a VPC network ACL 错误：使用Lambda函数读取ALB指标并动嬒更新VPC网络ACL是一种复杂的解决方案，涉及多个组件的集成和编程工作。 这种方法不符合“最少实施努力”的要求。
explanations.C: Configure an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB to block traffic by using rate-based rules 正确：AWS WAF可以直接与ALB集成，并通过基于速率的规则有效地阻止DDoS攻击。 这种方法简单易行，符合“最少实施努力”的要求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the Global Accelerator accelerator 错误：虽然CloudFront可以宿助缓解DDoS攻击，但将CloudFront放在Global Accelerator前面会增加架构复杂性。 此外，Global Accelerator的主要用途是优化全球流量，而不是直接与CloudFront结合使用。

question: Topic 1 A company uses an Amazon DynamoDB table to store data that the company receives from devices. The DynamoDB table supports a customer-facing website to display recent activity on customer devices. The company configured the table with provisioned throughput for writes and reads. The company wants to calculate performance metrics for customer device data on a daily basis. The solution must have minimal effect on the table's provisioned read and write capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon Athena SQL query with the Amazon Athena DynamoDB connector to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule.
options.B: Use an AWS Glue job with the AWS Glue DynamoDB export connector to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule.
options.C: Use an Amazon Redshift COPY command to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule. {FJ Amazon Redshift COPY 命令，
options.D: Use an Amazon EMR job with an Apache Hive external table to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule.

explanations.A: Use an Amazon Athena SQL query with the Amazon Athena DynamoDB connector to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule. 正确性分析：Amazon Athena可以通过DynamoDB connector直接查询DynamoDB表，但这种方法会直接读取表数据，可能会影响 DynamoDB的读容量，违反了题目要求“对表的读写容量影响最小”。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Use an AWS Glue job with the AWS Glue DynamoDB export connector to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule. 正确性分析：AWS Glue DynamoDB export connector可以将DynamoDB表数据导出到其他存储（如S3），然后进行分析。这种方法 不会直接影响DynamoDB表的读写容量，符合题目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Use an Amazon Redshift COPY command to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule. 正确性分析：Amazon Redshift COPY命令需要将数据从DynamoDB导入到Redshift中，但导入过程可能会直接读取DynamoDB表数 据，影响其读容量，违反题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Use an Amazon EMR job with an Apache Hive external table to calculate performance metrics on a recurring schedule. 正确性分析：Amazon EMR可以通过Hive外部表查询DynamoDB数据，但这种方法会直接读取DynamoDB表数据，可能会影响其读 容量，违反题目要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A global ecommerce company uses a monolithic architecture. The company needs a solution to manage the increasing volume of product data. The solution must be scalable and have a modular service architecture. The company needs to maintain its structured database schemas. The company also needs a storage solution to store product data and product images. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group to deploy a containerized application. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute web traffic. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance to store product data and product images.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda functions to manage the existing monolithic application. Use Amazon DynamoDB to store product data and product images. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) for event-driven communication between the Lambda functions.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with an Amazon EC2 deployment to deploy a containerized application. Use an Amazon Aurora cluster to store the product data. Use AWS Step Functions to manage workflows. Store the product images in Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate to deploy a containerized application. Use Amazon RDS with a Multi-AZ deployment to store the product data. Store the product images in an Amazon $3 bucket. {FQ Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 AWS Fargate

explanations.A: 使用EC2实例和RDS： 正确性：EC2实例可以支持容器化应用，RDS可以存储结构化数据。 问题：EC2实例需要孅动管理和维护，增加了操作开销，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 使用Lambda和DynamoDB： 正确性：Lambda函数可以实现无服务器架构，DynamoDB是一个高性能的NoSQL数据寑。 问题：DynamoDB是NoSQL数据寑，不适合存储结构化数据寑模式的数据。此外，Lambda函数不适合直接管理复杂的单体应用。
explanations.C: 使用EKS和Aurora： 正确性：EKS支持容器化应用，Aurora是高性能的关系型数据寑。 问题：EKS需要复杂的管理和配置，增加了操作开销。S3 Glacier Deep Archive不适合频繁访问的产品图片存储。
explanations.D: 使用ECS和Fargate： 正确性：ECS与Fargate提供无服务器容器管理，减少了操作开销。RDS Multi-AZ部署提供高可用性，S3适合存储产品图片。 问题：无明显问题，完全符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating an application from an on-premises environment to AWS. The application will store sensitive data in Amazon $3. The company must encrypt the data before storing the data in Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Encrypt the data by using client-side encryption with customer managed keys.
options.B: Encrypt the data by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.C: Encrypt the data by using server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C).
options.D: Encrypt the data by using client-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys.

explanations.A: Encrypt the data by using client-side encryption with customer managed keys. 正确。客户端加密意味着数据在上传到 Amazon S3之前已经被加密。使用客户管理密迫（Customer Managed Keys）可以确保公司完全控制加密密迫，符合敏感数据保护 的要求。
explanations.B: Encrypt the data by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). 错误。虽然SSE-KMS是一个强大的加密选 项，但它是服务器端加密，数据在传输过程中未加密。题目要求“在存储之前加密数据”，因此不符合要求。
explanations.C: Encrypt the data by using server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C). 错误。SSE-C是服务器端加密，数 据在传输过程中未加密。题目要求“在存储之前加密数据”，因此不符合要求。
explanations.D: Encrypt the data by using client-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys. 错误。Amazon S3管理密迫是由AWS管理 的，客户无法完全控制密迫。题目要求使用客户管理密迫，因此不符合要求。

question: Topic 1 A company wants to create an Amazon EMR cluster that multiple teams will use. The company wants to ensure that each team’s big data workloads can access only the AWS services that each team needs to interact with. The company does not want the workloads to have access to Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) on the cluster’s underlying EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure interface VPC endpoints for each AWS service that the teams need. Use the required interface VPC endpoints to submit the big data workloads.
options.B: Create EMR runtime roles. Configure the cluster to use the runtime roles. Use the runtime roles to submit the big data workloads.
options.C: Create an EC2 IAM instance profile that has the required permissions for each team. Use the instance profile to submit the big data workloads.
options.D: Create an EMR security configuration that has the EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole option set to false. Use the security configuration to submit the big data workloads.

explanations.A: 配置接口 VPC 端点并使用它们提交大数据工作负载。 正确性分析：虽然VPC端点可以限制对特定AWS服务的访问，但它无法直接解决团队权限隔离的问题，也无法禁用IMDSv2。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: 创建EMR运行时角色并配置集群使用这些角色。 正确性分析：EMR运行时角色允许为每个团队分配特定权限，并且可以通过配置来禁用IMDSv2。这是解决问题的正确方法。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.C: 创建EC2 IAM实例配置文件并使用它提交大数据工作负载。 正确性分析：EC2实例配置文件是为EC2实例分配权限的，而不是为EMR集群中的工作负载分配权限。此方法无法实现团队权限隔 离，也无法禁用IMDSv2。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: 创建EMR安全配置并设置EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole为false。 正确性分析：此选项涉及EMR安全配置，但设置EnableApplicationScopedIAMRole为false并不能直接解决团队权限隔离的问题，也 无法禁用IMDSv2。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is designing an application that helps users fill out and submit registration forms. The solutions architect plans to use a two-tier architecture that includes a web application server tier and a worker tier. The application needs to process submitted forms quickly. The application needs to process each form exactly once. The solution must ensure that no data is lost. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
options.B: Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
options.C: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
options.D: Use an AWS Step Functions workflow. Create a synchronous workflow between the web application server tier and the worker tier that stores and forwards form data.

explanations.A: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data. 正确：Amazon SQS FIFO队列可以确保消息的顺序性和“恰好一次”处理，符合题目要求。 FIFO队列适合需要严格顺序和避免重复处理的场景。
explanations.B: Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data. 错误：API Gateway主要用于管理HTTP API请求，不具备消息队列的功能。 无法保证消息的顺序性或“恰好一次”处理。
explanations.C: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data. 错误：标准队列虽然支持高知吐量，但不保证消息的顺序性或“恰好一次”处理。 题目明确要求“恰好一次”处理，因此标准队列不符合要求。
explanations.D: Use an AWS Step Functions workflow. Create a synchronous workflow between the web application server tier and the worker tier that stores and forwards form data. 错误：Step Functions主要用于编排复杂的工作流，而不是简单的消息队列场景。 题目要求快速处理表单数据，Step Functions的同步工作流可能会增加延迟。

question: Topic 1 A finance company uses an on-premises search application to collect streaming data from various producers. The application provides real-time updates to search and visualization features. The company is planning to migrate to AWS and wants to use an AWS native solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 instances to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon S3 buckets tor storage. Use Amazon Athena to search the data. Use Amazon Managed Grafana to create visualizations.
options.B: Use Amazon EMR to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon Redshift for storage. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to search the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon DynamoDB for storage. Use Amazon CloudWatch to create graphical dashboards to search and visualize the data.
options.D: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use OpenSearch Service to search the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon EC2实例将数据流摄取并处理到Amazon S3存储橘进行存储。使用Amazon Athena搜索数据。使用Amazon Managed Grafana创建可视化。 错误：Amazon EC2需要手动管理，目不适合处理实时数据流，痾乏原生流处理能力。 错误：Amazon S3和Athena适合批量数据查询，但不适合实时搜痋。 正确：Amazon Managed Grafana可以创建可视化，但整体方案不符合实时处理需求。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon EMR将数据流摄取并处理到Amazon Redshift进行存储。使用Amazon Redshift Spectrum搜索数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight创建可视化。 错误：Amazon EMR适合大规模数据处理，但不适合实时流处理。 错误：Amazon Redshift是数据仓库服务，适合结构化数据分析，但不适合实时搜痋。 正确：Amazon QuickSight可以创建可视化，但整体方案不符合实时处理需求。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)将数据流摄取并处理到Amazon DynamoDB进行存储。使用Amazon CloudWatch创建图形化仪表板以搜索和可视化数据。 错误：Amazon EKS需要复杂的管理，目不适合直接处理实时数据流。 错误：Amazon DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，适合快速查询，但不适合复杂搜痋功能。 错误：Amazon CloudWatch主要用于畁控和日志分析，不适合复杂数据可视化。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon Kinesis Data Streams将数据流摄取并处理到Amazon OpenSearch Service。使用OpenSearch Service搜索数 据。使用Amazon QuickSight创建可视化。 正确：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams是原生的实时数据流处理服务，适合实时数据摄取和处理。 正确：Amazon OpenSearch Service支持实时搜痋和分析功能，适合实时数据需求。 正确：Amazon QuickSight可以创建可视化，适合展異数据分析结果。

question: Topic 1 A company currently runs an on-premises application that usesASP.NET on Linux machines. The application is resource-intensive and serves customers directly. The company wants to modernize the application to .NET. The company wants to run the application on containers and to scale based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics. The company also wants to reduce the time spent on operational maintenance activities. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
options.B: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.C: Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. 正确性分析：AWS App2Container是一个适合将现有应用程序容器化的工具。AWS Fargate是一个无服务器计算引擎，支持Amazon ECS，能够减少运维开销。使用CloudFormation模板可以实现自动化部署。此选项满足题目要求，包括减少运维开销和基于 CloudWatch指标进行扩展。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 instances. 正确性分析：虽然AWS App2Container可以容器化应用程序，Amazon ECS可以部署容器，但使用Amazon EC2实例会增加运维开销 （例如管理EC2实例的生命周期、打补丁疨）。此选项不符合“减少运维开销”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. 正确性分析：AWS App Runner是一个完全托管的服务，适合直接运行容器化应用程序，但它不支持将应用程序部署到Amazon ECS。此选项在技术上不正确。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2 instances. 正确性分析：AWS App Runner无法直接部署到Amazon EKS。此外，使用Amazon EC2实例会增加运维开销，不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a new internal web application in the AWS Cloud. The new application must securely retrieve and store multiple employee usernames and passwords from an AWS managed service. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve usernames and passwords from Parameter Store.
options.B: Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager.
options.C: Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Parameter Store.
options.D: Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager.

explanations.A: Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve usernames and passwords from Parameter Store. 错误：AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store适合存储配置数据和非敏感人息，但对于敏感人息（如用户名和密码），AWS Secrets Manager是更合适的选择。 错误：BatchGetSecretValue API是Secrets Manager的API，不能用于Parameter Store。
explanations.B: Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager. 错误：虽然Secrets Manager是正确的存储选择，但AWS Batch并不是检索Secrets Manager数据的合适工具。 错误：AWS Batch主要用于运行批处理作业，与检索敏感人息无关。
explanations.C: Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Parameter Store. 错误：同选项A，Parameter Store不适合存储敏感人息。 错误：BatchGetSecretValue API是Secrets Manager的API，不能用于Parameter Store。 错误：AWS Batch与检索敏感人息无关。
explanations.D: Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager. 正确：AWS Secrets Manager专门设计用于存储和管理敏感人息（如用户名和密码）。 正确：BatchGetSecretValue API是Secrets Manager的API，用于检索存储的敏感人息。 正确：此选项使用了正确的服务和API，目操作开销最小。

question: Topic 1 A company that is in the ap-northeast-1 Region has a fleet of thousands of AWS Outposts servers. The company has deployed the servers at remote locations around the world. All the servers regularly download new software versions that consist of 100 files. There is significant latency before all servers run the new software versions. The company must reduce the deployment latency for new software versions. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in ap-northeast-1 that includes a CachingDisabled cache policy. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Create a second S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. Configure replication between the buckets. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses ap-northeast-1 as the primary origin and us-east-1 as the secondary origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Configure Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. Download the software by using the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. € ap-northeast-1
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in ap-northeast-1 that includes a CachingDisabled cache policy. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs. 分析： 虽然使用了 CloudFront，但禁用缓存（CachingDisabled）会导致每次请求都直接回源服务器，无法利用 CloudFront 的缓存优势。 这会增加延迟，尤其是对于全球范围的分发场景。 因此，这个选项不符合减少部署延迟的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Create a second S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. Configure replication between the buckets. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses ap-northeast-1 as the primary origin and us-east-1 as the secondary origin. Download the software by using signed URLs. 分析： 配置了两个 S3 bucket 并设置了复制，但这增加了额外的复杂性和操作开销。 虽然 CloudFront 可以使用多个源，但这种配置并不直接解决全球范围的延迟问题。 此选项的操作开销较高，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Configure Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. Download the software by using the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. 分析： S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以加速跨区域的上传和下载，但它主要适用于单一客户端与 S3 bucket 的交互。 对于全球范围的分发，CloudFront 的边缘缓存更适合，因为它可以将内容缓存到离用户最邮的边缘位置。 此选项虽然减少了延迟，但不如 CloudFront 的分发机制高效。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs. 分析： 使用 CloudFront 分发内容，可以将文件缓存到全球范围的边缘位置，从而显著减少延迟。 签名 URL 提供了安全性，确保只有授权用户可以下载文件。 此选项操作简单，符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。

question: Topic 1 A company currently runs an on-premises stock trading application by using Microsoft Windows Server. The company wants to migrate the application to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to design a highly available solution that provides low-latency access to block storage across multiple Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Configure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster nodes. Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as shared storage between the two cluster nodes.
options.B: Configure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster nodes. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set up application-level replication to sync data from one EBS volume in one Availability Zone to another EBS volume in the second Availability Zone.
options.C: Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Configure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2 instance in standby mode. Use an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file system to access the data by using Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) protocol.
options.D: Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Configure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2 instance in standby mode. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set up Amazon EBS level replication to sync data from one io2 volume in one Availability Zone to another io2 volume in the second Availability Zone. IT

explanations.A: Configure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster nodes. Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as shared storage between the two cluster nodes. 分析： Amazon FSx for Windows File Server是一个托管的Windows文件系统，适合Windows应用程序的共享存储需求。 虽然FSx for Windows File Server支持跨可用区的高可用性，但它主要用于文件共享，而不是低延迟的块存储。 此选项未提到使用块存储（如iSCSI协议），因此不完全满足题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Configure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster nodes. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set up application-level replication to sync data from one EBS volume in one Availability Zone to another EBS volume in the second Availability Zone. 分析： Amazon EBS gp3卷提供高性能块存储，但它不支持跨可用区的原生同步或复制。 应用程序级别的复制需要额外的开发工作，增加了实现复杂性。 此选项的实现努力较高，不符合题目要求的“LEAST implementation effort”。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Configure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2 instance in standby mode. Use an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file system to access the data by using Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) protocol. 分析： Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP支持跨可用区的高可用性，并提供低延迟的块存储访问（通过iSCSI协议）。 此选项直接满足题目要求：高可用、低延迟、跨可用区的块存储。 实现努力较低，因为FSx for NetApp ONTAP是托管服务，减少了配置和管理的复杂性。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Configure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2 instance in standby mode. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set up Amazon EBS level replication to sync data from one io2 volume in one Availability Zone to another io2 volume in the second Availability Zone. 分析： Amazon EBS io2卷提供高性能和高可靠性，但EBS本身不支持跨可用区的原生同步。 设置EBS级别的复制需要额外的配置工作，增加了实现复杂性。 Correct Answer: C 正确答案：C Community vote distribution 畱区投畵分布 C (52%) A (29%) Other IT正确答案社 区投: https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 票分: https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 布人: Examtopics 此选项的实现努力较高，不符合题目要求的“LEAST implementation effort”。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is designing a web application with an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company needs the ALB to receive HTTPS web traffic from the public internet. The ALB must send only HTTPS traffic to the web application servers hosted on the Amazon EC2 instances on port 443. The ALB must perform a health check of the web application servers over HTTPS on port 8443. Which combination of configurations of the security group that is associated with the ALB will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443.
options.B: Allow all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443.
options.C: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for port 443.
options.D: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for port 443.
options.E: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for the health check on port 8443.
options.F: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for the health check on port 8443.

explanations.A: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443. 正确：ALB需要接收来自互联网的HTTPS流量，因此需要允许从0.0.0.0/0到443端口的入站流量。
explanations.B: Allow all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443. 错误：ALB不需要向互联网发送HTTPS流量，出站流量应该限制到目标实例。
explanations.C: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for port 443. 正确：ALB需要将HTTPS流量发送到托管Web应用程序的EC2实例，因此需要允许到443端口的出站流量。
explanations.D: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for port 443. 错误：Web应用程序实例不会向ALB发送HTTPS流量，因此不需要此规则。
explanations.E: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for the health check on port 8443. 正确：ALB需要对Web应用程序实例进行健康检查，健康检查使用HTTPS协议并通过8443端口，因此需要允许此出站流量。
explanations.F: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for the health check on port 8443. 错误：健康检查是ALB向实例发起的请求，实例不会向ALB发送流量，因此不需要此规则。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts an application on AWS. The application gives users the ability to upload photos and store the photos in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon CloudFront and a custom domain name to upload the photo files to the S3 bucket in the eu-west-1 Region. Which solution will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in the us-east-1 Region. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
options.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
options.C: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.D: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront origin access control (OAC).
options.E: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure an Amazon S3 website endpoint.

explanations.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in the us-east-1 Region. Use the certificate in CloudFront. 正确。CloudFront要求使用的证书必须在us-east-1区域创建，因为CloudFront的证书管理是集中在us-east-1区域的。
explanations.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront. 错误。CloudFront不支持在其他区域（如eu-west-1）创建的证书，必须在us-east-1区域创建证书。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration. 错误。S3 Transfer Acceleration是用于加速跨区域或全球范围的上传，但题目没有提到需要加速功能，目与CloudFront的集成不直接 相关。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront origin access control (OAC). 正确。使用CloudFront的源访问控制 (OAC) 是推荐的最佳实践，可以确保只有CloudFront可以访问S3资源。
explanations.E: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure an Amazon S3 website endpoint. 错误。S3网站端点用于静态网站托管，与CloudFront的上传功能无关。

question: Topic 1 A weather forecasting company collects temperature readings from various sensors on a continuous basis. An existing data ingestion process collects the readings and aggregates the readings into larger Apache Parquet files. Then the process encrypts the files by using client-side encryption with KMS managed keys (CSE-KMS). Finally, the process writes the files to an Amazon S3 bucket with separate prefixes for each calendar day. The company wants to run occasional SQL queries on the data to take sample moving averages for a specific calendar day. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure Amazon Athena to read the encrypted files. Run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Select to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. (FA Amazon S3 Select 在 Amazon S3
options.C: Configure Amazon Redshift to read the encrypted files. Use Redshift Spectrum and Redshift query editor v2 to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.D: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to read the encrypted files. Use Apache SparkSQL to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Configure Amazon Athena to read the encrypted files. Run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 正确：Amazon Athena是一种无服务器的交互式查询服务，可以直接查询存储在Amazon S3中的数据。它支持读取加密的Parquet文 件，并且可以通过KMS解密数据。 成本效益高：Athena按查询付费，无需预置资源，非常适合偶尔运行SQL查询的场景。
explanations.B: Use Amazon S3 Select to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 错误：Amazon S3 Select主要用于从单个对象中提取部分数据，而不是运行复杂的SQL查询。题目要求运行SQL查询以计算移动平均 值，S3 Select不适合这种场景。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon Redshift to read the encrypted files. Use Redshift Spectrum and Redshift query editor v2 to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 错误：虽然Redshift Spectrum可以查询存储在S3中的数据，但Redshift需要预置集群，成本较高，不适合偶尔运行查询的场景。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to read the encrypted files. Use Apache SparkSQL to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 错误：Amazon EMR Serverless适合处理大规模数据分析任务，但对于偶尔运行SQL查询的场景，EMR的复杂性和成本较高，不是最 优选择。

question: Topic 1 A company is implementing a new application on AWS. The company will run the application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones within multiple AWS Regions. The application will be available through the internet. Users will access the application from around the world. The company wants to ensure that each user who accesses the application is sent to the EC2 instances that are closest to the user's location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.B: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.C: Implement an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.D: Implement an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.

explanations.A: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析：Geolocation routing policy 是基于用户的地理位置来路由流量，但它无法动态调整到“最邮的”资源，只能基于预定义 的地理区域进行分配。 错误原因：题目要求将用户路由到“最邮的”EC2实例，而 Geolocation routing 不能动态计算距离。
explanations.B: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析：Geoproximity routing policy 是基于用户和资源之间的距离来路由流量，可以动态调整到“最邮的”资源。 正确原因：此选项满足题目要求，将用户路由到最邮的 EC2 实例，同时 Network Load Balancer 可以高效处理跨区域流量。
explanations.C: Implement an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析：Multivalue answer routing policy 返回多个 IP 地址供客户端选择，但它不基于用户位置动态调整流量。 错误原因：此选项无法满足题目要求的“最邮的”资源路由功能。
explanations.D: Implement an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析：Weighted routing policy 是基于预定义权重分配流量，而不是基于用户位置动态调整流量。 错误原因：此选项无法满足题目要求的“最邮的”资源路由功能。

question: Topic 1 A financial services company plans to launch a new application on AWS to handle sensitive financial transactions. The company will deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company will use Amazon RDS for MySQL as the database. The company’s security policies mandate that data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit.
options.B: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure IPsec tunnels for encryption in transit.
options.C: Implement third-party application-level data encryption before storing data in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit.
options.D: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure a VPN connection to enable private connectivity to encrypt data in transit.

explanations.A: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit. 正确：AWS KMS 是原生支持的服务，可以答案配置 RDS 数据加密，目操作开销低。 正确：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 提供托管的 SSL/TLS 证书，自动化管理证书生命周期，适合加密数据传输。 此选项完全符合要求，并且操作开销最低。
explanations.B: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure IPsec tunnels for encryption in transit. 正确：AWS KMS 可以答案配置 RDS 数据加密。 错误：IPsec 輳社通常用于网痬层加密（如 VPN），而不是直接用于应用层数据传输加密。配置和维护 IPsec 輳社需要额外的操作开 销。
explanations.C: Implement third-party application-level data encryption before storing data in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit. 错误：疦三方应用程序级数据加密需要开发人员额外的工作，增加了操作开销。 正确：ACM SSL/TLS 证书可以加密数据传输。 此选项增加了不必要的复杂性，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure a VPN connection to enable private connectivity to encrypt data in transit. 正确：AWS KMS 可以答案配置 RDS 数据加密。 错误：VPN 连接主要用于网痬层的私有连接，而不是直接用于应用层数据加密。配置和维护 VPN 连接需要额外的操作开销。

question: Topic 1 A company is migrating its on-premises Oracle database to an Amazon RDS for Oracle database. The company needs to retain data for 90 days to meet regulatory requirements. The company must also be able to restore the database to a specific point in time for up to 14 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon RDS automated backups. Set the retention period to 90 days.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS manual snapshot every day. Delete manual snapshots that are older than 90 days.
options.C: Use the Amazon Aurora Clone feature for Oracle to create a point-in-time restore. Delete clones that are older than 90 days.
options.D: Create a backup plan that has a retention period of 90 days by using AWS Backup for Amazon RDS.

explanations.A: Create Amazon RDS automated backups. Set the retention period to 90 days. 错误：Amazon RDS自动备份的最大保留期为35天，无法满足90天的保留要求。 虽然自动备份支持点时间恢复，但无法满足90天的保留需求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon RDS manual snapshot every day. Delete manual snapshots that are older than 90 days. 正确性：手动快照可以满足90天的保留要求。 错误：需要每天手动创建快照并管理删除操作，增加了操作开销，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Use the Amazon Aurora Clone feature for Oracle to create a point-in-time restore. Delete clones that are older than 90 days. 错误：Amazon Aurora Clone是Aurora特有的功能，不适用于Amazon RDS for Oracle。 此选项与题目要求不符。
explanations.D: Create a backup plan that has a retention period of 90 days by using AWS Backup for Amazon RDS. 正确性：AWS Backup支持为Amazon RDS创建备份计划，并可以设置保留期为90天。 正确性：AWS Backup支持点时间恢复，目操作开销最少。 此选项完全满足题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is developing a new application that uses a relational database to store user data and application configurations. The company expects the application to have steady user growth. The company expects the database usage to be variable and read- heavy, with occasional writes. The company wants to cost-optimize the database solution. The company wants to use an AWS managed database solution that will provide the necessary performance. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD storage to ensure consistent performance for read and write operations.
options.B: Deploy the database on Amazon Aurora Serverless to automatically scale the database capacity based on actual usage to accommodate the workload.
options.C: Deploy the database on Amazon DynamoDB. Use on-demand capacity mode to automatically scale throughput to accommodate the workload.
options.D: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use magnetic storage and use read replicas to accommodate the workload.

explanations.A: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD storage to ensure consistent performance for read and write operations. 正确性分析：Provisioned IOPS SSD存储确实可以提供一致的性能，但它的成本较高，不符合题目中“成本优化”的要求。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Deploy the database on Amazon Aurora Serverless to automatically scale the database capacity based on actual usage to accommodate the workload. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora Serverless支持自动扩展数据库容量，能够根据实际使用情况动态调整资源，适合读多写少的场景， 同时成本优化效果显著。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.C: Deploy the database on Amazon DynamoDB. Use on-demand capacity mode to automatically scale throughput to accommodate the workload. 正确性分析：DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，不适合存储关系型数据（如用户数据和应用配置），与题目要求不符。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use magnetic storage and use read replicas to accommodate the workload. 正确性分析：磁性存储的性能较低，不适合读多写少的场景；虽然读副本可以提高读取性能，但整体方案不够成本优化。 结论：此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its application on several Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC. The company creates a dedicated Amazon S3 bucket for each customer to store their relevant information in Amazon S3. The company wants to ensure that the application running on EC2 instances can securely access only the S3 buckets that belong to the company’s AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 that is attached to the VPC. Update the IAM instance profile policy to provide access to only the specific buckets that the application needs.
options.B: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet with a security group that allows access to only Amazon S3. Update the route tables to use the NAT Gateway.
options.C: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 that is attached to the VPUpdate the IAM instance profile policy with a Deny action and the following condition key: { “StringNotEquals" : { "s3:ResourceAccount" : [ "CompanyAWSAcctNumber"] } 为Amazon S3
options.D: Create a NAT Gateway in a public subnet. Update route tables to use the NAT Gateway. Assign bucket policies for all buckets with a Deny action and the following condition key: IT

explanations.A: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 that is attached to the VPC. Update the IAM instance profile policy to provide access to only the specific buckets that the application needs. 正确性分析：使用网关端点可以安全地访问S3，而无需通过互联网。更新IAM实例配置文件策略可以限制对特定存储橘的访问。 问题：虽然可以实现目标，但需要孅动更新IAM策略以限制访问特定存储橘，增加了操作开销。 结论：此选项正确但不是操作开销最小的解决方案。
explanations.B: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet with a security group that allows access to only Amazon S3. Update the route tables to use the NAT Gateway. 正确性分析：NAT网关允许私有子网中的实例访问互联网资源，包括S3。 问题：使用NAT网关会增加成本，并且安全组无法直接限制对特定S3存储橘的访问。 结论：此选项不符合要求，因为它无法证保仅访问公司账户的S3存储橘。
explanations.C: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 that is attached to the VPC. Update the IAM instance profile policy with a Deny action and the following condition key: 正确性分析：网关端点提供安全的S3访问。通过IAM策略中的Deny操作和条件键，可以确保实例只能访问公司账户的S3存储橘。 优势：此方法自动化程寗高，操作开销最小。 结论：此选项是正确答案。
explanations.D: Create a NAT Gateway in a public subnet. Update route tables to use the NAT Gateway. Assign bucket policies for all buckets with a Deny action and the following condition key: 正确性分析：NAT网关允许私有子网中的实例访问互联网资源，包括S3。通过存储橘策略可以限制访问。 问题：使用NAT网关增加了成本，目需要为每个存储橘单独配置策略，操作开销较高。 结论：此选项不符合要求，因为操作开销较高。

question: Topic 1 A company is building a cloud-based application on AWS that will handle sensitive customer data. The application uses Amazon RDS for the database, Amazon S3 for object storage, and S3 Event Notifications that invoke AWS Lambda for serverless processing. The company uses AWS IAM Identity Center to manage user credentials. The development, testing, and operations teams need secure access to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3 while ensuring the confidentiality of sensitive customer data. The solution must comply with the principle of least privilege. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use IAM roles with least privilege to grant all the teams access. Assign IAM roles to each team with customized IAM policies defining specific permission for Amazon RDS and S3 object access based on team responsibilities.
options.B: Enable IAM Identity Center with an Identity Center directory. Create and configure permission sets with granular access to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3. Assign all the teams to groups that have specific access with the permission sets.
options.C: Create individual IAM users for each member in all the teams with role-based permissions. Assign the IAM roles with predefined policies for RDS and S3 access to each user based on user needs. Implement IAM Access Analyzer for periodic credential evaluation.
options.D: Use AWS Organizations to create separate accounts for each team. Implement cross-account IAM roles with least privilege. Grant specific permission for RDS and S3 access based on team roles and responsibilities. IT

explanations.A: 使用IAM角色为所有团队授予访问权限： 正确性：使用IAM角色可以实现最小权限原则，并且可以为不同团队分配自定义策略。 问题：需要手动创建和管理多个IAM角色及策略，增加了操作复杂性和管理开销。 结论：虽然满足要求，但操作开销较高，不是最佳解决方案。
explanations.B: 启用IAM Identity Center并使用权限集： 正确性：IAM Identity Center支持集中管理用户身份和权限，权限集可以实现细粒度控制，符合最小权限原则。 优势：通过组和权限集的管理，简化了操作开销，同时确保安全性和合规性。 结论：满足所有要求，并且操作开销最低，是最佳解决方案。
explanations.C: 为每个成员创建IAM用户并分配角色： 正确性：可以通过IAM用户和角色实现权限管理。 问题：需要为桹个用户单栘创建IAM用户和分配权限，管理复杂性高，目不符合集中管理的最佳实践。 结论：操作开销高，不是最佳解决方案。
explanations.D: 使用AWS Organizations创建单独账户： 正确性：跨账户IAM角色可以实现权限管理，并且符合最小权限原则。 问题：创建多个账户增加了管理复杂性，目不必要地增加了操作开销。 结论：虽然满足要求，但操作开销较高，不是最佳解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains sensitive data files. The company has an application that runs on virtual machines in an on-premises data center. The company currently uses AWS IAM Identity Center. The application requires temporary access to files in the S3 bucket. The company wants to grant the application secure access to the files in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket policy that permits access to the bucket from the public IP address range of the company’s on-premises data center.
options.B: Use IAM Roles Anywhere to obtain security credentials in IAM Identity Center that grant access to the S3 bucket. Configure the virtual machines to assume the role by using the AWS CLI.
options.C: Install the AWS CLI on the virtual machine. Configure the AWS CLI with access keys from an IAM user that has access to the bucket.
options.D: Create an IAM user and policy that grants access to the bucket. Store the access key and secret key for the IAM user in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the access key and secret key at startup.

explanations.A: Create an S3 bucket policy that permits access to the bucket from the public IP address range of the company’s on- premises data center. 错误：通过IP地址范围限制访问虽然可以实现访问控制，但这种方法不够安全，尤其是对于敏感数据文件。IP地址可能会被伪造， 目无法提供临时认证。
explanations.B: Use IAM Roles Anywhere to obtain security credentials in IAM Identity Center that grant access to the S3 bucket. Configure the virtual machines to assume the role by using the AWS CLI. 正确：IAM Roles Anywhere允许本地应用程序安全地获取临时认证并访问AWS资源。通过AWS CLI配置虚拟机以承担角色是安全目 符合最佳实践的解决方案。
explanations.C: Install the AWS CLI on the virtual machine. Configure the AWS CLI with access keys from an IAM user that has access to the bucket. 错误：直接使用IAM用户的访问密钥和秘密密钥存在安全风险，因为这些密钥是长期认证，容易被泄需或小用。
explanations.D: Create an IAM user and policy that grants access to the bucket. Store the access key and secret key for the IAM user in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the access key and secret key at startup. 错误：虽然使用AWS Secrets Manager存储密钥可以提高安全性，但仍然依赖IAM用户的长期认证，不符合临时访问的最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its core network services, including directory services and DNS, in its on-premises data center. The data center is connected to the AWS Cloud using AWS Direct Connect (DX). Additional AWS accounts are planned that will require quick, cost- effective, and consistent access to these network services. What should a solutions architect implement to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Create a DX connection in each new account. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers.
options.B: Configure VPC endpoints in the DX VPC for all required services. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers.
options.C: Create a VPN connection between each new account and the DX VPRoute the network traffic to the on-premises servers.
options.D: Configure AWS Transit Gateway between the accounts. Assign DX to the transit gateway and route network traffic to the on- premises servers.

explanations.A: Create a DX connection in each new account. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers. 错误：创建多个DX连接会导致高成本，因为每个DX连接都需要额外的费用。 错误：运营开销较高，因为需要为每个账户单独配置DX连接。 不符合题目要求的“LEAST amount of operational overhead”。
explanations.B: Configure VPC endpoints in the DX VPC for all required services. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers. 错误：VPC Endpoints主要用于访问AWS服务（如S3、DynamoDB），而不是用于连接本地数据中心。 错误：无法直接通过VPC Endpoints实现跨账户的网络连接到本地服务器。
explanations.C: Create a VPN connection between each new account and the DX VPC. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers. 错误：为每个账户创建VPN连接会增加运营开销和复杂性。 错误：VPN连接的性能通常不如DX连接，目不符合题目要求的“快速、成本效益高、稳定”。
explanations.D: Configure AWS Transit Gateway between the accounts. Assign DX to the transit gateway and route network traffic to the on-premises servers. 正确：AWS Transit Gateway可以高效地连接多个VPC和账户，简化网络架构。 正确：将DX连接分配给Transit Gateway可以实现快速、稳定的网络连接到本地数据中心。 正确：符合题目要求的“LEAST amount of operational overhead”。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its main public web application in one AWS Region across multiple Availability Zones. The application uses an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A web development team needs a cost-optimized compute solution to improve the company’s ability to serve dynamic content globally to millions of customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the existing ALB as the origin.
options.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to serve traffic to the ALB and EC2 instances based on the geographic location of each customer.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with public read access enabled. Migrate the web application to the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting.
options.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to directly serve content from the web application to the location of each customer.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the existing ALB as the origin. 正确：Amazon CloudFront是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以缓存和分发动态内容，减少延迟并优化成本。 将现有的ALB配置为CloudFront的源是一个常见的架构模式，可以有效地将动态内容分发到全球用户。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to serve traffic to the ALB and EC2 instances based on the geographic location of each customer. 错误：虽然Amazon Route 53支持基于地理位置的流量路由，但它无法优化动态内容的分发，也无法提供缓存功能。 此选项没有提到如何降低成本或提高性能。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with public read access enabled. Migrate the web application to the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. 错误：Amazon S3适用于静态网站托管，而题目明确提到需要优化动态内容的分发。 动态内容无法直接通过S3托管实现，目迁移整个应用程序到S3并不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to directly serve content from the web application to the location of each customer. 错误：AWS Direct Connect是一个网络连接服务，用于建立专线连接，适合企业内部网络与AWS之间的通人。 Direct Connect不适用于动态内容的全球分发，也无法优化成本。

question: Topic 1 A company stores user data in AWS. The data is used continuously with peak usage during business hours. Access patterns vary, with some data not being used for months at a time. A solutions architect must choose a cost-effective solution that maintains the highest level of durability while maintaining high availability. Which storage solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon S3 Standard
options.B: Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.C: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.D: Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-lA)

explanations.A: Amazon S3 Standard Amazon S3 Standard提供高可用性和高耐久性，适合频繁访问的数据。然而，它的成本较高，不适合访问模式变化较大的场景。因 此，此选项错误。
explanations.B: Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering根据访问模式自动将数据移动到最合适的存储层。它支持高可用性和高耐久性，同时优化成本，非常 适合访问模式变化的场景。因此，此选项正确。
explanations.C: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive是最低成本的存储选项，但它主要用于长期存桂数据，桌索时间较长，不适合需要高可用性和频繁 访问的数据。因此，此选项错误。
explanations.D: Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) Amazon S3 One Zone-IA成本较低，但它仅存储在单个可用区中，无法提供高可用性，不符合题目要求。因此，此选项错误。

question: Topic 1 A company is testing an application that runs on an Amazon EC2 Linux instance. A single 500 GB Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSO (gp2) volume is attached to the EC2 instance. The company will deploy the application on multiple EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. All instances require access to the data that is stored in the EBS volume. The company needs a highly available and resilient solution that does not introduce significant changes to the application's code. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an EC2 instance that uses NFS server software. Attach a single 500 GB gp2 EBS volume to the instance.
options.B: Provision an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Configure the file system as an SMB file store within a single Availability Zone.
options.C: Provision an EC2 instance with two 250 GB Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes.
options.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure the file system to use General Purpose performance mode.

explanations.A: Provision an EC2 instance that uses NFS server software. Attach a single 500 GB gp2 EBS volume to the instance. 正确性分析：虽然 NFS 可以提供共享存储，但它依赖于单个 EC2 实例作为服务器。如果该实例发生故障，存储将不可用，因此不 符合高可用性和弹性要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Provision an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Configure the file system as an SMB file store within a single Availability Zone. 正确性分析：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是一种专为 Windows 应用程序设计的文件存储解决方案，使用 SMB 协议。但题 目未提到应用程序需要 Windows 文件系统支持。此外，单可用区配置不符合高可用性要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Provision an EC2 instance with two 250 GB Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes. 正确性分析：此选项仅提供了高性能存储，但没有解决共享存储的需求。多个 EC2 实例无法直接访问这些 EBS 卷。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure the file system to use General Purpose performance mode. 正确性分析：Amazon EFS 是一个完全托管的共享文件存储服务，支持多个 EC2 实例同时访问。General Purpose 性能模式提供高可 用性和弹性，符合题目要求。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company recently launched a new application for its customers. The application runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. End users use TCP to communicate with the application. The application must be highly available and must automatically scale as the number of users increases. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances.
options.C: Add an Application Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.D: Manually add more EC2 instances for the application.
options.E: Add a Gateway Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Add a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances. 正确：Network Load Balancer (NLB) 是一种高性能负载均衡器，适用于处理 TCP 流量。题目明确提到用户使用 TCP 与应用通人， 因此 NLB 是合适的选择。 成本效益：NLB 的性能和成本在处理 TCP 流量时非常高效。
explanations.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. 正确：Auto Scaling 组可以根据用户需求动态调整 EC2 实例的数量，从而实现自动扩展和高可用性。 成本效益：通过自动扩展，避免了资源社度分配，节约了成本。
explanations.C: Add an Application Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances. 错误：Application Load Balancer (ALB) 主要用于处理 HTTP 和 HTTPS 流量，而题目明确提到用户使用 TCP 通人，因此 ALB 不适合 此场景。
explanations.D: Manually add more EC2 instances for the application. 错误：手动添加 EC2 实例无法实现自动扩展，目管理成本较高，不符合题目要求的“自动扩展”和“高可用性”。
explanations.E: Add a Gateway Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances. 错误：Gateway Load Balancer 主要用于网络流量的第三方虚拟设备（如防棨墙、入侵桌测系统），不适用于直接处理 TCP 流量的 应用负载均衡。

question: Topic 1 A company runs database workloads on AWS that are the backend for the company’s customer portals. The company runs a Multi-AZ database cluster on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company needs to implement a 30-day backup retention policy. The company currently has both automated RDS backups and manual RDS backups. The company wants to maintain both types of existing RDS backups that are less than 30 days old. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups by using AWS Backup. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days.
options.B: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.
options.C: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days automatically by using AWS CloudFormation. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.

explanations.A: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups by using AWS Backup. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days. 正确性分析：AWS Backup可以管理RDS备份，但题目并未提到需要使用AWS Backup来配置备份策略。手动删除手动备份是可行 的，但没有提到如何自动化这一过程。 成本分析：使用AWS Backup可能会增加额外的成本，而题目要求最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. 正确性分析：禁用自动备份会导致数据保护风险，不符合题目要求。删除备份的操作也没有提到如何自动化。 成本分析：禁用自动备份可能会降低成本，但会增加数据丢失的风险，不符合最佳实践。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days. 正确性分析：配置自动备份的保留策略为30天是正确的做法。手动删除超过30天的手动备份是可行的，并且符合题目要求。 成本分析：此选项不需要额外的服务或工具，符合成本效益的要求。 结论：此选项符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days automatically by using AWS CloudFormation. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. 正确性分析：禁用自动备份会导致数据保护风险，不符合题目要求。使用AWS CloudFormation删除备份并不是最佳实践，因为 CloudFormation主要用于资源的创建和管理，而不是备份管理。 成本分析：禁用自动备份可能会降低成本，但会增加数据丢失的风险，不符合最佳实践。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。

question: Topic 1 A company is planning to migrate a legacy application to AWS. The application currently uses NFS to communicate to an on- premises storage solution to store application data. The application cannot be modified to use any other communication protocols other than NFS for this purpose. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend for use after the migration?

options.A: AWS DataSync
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.D: Amazon EMR File System (Amazon EMRFS)

explanations.A: AWS DataSync 错误：AWS DataSync是一种数据迁移服务，用于将数据从本地存储迁移到AWS存储服务（如EFS或S3）。它不提供直接的NFS存储 功能。
explanations.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 错误：Amazon EBS是块存储服务，主要用于与EC2实例配合使用。它不支持NFS协议，无法满足题目中应用的需求。
explanations.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 正确：Amazon EFS是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，支持NFS协议。它可以直接与迁移后的应用集成，满足题目中应用的需求。
explanations.D: Amazon EMR File System (Amazon EMRFS) 错误：Amazon EMRFS是专门为Amazon EMR（Elastic MapReduce）设计的文件系统，主要用于与S3集成。它不支持NFS协议，无 法满足题目中应用的需求。

question: Topic 1 A company uses GPS trackers to document the migration patterns of thousands of sea turtles. The trackers check every 5 minutes to see if a turtle has moved more than 100 yards (91.4 meters). If a turtle has moved, its tracker sends the new coordinates to a web application running on three Amazon EC2 instances that are in multiple Availability Zones in one AWS Region. Recently, the web application was overwhelmed while processing an unexpected volume of tracker data. Data was lost with no way to replay the events. A solutions architect must prevent this problem from happening again and needs a solution with the least operational overhead. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the data. Configure the application to scan for new data in the bucket for processing.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to handle transmitted location coordinates. Use an AWS Lambda function to process each item concurrently.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to store the incoming data. Configure the application to poll for new messages for processing.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store transmitted location coordinates. Configure the application to query the table for new data for processing. Use TTL to remove data that has been processed.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the data. Configure the application to scan for new data in the bucket for processing. 错误原因：Amazon S3是对象存储服务，适合存储静态文件或数据，但不适合处理实时数据流。扫描S3 bucket的方式效率低下，目 无法保证数据处理的顺序或可靠性。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to handle transmitted location coordinates. Use an AWS Lambda function to process each item concurrently. 错误原因：虽然API Gateway和Lambda可以处理并发请求，但它们无法缓冲数据流。如果流量激增，API Gateway可能会超载，导 致数据丢失。此外，这种方案需要额外的配置和管理，运营开销较高。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to store the incoming data. Configure the application to poll for new messages for processing. 正确原因：Amazon SQS是专门设计用于缓冲和存储消息的服务，能够处理高并发数据流并防止数据丢失。应用程序可以轮询队列 中的消息，确保数据按顺序处理。这种方案具有低运营开销，目非常可靠。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store transmitted location coordinates. Configure the application to query the table for new data for processing. Use TTL to remove data that has been processed. 错误原因：虽然DynamoDB可以存储数据并支持TTL清理，但它不是设计用于处理实时数据流的最佳选择。查询新数据的方式效率 较低，目无法保证数据处理的顺序。此外，运营开销较高。

question: Topic 1 A company's software development team needs an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ cluster. The RDS cluster will serve as a backend for a desktop client that is deployed on premises. The desktop client requires direct connectivity to the RDS cluster. The company must give the development team the ability to connect to the cluster by using the client when the team is in the office. Which solution provides the required connectivity MOST securely?

options.A: Create a VPC and two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
options.B: Create a VPC and two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
options.C: Create a VPC and two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use RDS security groups to allow the company's office IP ranges to access the cluster.
options.D: Create a VPC and two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Create a cluster user for each developer. Use RDS security groups to allow the users to access the cluster.

explanations.A: 创建一个 VPC 和两个公共子网。在公共子网中创建 RDS 集群。使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 和公司办公室的客户网关。 错误：将RDS部署在公共子网中会暴需数据寑实例的公网IP地址，增加安全风险。 虽然使用Site-to-Site VPN可以提供安全连接，但公共子网的选择违背了最佳实践。
explanations.B: 创建一个 VPC 和两个私有子网。在私有子网中创建 RDS 集群。使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 和公司办公室的客户网关。 正确：将RDS部署在私有子网中可以确保数据寑实例不会直接暴需在互联网中，符合安全最佳实践。 使用AWS Site-to-Site VPN可以安全地连接公司办公孭和AWS VPC，满足题目要求。
explanations.C: 创建一个 VPC 和两个私有子网。在私有子网中创建 RDS 集群。使用 RDS security groups 允许公司的办公室 IP 范围访问集 群。 错误：虽然RDS安全组可以限制访问，但没有提到如何建立安全的网络连接（如VPN）。 直接依赖IP范围访问可能不够安全，完其是在动嬒IP环境中。
explanations.D: 创建一个 VPC 和两个公共子网。在公共子网中创建 RDS 集群。为每个开发人员创建一个集群用户。使用 RDS security groups 允许用户访问集群。 错误：将RDS部署在公共子网中会暴需数据寑实例的公网IP地址，增加安全风险。 为每个开发人员创建用户并使用安全组限制访问虽然可以控制权限，但公共子网的选择违背了安全最佳实践。

question: Topic 1 A solutions architect is creating an application that will handle batch processing of large amounts of data. The input data will be held in Amazon S3 and the output data will be stored in a different S3 bucket. For processing, the application will transfer the data over the network between multiple Amazon EC2 instances. What should the solutions architect do to reduce the overall data transfer costs?

options.A: Place all the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Place all the EC2 instances in the same AWS Region.
options.C: Place all the EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone.
options.D: Place all the EC2 instances in private subnets in multiple Availability Zones.

explanations.A: Place all the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. 错误：Auto Scaling组的主要作用是根据负载动嬒调整实例数量，与数据传输成本优化无直接关系。
explanations.B: Place all the EC2 instances in the same AWS Region. 错误：虽然在同一个Region内传输数据桻跨Region传输便孧，但在同一个Region内的不同可用区之间传输数据仍然会产椹费用。
explanations.C: Place all the EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone. 正确：在同一个可用区内的EC2实例之间传输数据是免费的，因此将所有实例放置在同一个可用区可以有效减少数据传输成本。
explanations.D: Place all the EC2 instances in private subnets in multiple Availability Zones. 错误：虽然使用私有子网可以提高安全性，但在多个可用区之间传输数据仍然会产椹费用。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company's IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.
options.B: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.
options.C: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.
options.D: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket. IT

Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file.
