question: Topic 1 A streaming media company is rebuilding its infrastructure to accommodate increasing demand for video content that users consume daily. The company needs to process terabyte-sized videos to block some content in the videos. Video processing can take up to 20 minutes. The company needs a solution that will scale with demand and remain cost-effective. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda functions to process videos. Store video metadata in Amazon DynamoDB. Store video content in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) and AWS Fargate to implement microservices to process videos. Store video metadata in Amazon Aurora. Store video content in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to process videos. Store video content in Amazon S3 Standard. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for queuing and to decouple processing tasks. 1£— BF Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的Auto scaling
options.D: Deploy a containerized video processing application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2. Store video metadata in Amazon RDS in a single Availability Zone. Store video content in Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Lambda函数处理视频。 错误：AWS Lambda适合处理短时间的任务（最大15分钟），而题目中视频处理需要20分钟，超出了Lambda的执行时间限制。 正确：Amazon DynamoDB是一个高性能的NoSQL数据库，适合存储视频元数据。 正确：Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以根据访问模式自动优化存储成本。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon ECS和AWS Fargate实现布服务来处理视频。 正确：Amazon ECS和AWS Fargate支持容器化应用，能够处理长时间运行的任务，并且可以根据需求自动扩展，适合视频处理场 景。 正确：Amazon Aurora是一个高性能的关系型数据库，适合存储结构化的元数据。 正确：Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以优化存储成本，适合存储视频内容。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon EC2实例在Auto Scaling组中处理视频。 正确：EC2实例可以处理长时间运行的任务，并且Auto Scaling组可以根据需求扩展计算资源。 正确：Amazon SQS可以解兢任务并实现队列管理。 错误：Amazon S3 Standard虽然适合存储视频内容，但没有提供成本优化功能，题目要求成本效益。
explanations.D: 在Amazon EKS上部署容器化的视频处理应用程序。 正确：Amazon EKS支持容器化应用，适合处理复杂的工作负载。 错误：Amazon RDS在单一可用区中部署会导致高可用性问题，不符合最佳实践。 错误：Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive适合长期存储冷数据，不适合频繁访问的视频内容。

question: Topic 1 A company runs an on-premises application on a Kubernetes cluster. The company recently added millions of new customers. The company's existing on-premises infrastructure is unable to handle the large number of new customers. The company needs to migrate the on-premises application to the AWS Cloud. The company will migrate to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company does not want to manage the underlying compute infrastructure for the new architecture on AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use a self-managed node to supply compute capacity. Deploy the application to the new EKS cluster.
options.B: Use managed node groups to supply compute capacity. Deploy the application to the new EKS cluster.
options.C: Use AWS Fargate to supply compute capacity. Create a Fargate profile. Use the Fargate profile to deploy the application.
options.D: Use managed node groups with Karpenter to supply compute capacity. Deploy the application to the new EKS cluster.

explanations.A: 使用自管理节点提供计算容量。将应用程序部署到新的 EKS 集群。 错误：自管理节点需要用户手动管理底层计算资源，包括 EC2 实例的启动、配置、畁控和维护。这增加了操作开销，不符合题目要 求的“最少操作开销”。
explanations.B: 使用托管节点组提供计算容量。将应用程序部署到新的 EKS 集群。 部分正确：托管节点组减少了部分管理工作，因为 AWS 会自动管理节点生命周期（例如自动修复和更新）。但仍然需要管理底层 EC2 实例，操作开销比 Fargate 高。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Fargate 提供计算容量。创建一个 Fargate 配置文件。使用 Fargate 配置文件部署应用程序。 正确：AWS Fargate 是一种无服务器计算选项，完全消除了对底层计算资源的管理需求。用户只需定义任务和服务，AWS 会自动处 理资源分配和管理。这是最少操作开销的解决方案。
explanations.D: 使用带有 Karpenter 的托管节点组提供计算容量。将应用程序部署到新的 EKS 集群。 部分正确：Karpenter 是一种自动扩展工具，可以动态调整节点组的大小以满足工作负载需求。但它仍然依赖托管节点组，因此需 要管理底层 EC2 实例，操作开销比 Fargate 高。

question: Topic 1 A company is launching a new application that requires a structured database to store user profiles, application settings, and transactional data. The database must be scalable with application traffic and must offer backups. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy a self-managed database on Amazon EC2 instances by using open source software. Use Spot Instances for cost optimization. Configure automated backups to Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS. Use on-demand capacity mode for the database with General Purpose SSD storage. Configure automatic backups with a retention period of 7 days. {FA Amazon RDS。
options.C: Use Amazon Aurora Serverless for the database. Use serverless capacity scaling. Configure automated backups to Amazon s3.
options.D: Deploy a self-managed NoSQL database on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for cost optimization. Configure automated backups directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. ££ Amazon EC2

explanations.A: Deploy a self-managed database on Amazon EC2 instances by using open source software. Use Spot Instances for cost optimization. Configure automated backups to Amazon S3. 正确性分析：虽然使用 Spot Instances 可以降低成本，但自托管数据库需要额外的管理工作，包括安装、维护、扩展和备份配置。 这增加了复杂性和运营成本。 备份到 Amazon S3 是可行的，但不如 Amazon RDS 或 Aurora 的自动备份机制方便。 错误原因：不符合“最成本效益”的要求，因为管理开销较高。
explanations.B: Use Amazon RDS. Use on-demand capacity mode for the database with General Purpose SSD storage. Configure automatic backups with a retention period of 7 days. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS 提供托管的关系型数据库服务，支持自动备份和扩展，使用 General Purpose SSD 存储是一个合理的选 择。 错误原因：虽然 RDS 是一个不错的选择，但使用按需容量模式可能会导致成本高于 Aurora Serverless，尤其是在流量波动较大的情 况下。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Aurora Serverless for the database. Use serverless capacity scaling. Configure automated backups to Amazon S3. 正确性分析：Amazon Aurora Serverless 是一个无服务器的关系型数据库解决方案，支持自动扩展和按需计费，非常适合流量波动 的应用场景。 备份机制自动集成到 Amazon S3，简化了管理工作。 正确原因：最符合题目要求的“最成本效益”解决方案。
explanations.D: Deploy a self-managed NoSQL database on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for cost optimization. Configure automated backups directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. 正确性分析：NoSQL 数据库不适合存储结构化数据（如用户配置文件和事务数据）。 虽然 Reserved Instances 可以降低成本，但自托管数据库仍然需要额外的管理工作。 错误原因：不符合题目要求的“结构化数据库”和“最成本效益”解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its legacy web application on AWS. The web application server runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in the public subnet of a VPC. The web application server collects images from customers and stores the image files in a locally attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The image files are uploaded every night to an Amazon S3 bucket for backup. A solutions architect discovers that the image files are being uploaded to Amazon S3 through the public endpoint. The solutions architect needs to ensure that traffic to Amazon S3 does not use the public endpoint. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket that has the necessary permissions for the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to use the gateway VPC endpoint.
options.B: Move the S3 bucket inside the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to access the S3 bucket through private IP addresses.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 access point for the Amazon EC2 instance inside the VPConfigure the web application to upload by using the Amazon S3 access point.
options.D: Configure an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC that has the Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon S3 to provide a dedicated network path.

explanations.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket that has the necessary permissions for the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to use the gateway VPC endpoint. 正确：Gateway VPC Endpoint允许流量通过私有网络直接访问Amazon S3，而无需通过公有端点。 通过配置子网路由表，流量可以通过VPC Endpoint访问S3，满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Move the S3 bucket inside the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to access the S3 bucket through private IP addresses. 错误：S3是一个区域级服务，不能直接“移动”到VPC内部。 即使配置了私有IP地址，S3的架构设计不支持这种方式。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 access point for the Amazon EC2 instance inside the VPC. Configure the web application to upload by using the Amazon S3 access point. 错误：S3 Access Point是用于简化大规模数据访问的工具，但它仍然依赖于公有端点或VPC Endpoint。 题目要求避免使用公有端点，而此选项未解决该问题。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC that has the Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon S3 to provide a dedicated network path. 错误：Direct Connect主要用于连接本地数据中心与AWS，而不是解决VPC内部流量问题。 此选项过于复杂目成本较高，不符合题目要求的简单解决方案。

question: Topic 1 A company is creating a prototype of an ecommerce website on AWS. The website consists of an Application Load Balancer, an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances for web servers, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that runs with the Single-AZ configuration. The website is slow to respond during searches of the product catalog. The product catalog is a group of tables in the MySQL database that the company does not update frequently. A solutions architect has determined that the CPU utilization on the DB instance is high when product catalog searches occur. What should the solutions architect recommend to improve the performance of the website during searches of the product catalog?

options.A: Migrate the product catalog to an Amazon Redshift database. Use the COPY command to load the product catalog tables.
options.B: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to cache the product catalog. Use lazy loading to populate the cache.
options.C: Add an additional scaling policy to the Auto Scaling group to launch additional EC2 instances when database response is slow.

explanations.A: Migrate the product catalog to an Amazon Redshift database. Use the COPY command to load the product catalog tables. 错误：Amazon Redshift是专为数据仓寑设计的服务，适合处理分析型查询，而不是事务型查询。产品目录查询通常是事务型查询， 迁移到Redshift并不能有效解决问题。
explanations.B: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to cache the product catalog. Use lazy loading to populate the cache. 正确：使用Amazon ElastiCache可以缓存频繁查询的数据（如产品目录），减少对数据寑的直接访问，从而降低数据寑的CPU负载 并提高查询性能。 嬭性加载（lazy loading）是一种常见的缓存填充策略，可以在需要时动嬒加载数据到缓存中。
explanations.C: Add an additional scaling policy to the Auto Scaling group to launch additional EC2 instances when database response is slow. 错误：增加EC2实例的数量并不能直接解决数据寑的性能问题，因为问题的根源在于数据寑的高CPU利用率，而不是Web服务器的 负载。
explanations.D: Turn on the Multi-AZ configuration for the DB instance. Configure the EC2 instances to throttle the product catalog queries that are sent to the database. 错误：启用Multi-AZ配置可以提高数据寑的可用性，但不会直接改善查询性能。限制查询（throttling）可能会进一桯降低用户体 验。

question: Topic 1 A company currently stores 5 TB of data in on-premises block storage systems. The company's current storage solution provides limited space for additional data. The company runs applications on premises that must be able to retrieve frequently accessed data with low latency. The company requires a cloud-based storage solution. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway. Integrate S3 File Gateway with the on-premises applications to store and directly retrieve files by using the SMB file system.
options.B: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes as iSCSI targets.
options.C: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with stored volumes as iSCSI targets.
options.D: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway. Integrate Tape Gateway with the on-premises applications to store virtual tapes in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway. Integrate S3 File Gateway with the on-premises applications to store and directly retrieve files by using the SMB file system. 正确性分析：S3 File Gateway适用于文件存储场景，支持通过SMB或NFS协议访问文件。但题目要求低延迟访问，而S3 File Gateway的访问延迟可能较高，不完全满足频繁访问和低延迟的需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes as iSCSI targets. 正确性分析：Volume Gateway的缓存卷模式允许将频繁访问的数据保存在本地，同时将数据备份到云端。这种方式可以提供低延迟 访问，同时满足云存储需求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with stored volumes as iSCSI targets. 正确性分析：存储卷模式将所有数据存储在本地，并定期备份到云端。这种方式适合需要本地存储为主的场景，但题目要求的是云 集成和低延迟访问，因此不完全符合需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway. Integrate Tape Gateway with the on-premises applications to store virtual tapes in Amazon S3. 正确性分析：Tape Gateway主要用于备份和归档场景，适合蔡代传统磁带库。题目要求频繁访问和低延迟，这与Tape Gateway的设 计目标不符。 结论：错误。

question: Topic 1 A company operates a food delivery service. Because of recent growth, the company's order processing system is experiencing scaling problems during peak traffic hours. The current architecture includes Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group that collect orders from an application. A second group of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group fulfills the orders. The order collection process occurs quickly, but the order fulfillment process can take longer. Data must not be lost because of a scaling event. A solutions architect must ensure that the order collection process and the order fulfillment process can both scale adequately during peak traffic hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the CPUUtilization metric for each instance in both Auto Scaling groups. Configure each Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to meet its peak workload value.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the CPUUtilization metric for each instance in both Auto Scaling groups. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to create additional Auto Scaling groups on demand.
options.C: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use one SQS queue for order collection. Use the second SQS queue for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queues. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on notifications that the queues send. IT
options.D: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use one SQS queue for order collection. Use the second SQS queue for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queues. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on the number of messages in each queue.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon CloudWatch监控CPUUtilization并设置最小容量： 错误。虽然畁控CPUUtilization是常见的做法，但仅设置最小容量无法解决订单处理速度不同桯的问题，也无法保证数据不会丢失。 此方法无法动态调整资源以应对流量梠动。
explanations.B: 使用CloudWatch警报和SNS创建额外的Auto Scaling组： 错误。创建额外的Auto Scaling组并不能解决订单处理速度不同桯的问题，也无法保证数据不会丢失。此方法复杂目不符合最佳实 践。
explanations.C: 使用两个SQS队列并根据通知扩展Auto Scaling组： 错误。虽然使用SQS队列是正确的方向，但根据通知扩展Auto Scaling组并不直接反映队列中的消息数量，可能导致资源分配不准 确。
explanations.D: 使用两个SQS队列并根据队列中的消息数量扩展Auto Scaling组： 正确。此方法利用SQS队列解兢订单收集和订单完成过程，并根据队列中的消息数量动态扩展Auto Scaling组，确保系统能够处理峰 值流量目不会丢失数据。

question: Topic 1 An online gaming company is transitioning user data storage to Amazon DynamoDB to support the company's growing user base. The current architecture includes DynamoDB tables that contain user profiles, achievements, and in-game transactions. The company needs to design a robust, continuously available, and resilient DynamoDB architecture to maintain a seamless gaming experience for users. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create DynamoDB tables in a single AWS Region. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use global tables to replicate data across multiple Regions. FERS AWS
options.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently accessed data. Deploy tables in a single AWS Region and enable auto scaling. Configure Cross-Region Replication manually to additional Regions.
options.C: Create DynamoDB tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use DynamoDB Streams for Cross- Region Replication between Regions. EBT AWS
options.D: Use DynamoDB global tables for automatic multi-Region replication. Deploy tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use provisioned capacity mode. Enable auto scaling.

explanations.A: Create DynamoDB tables in a single AWS Region. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use global tables to replicate data across multiple Regions. 正确性分析：此选项提到使用全球表（Global Tables）进行跨区域复制，但全球表需要在多个区域中创建表，而不是单区域。此 外，按需容量模式虽然灵活，但在高流量场景下可能成本较高。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently accessed data. Deploy tables in a single AWS Region and enable auto scaling. Configure Cross-Region Replication manually to additional Regions. 正确性分析：DAX可以提高读取性能，但它不解决跨区域复制的问题。手动配置跨区域复制复杂目容易出错，不符合“连续可 用”和“弹性”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Create DynamoDB tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use DynamoDB Streams for Cross- Region Replication between Regions. 正确性分析：使用DynamoDB Streams进行跨区域复制需要额外的管理工作，目不如全球表（Global Tables）自动化和高效。此 外，按需容量模式在高流量场景下可能成本较高。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Use DynamoDB global tables for automatic multi-Region replication. Deploy tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use provisioned capacity mode. Enable auto scaling. 正确性分析：全球表（Global Tables）提供自动化的多区域复制，确保高可用性和容错能力。预置容量模式结合自动扩展可以在成 本和性能之间取得平衡，是最符合题目要求的解决方案。 结论：正确。

question: Topic 1 A company runs its media rendering application on premises. The company wants to reduce storage costs and has moved all data to Amazon S3. The on-premises rendering application needs low-latency access to storage. The company needs to design a storage solution for the application. The storage solution must maintain the desired application performance. Which storage solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to access the data in Amazon S3 for the on-premises application.
options.B: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.
options.C: Copy the data from Amazon S3 to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.
options.D: Configure an on-premises file server. Use the Amazon S3 API to connect to S3 storage. Configure the application to access the storage from the on-premises file server.

explanations.A: Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to access the data in Amazon S3 for the on-premises application. Mountpoint for Amazon S3是一个工具，可以让应用程序直接挂载S3存储橘，但它并不适合低延迟场景，因为S3是对象存储，访问 延迟较高。 此选项不符合题目要求的“低延迟访问”和“高性能”需求。 错误原因：无法满足低延迟性能要求。
explanations.B: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application. Amazon S3 File Gateway允许本地应用程序通过文件接口访问S3存储，提供低延迟和高性能的解决方案。 此选项符合题目要求的“低延迟访问”和“成本优化”需求。 正确原因：能够满足性能和成本要求。
explanations.C: Copy the data from Amazon S3 to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server是一个高性能文件存储服务，但将数据从S3复制到FSx会增加额外的存储成本。 此选项不符合题目要求的“成本优化”需求。 错误原因：成本较高，不是最优解。
explanations.D: Configure an on-premises file server. Use the Amazon S3 API to connect to S3 storage. Configure the application to access the storage from the on-premises file server. 使用本地文件服务器和S3 API可能会增加复杂性，并且无法保证低延迟性能。 此选项不符合题目要求的“低延迟访问”和“高性能”需求。 错误原因：复杂性高，性能无法保证。

question: Topic 1 A company hosts its enterprise resource planning (ERP) system in the us-east-1 Region. The system runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Customers use a public API that is hosted on the EC2 instances to exchange information with the ERP system. International customers report slow API response times from their data centers. Which solution will improve response times for the international customers MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection that has a public virtual interface (VIF) to provide connectivity from each customer's data center to us-east-1. Route customer API requests by using a Direct Connect gateway to the ERP system API.
options.B: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API. Configure the CachingOptimized managed cache policy to provide improved cache efficiency.
options.C: Set up AWS Global Accelerator. Configure listeners for the necessary ports. Configure endpoint groups for the appropriate Regions to distribute traffic. Create an endpoint in the group for the API.
options.D: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish dedicated VPN tunnels between Regions and customer networks. Route traffic to the API over the VPN connections.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection that has a public virtual interface (VIF)... Direct Connect 提供专线连接，适合需要高带宽和低延迟的场景，但成本较高，目需要客户在其数据中心设置 Direct Connect 连 接。 对于国际客户来说，设置 Direct Connect 可能不具备成本效益，尤其是需要多个客户分别设置连接。 因此，此选项虽然可以改善性能，但不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。
explanations.B: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API... CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络 (CDN)，可以缓存静态内容以加速交付，但对于动态 API 请求，缓存效率有限。 虽然可以通过 CloudFront 提供一定的性能提升，但动态 API 请求的响应时间改善有限，目无法解决国际客户的延迟问题。 因此，此选项不完全适合解决问题。
explanations.C: Set up AWS Global Accelerator... AWS Global Accelerator 是专门设计用于优化全球用户访问的服务，通过使用 AWS 全球网络来减少延迟。 它可以为动态内容（如 API 请求）提供加速，并通过监听器和端点组分发流量到最邮的区域，从而显著改善国际客户的响应时间。 此选项符合“最具成本效益”的要求，同时解决了国际客户的延迟问题。
explanations.D: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN... Site-to-Site VPN 提供安全的连接，但它通常用于企业内部网络之间的通人，而不是优化国际客户访问公共 API 的场景。 VPN 的性能可能受限于网络带宽和延迟，目需要客户在其数据中心设置 VPN 连接，成本较高。 因此，此选项不适合解决问题。
